units.english: Pirate Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione pirata

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|description|17|0
units.english: Fly through the <waypoints> systems, then report to <destination> so the Southern Mutual Defense Pact can analyze your logs of pirate activity (if any).
units.italian: Attraversa i sistemi <waypoints>, poi presenta il rapporto a <destination> così che il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud possa analizzare i tuoi registri sull'attività dei pirati (se ce n'è stata).

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|You can't help noticing that the freighter parked next to the <ship> is in very bad shape, its hull pockmarked with blaster scars, as well as larger dents that may be from missiles. The crew and a number of men in militia uniforms are busy welding new hull plating onto it; the captain is having an animated conversation with a young female militia officer.|34|0
units.english: You can't help noticing that the freighter parked next to the <ship> is in very bad shape, its hull pockmarked with blaster scars, as well as larger dents that may be from missiles. The crew and a number of men in militia uniforms are busy welding new hull plating onto it; the captain is having an animated conversation with a young female militia officer.
units.italian: Non puoi fare a meno di notare che il mercantile parcheggiato accanto al <ship> è in pessime condizioni: lo scafo è crivellato di segni di blaster, oltre a bozzi più grandi che forse vengono da missili. L'equipaggio e diversi uomini in uniforme della milizia sono indaffarati a saldare nuove lastre di scafo; il capitano sta avendo una conversazione animata con una giovane ufficiale della milizia.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	(Approach them and find out what happened.)|36|0
units.english: (Approach them and find out what happened.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati e scopri che cosa è successo.)

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	(Ignore them.)|37|0
units.english: (Ignore them.)
units.italian: (Ignorali.)

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	You overhear enough of the conversation to figure out that the freighter was attacked by pirates, and the militia are helping to get it in working condition again. "A little spit shine and it'll look as good as new," the officer says, but the captain of the ship doesn't look convinced and walks up to his ship to work on it alongside the crew.|39|0
units.english: You overhear enough of the conversation to figure out that the freighter was attacked by pirates, and the militia are helping to get it in working condition again. "A little spit shine and it'll look as good as new," the officer says, but the captain of the ship doesn't look convinced and walks up to his ship to work on it alongside the crew.
units.italian: Senti abbastanza della conversazione da capire che il mercantile è stato attaccato dai pirati e che la milizia sta aiutando a rimetterlo in condizioni di funzionare. "Con una lucidata andrà come nuovo," dice l'ufficiale, ma il capitano della nave non sembra convinto e si avvicina alla sua nave per lavorare insieme all'equipaggio.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	The militia officer glances over her shoulder and, having spotted you listening in, waves you over. "No need to be shy," she says. "I'm guessing you're not from around here."|40|0
units.english: The militia officer glances over her shoulder and, having spotted you listening in, waves you over. "No need to be shy," she says. "I'm guessing you're not from around here."
units.italian: L'ufficiale della milizia si guarda alle spalle e, vedendoti ascoltare, ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. "Non c'è bisogno di essere timidi," dice. "Immagino che tu non sia di queste parti."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"How can you tell?"|42|0
units.english: "How can you tell?"
units.italian: "Come fai a dirlo?"

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Are the pirates rough around these parts?"|43|0
units.english: "Are the pirates rough around these parts?"
units.italian: "I pirati sono violenti da queste parti?"

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Because captains from around here don't rubberneck at an every-day occurrence. After seeing your first dozen or so damaged ships, you eventually get used to seeing them and just move on."|45|0
units.english: "Because captains from around here don't rubberneck at an every-day occurrence. After seeing your first dozen or so damaged ships, you eventually get used to seeing them and just move on."
units.italian: "Perché i capitani di queste parti non si fermano a guardare una cosa che succede tutti i giorni. Dopo le prime dodici navi danneggiate, ci fai l'abitudine e tiri dritto."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Are the pirates rough around these parts?" you ask.|46|0
units.english: "Are the pirates rough around these parts?" you ask.
units.italian: "I pirati sono violenti da queste parti?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Rougher than you're probably used to if you're from farther up north. The Navy doesn't patrol these parts, not unless there's some high profile warlord that's on their radar. Because of that, pirates have more free rein to terrorize us down here." She pauses for a moment while turning back to the freighter. "And the pirate fleets keep getting stronger every year," she says with concern.|48|0
units.english: "Rougher than you're probably used to if you're from farther up north. The Navy doesn't patrol these parts, not unless there's some high profile warlord that's on their radar. Because of that, pirates have more free rein to terrorize us down here." She pauses for a moment while turning back to the freighter. "And the pirate fleets keep getting stronger every year," she says with concern.
units.italian: "Più violenti di quanto tu sia abituato, se vieni da molto più a nord. La Marina non pattuglia queste zone, non a meno che non ci sia qualche signore della guerra di alto profilo sul loro radar. Per questo i pirati hanno più libertà di terrorizzarci quaggiù." Si ferma un momento mentre si volta di nuovo verso il mercantile. "E le flotte dei pirati diventano più forti ogni anno," dice, preoccupata.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Is there something I can do to help?"|50|0
units.english: "Is there something I can do to help?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che posso fare per aiutare?"

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"I wish I could help, but my ship is not a warship."|51|0
units.english: "I wish I could help, but my ship is not a warship."
units.italian: "Vorrei aiutare, ma la mia nave non è una nave da guerra."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"There is indeed," she says. "Have you heard of the Southern Mutual Defense Pact?"|53|0
units.english: "There is indeed," she says. "Have you heard of the Southern Mutual Defense Pact?"
units.italian: "Certo che c'è," dice. "Hai mai sentito parlare del Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud?"

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"There are other ways you could help us," she says. "Have you heard of the Southern Mutual Defense Pact?"|56|0
units.english: "There are other ways you could help us," she says. "Have you heard of the Southern Mutual Defense Pact?"
units.italian: "Ci sono altri modi in cui potresti aiutarci," dice. "Hai mai sentito parlare del Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud?"

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"No. What is it?"|59|0
units.english: "No. What is it?"
units.italian: "No. Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Yes."|60|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	She says, "We're a collection of worlds that have decided that since the Navy doesn't patrol this part of the galaxy anymore, it's up to us to keep the pirates in check. The idea is that if the pirates ever try something big, like capturing an entire planet, that planet can call on the entire Pact to assist them. And, as you can see, we also do our fair share of helping out the local merchants where we can."|62|0
units.english: She says, "We're a collection of worlds that have decided that since the Navy doesn't patrol this part of the galaxy anymore, it's up to us to keep the pirates in check. The idea is that if the pirates ever try something big, like capturing an entire planet, that planet can call on the entire Pact to assist them. And, as you can see, we also do our fair share of helping out the local merchants where we can."
units.italian: Dice: "Siamo un insieme di mondi che ha deciso che, dato che la Marina non pattuglia più questa parte della galassia, tocca a noi tenere a freno i pirati. L'idea è che, se i pirati provano qualcosa di grosso, tipo conquistare un intero pianeta, quel pianeta può chiamare tutto il Patto in suo aiuto. E, come vedi, facciamo anche la nostra parte per aiutare i mercanti del posto, quando possiamo."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Sounds like a good idea," you say.|63|0
units.english: "Sounds like a good idea," you say.
units.italian: "Sembra una buona idea," dici.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"The Pact is launching a new initiative, led by myself," she says. "We're calling it the 'Thousand Eyes.' We're asking merchant ship captains to let us access their scanner logs, basically using merchants as a surveillance network. You don't have to fight the pirates, just let us know if you see them. Interested?"|65|0
units.english: "The Pact is launching a new initiative, led by myself," she says. "We're calling it the 'Thousand Eyes.' We're asking merchant ship captains to let us access their scanner logs, basically using merchants as a surveillance network. You don't have to fight the pirates, just let us know if you see them. Interested?"
units.italian: "Il Patto sta lanciando una nuova iniziativa, guidata da me," dice. "La chiamiamo 'Mille Occhi'. Chiediamo ai capitani dei mercantili di darci accesso ai registri dei loro scanner, in pratica usando i mercanti come rete di sorveglianza. Non devi combattere i pirati, devi solo farci sapere se li vedi. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Sure, I would be glad to help."|67|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to help."
units.italian: "Certo, sarò lieto di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Sorry, sounds too risky."|68|0
units.english: "Sorry, sounds too risky."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, mi sembra troppo rischioso."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Great!" she says. "Right now, we need more eyes on a few systems on the edge of Southern space. All you need to do is fly through those systems, then report to our base on <destination>. I'll mark the target systems on your ship's map for you. And by the way, the name's Freya Winters."|70|0
units.english: "Great!" she says. "Right now, we need more eyes on a few systems on the edge of Southern space. All you need to do is fly through those systems, then report to our base on <destination>. I'll mark the target systems on your ship's map for you. And by the way, the name's Freya Winters."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice. "Al momento ci servono più occhi su alcuni sistemi ai margini dello spazio del Sud. Ti basta attraversare quei sistemi, poi presentarti alla nostra base su <destination>. Ti segno i sistemi bersaglio sulla mappa della nave. E comunque, mi chiamo Freya Winters."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"<first> <last>," you respond, shaking her hand.|71|0
units.english: "<first> <last>," you respond, shaking her hand.
units.italian: "<first> <last>," rispondi, stringendole la mano.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|	"Nice to meet you, Captain <last>. Glad to have another helping hand. I'll be heading to <planet> after I've finished my business on <origin>, so see you there."|72|0
units.english: "Nice to meet you, Captain <last>. Glad to have another helping hand. I'll be heading to <planet> after I've finished my business on <origin>, so see you there."
units.italian: "Piacere di conoscerti, Capitano <last>. Sono contenta di avere un altro paio di mani. Andrò su <planet> dopo aver sbrigato i miei affari su <origin>, quindi ci vediamo là."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|log|76|0
units.english: Volunteered to help the Southern Mutual Defense Pact keep tabs on pirate activity in their region of space. Pirate attacks seem to be getting worse because the Navy doesn't bother to patrol down here anymore.
units.italian: Ti sei offerto di aiutare il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud a tenere d'occhio l'attività dei pirati nella loro regione di spazio. Gli attacchi dei pirati sembrano peggiorare perché la Marina non si degna più di pattugliare quaggiù.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 0|dialog|83|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, you're approached by Freya Winters. She gives you <payment> in exchange for your scanner logs of the Southern systems. "Thank you, Captain. I pray the pirates didn't give you too much trouble," she says. "I'll be in touch when we've got a new assignment for you, assuming you're still interested."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, ti viene incontro Freya Winters. Ti dà <payment> in cambio dei registri dei tuoi scanner sui sistemi del Sud. "Grazie, Capitano. Confido che i pirati non ti abbiano dato troppo fastidio," dice. "Ti farò sapere quando avremo un nuovo incarico per te, sempre che tu sia ancora interessato."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 1|name|91|0
units.english: Pirate Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione pirata

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 1|description|92|0
units.english: Fly through the <waypoints> systems, then report to <destination> so the Southern Mutual Defense Pact can analyze your logs of pirate activity (if any).
units.italian: Attraversa i sistemi <waypoints>, poi presenta il rapporto a <destination> così che il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud possa analizzare i tuoi registri sull'attività dei pirati (se ce n'è stata).

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 1|dialog|107|0
units.english: You receive a message from Freya, the militia officer in charge of tracking pirate activity. "Hello, Captain <last>. I pray you're still interested in being a part of our Thousand Eyes program. We need some more intel on the empty systems in the middle of the Dirt Belt," she says. "Pay would be a bit better than last time, since these systems are a bit more out of the way. As with before, return to <destination> once you're finished."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Freya, l'ufficiale della milizia incaricata di seguire l'attività dei pirati. "Salve, Capitano <last>. Confido che tu sia ancora interessato a far parte del nostro programma Mille Occhi. Ci servono altre informazioni sui sistemi vuoti nel mezzo della Fascia di Terra," dice. "La paga sarebbe un po' migliore dell'ultima volta, dato che questi sistemi sono un po' più fuori mano. Come prima, torna a <destination> quando hai finito."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 1|dialog|114|0
units.english: You transfer your sensor logs to Freya. She thanks you for your work and pays you <payment>. "I'll let you know when we need your services again," she says.
units.italian: Trasferisci i registri dei sensori a Freya. Ti ringrazia per il lavoro e ti paga <payment>. "Ti farò sapere quando avremo di nuovo bisogno dei tuoi servizi," dice.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 2|name|122|0
units.english: Pirate Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione pirata

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 2|description|123|0
units.english: Fly through the <waypoints> systems, then report to <destination> so the Southern Mutual Defense Pact can analyze your logs of pirate activity (if any).
units.italian: Attraversa i sistemi <waypoints>, poi presenta il rapporto a <destination> così che il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud possa analizzare i tuoi registri sull'attività dei pirati (se ce n'è stata).

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 2|dialog|138|0
units.english: You receive another message from Freya: "Hello, Captain! I've got a more challenging and lucrative mission for you this time. We need someone to do a flyby of four pirate systems bordering the South, to gauge their strength. Again, no fighting is required, just fly in and out of the systems as fast as possible, and we're willing to pay much more than the last job given the danger involved. What do you say?"
units.italian: Ricevi un altro messaggio da Freya: "Salve, Capitano! Questa volta ho un incarico più impegnativo e più redditizio per te. Ci serve qualcuno che faccia un sorvolo di quattro sistemi pirata al confine con il Sud, per valutare la loro forza. Di nuovo, non serve combattere: entra ed esci dai sistemi il più in fretta possibile, e siamo disposti a pagare molto più dell'ultimo lavoro, visto il pericolo. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 2|dialog|145|0
units.english: Freya Winters meets up with you in person soon after you land. "Glad to see you're still in one piece. I pray you didn't have much trouble," she says, as she hands you a credit chip for <payment>. "You've been a great help to us. I'll be sure to contact you next time we need a scout."
units.italian: Freya Winters ti viene incontro di persona poco dopo che atterri. "Sono contenta di vedere che sei ancora tutto intero. Confido che tu non abbia avuto troppi problemi," dice, porgendoti un chip di credito per <payment>. "Ci sei stato di grande aiuto. Ti contatterò di sicuro la prossima volta che avremo bisogno di un esploratore."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 3|name|153|0
units.english: Pirate Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione pirata

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 3|description|154|0
units.english: Fly through the <marks> systems, searching for a gathering pirate fleet. Report to the Pact on <destination> once you have located them.
units.italian: Attraversa i sistemi <marks> cercando una flotta pirata in raduno. Presenta il rapporto al Patto su <destination> quando l'hai individuata.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 3|dialog|168|0
units.english: Once again, you receive a message from Freya Winters. "We have another mission for you," she says, "this one a bit more dangerous. We've heard rumors of a pirate fleet amassing in one of the seldom-visited systems in the Dirt Belt, and we need to know where they are. Interested in helping to track them down? As before, you don't need to fight, just observe them."
units.italian: Ancora una volta ricevi un messaggio da Freya Winters. "Abbiamo un altro incarico per te," dice, "e questo è un po' più pericoloso. Abbiamo sentito voci di una flotta pirata che si sta radunando in uno dei sistemi poco visitati della Fascia di Terra, e dobbiamo sapere dove sono. Ti interessa aiutarci a rintracciarli? Come prima, non devi combattere, devi solo osservarli."

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 3|dialog|189|0
units.english: You have located the pirate fleet. Time to head back to <planet> to report to Freya what you found.
units.italian: Hai individuato la flotta pirata. È tempo di tornare su <planet> e riferire a Freya che cosa hai trovato.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 3|dialog|191|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you haven't located the pirate fleet yet! Better depart and make sure you have checked <marks>.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non hai ancora individuato la flotta pirata! Meglio ripartire e assicurarti di aver controllato <marks>.

units.id: mission:Pact Recon 3|dialog|197|0
units.english: You report to Freya that you found a sizable pirate fleet in the Naper system, as well as spotting some pirates elsewhere. She thanks you, and pays you <payment>. "Thank you for your assistance," she says. "Again, I'll be in touch if we need you."
units.italian: Riferisci a Freya di aver trovato una flotta pirata considerevole nel sistema Naper, e di aver avvistato altri pirati altrove. Ti ringrazia e ti paga <payment>. "Grazie per il tuo aiuto," dice. "Di nuovo, ti contatterò se avremo bisogno di te."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|log|212|0
units.english: Apparently the Navy is suspicious of anyone who worked with the Southern Mutual Defense Pact; got questioned about it by an officer. It was unclear what his rank or position in the Navy was.
units.italian: A quanto pare la Marina diffida di chiunque abbia lavorato con il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud; un ufficiale ti ha fatto delle domande in proposito. Non era chiaro quale fosse il suo grado o la sua posizione nella Marina.

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|As you complete the usual landing documents with the Navy inspector outside your ship, another officer, a middle-aged man in the same uniform, walks up from behind him. As he passes by he gives a curt nod to the inspector, who suddenly walks away swiftly without saying anything, not even a "good day" to you or this new officer. He must have some sort of seniority over the inspector.|214|0
units.english: As you complete the usual landing documents with the Navy inspector outside your ship, another officer, a middle-aged man in the same uniform, walks up from behind him. As he passes by he gives a curt nod to the inspector, who suddenly walks away swiftly without saying anything, not even a "good day" to you or this new officer. He must have some sort of seniority over the inspector.
units.italian: Mentre completi le solite pratiche di atterraggio con l'ispettore della Marina fuori dalla nave, un altro ufficiale, un uomo di mezza età con la stessa uniforme, si avvicina da dietro. Passando, fa un cenno secco all'ispettore, che se ne va in fretta senza dire nulla, nemmeno un "buongiorno" a te o a questo nuovo ufficiale. Deve avere una qualche anzianità rispetto all'ispettore.

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	Once the inspector is out of the way, the new officer turns to you and says, "Excuse me, Captain <last>. I would like to speak with you for a few minutes."|215|0
units.english: Once the inspector is out of the way, the new officer turns to you and says, "Excuse me, Captain <last>. I would like to speak with you for a few minutes."
units.italian: Quando l'ispettore si è allontanato, il nuovo ufficiale si volta verso di te e dice: "Mi scusi, Capitano <last>. Vorrei parlarle per qualche minuto."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Okay."|217|0
units.english: "Okay."
units.italian: "Va bene."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Sorry, I'm really busy right now."|219|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm really busy right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, adesso sono davvero occupato."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Unfortunately, this cannot wait," he responds.|220|0
units.english: "Unfortunately, this cannot wait," he responds.
units.italian: "Purtroppo non può aspettare," risponde.

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Am I correct that you have been assisting the Southern Mutual Defense Pact?"|224|0
units.english: "Am I correct that you have been assisting the Southern Mutual Defense Pact?"
units.italian: "È corretto che lei abbia aiutato il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud?"

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Am I correct that you performed some missions for the Southern Mutual Defense Pact, back before they became the Free Worlds?"|227|0
units.english: "Am I correct that you performed some missions for the Southern Mutual Defense Pact, back before they became the Free Worlds?"
units.italian: "È corretto che lei abbia svolto alcune missioni per il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud, prima che diventasse le Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	His voice is very friendly, and he is not armed or accompanied by any other officers that you can see, so it doesn't seem like you are in trouble or in danger of being arrested - especially since your work for the Pact was perfectly legal.|229|0
units.english: His voice is very friendly, and he is not armed or accompanied by any other officers that you can see, so it doesn't seem like you are in trouble or in danger of being arrested - especially since your work for the Pact was perfectly legal.
units.italian: La sua voce è molto amichevole, e non è armato né accompagnato da altri ufficiali che tu possa vedere, quindi non sembra che tu sia nei guai né in pericolo di arresto, tanto più che il tuo lavoro per il Patto era perfettamente legale.

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I don't know what you are talking about."|231|0
units.english: "I don't know what you are talking about."
units.italian: "Non so di che cosa stia parlando."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I did take a few jobs helping out the local militias, yes."|232|0
units.english: "I did take a few jobs helping out the local militias, yes."
units.italian: "Ho accettato qualche incarico per aiutare le milizie locali, sì."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Yes, I ran several missions for the Pact."|234|0
units.english: "Yes, I ran several missions for the Pact."
units.italian: "Sì, ho svolto diverse missioni per il Patto."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I'm sorry, but I don't want to talk to you about that."|236|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I don't want to talk to you about that."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non voglio parlarne con lei."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	He has been looking intently into your eye, and when you lie to him, he frowns. "It really isn't necessary to lie to me," he says. You are not sure what to say in response, so you remain quiet.|238|0
units.english: He has been looking intently into your eye, and when you lie to him, he frowns. "It really isn't necessary to lie to me," he says. You are not sure what to say in response, so you remain quiet.
units.italian: Ti sta guardando intensamente negli occhi, e quando gli menti si acciglia. "Non c'è davvero bisogno di mentirmi," dice. Non sai bene che cosa rispondere, quindi resti in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Tell me," he says, "was there one particular militia officer who you reported to, or was it someone different every time?" As he is speaking, you look for clues of who he is or why he is questioning you, and you notice something very odd. The Navy inspector before, and all Navy personnel you have encountered in the past, had a name badge on their lapel and rank insignia on their collar. But this officer's uniform is entirely blank.|240|0
units.english: "Tell me," he says, "was there one particular militia officer who you reported to, or was it someone different every time?" As he is speaking, you look for clues of who he is or why he is questioning you, and you notice something very odd. The Navy inspector before, and all Navy personnel you have encountered in the past, had a name badge on their lapel and rank insignia on their collar. But this officer's uniform is entirely blank.
units.italian: "Mi dica," dice, "c'era un particolare ufficiale della milizia a cui lei faceva rapporto, o era ogni volta qualcuno di diverso?" Mentre parla, cerchi indizi su chi sia e perché ti stia interrogando, e noti una cosa molto strana. L'ispettore della Marina di prima, e tutto il personale della Marina che hai incontrato in passato, portava un distintivo col nome sul bavero e le insegne di grado sul colletto. L'uniforme di questo ufficiale è completamente vuota.

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I don't remember anyone's name in particular."|242|0
units.english: "I don't remember anyone's name in particular."
units.italian: "Non ricordo il nome di nessuno in particolare."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I would rather not name any names."|243|0
units.english: "I would rather not name any names."
units.italian: "Preferirei non fare nomi."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I usually reported to an officer named Freya Winters."|244|0
units.english: "I usually reported to an officer named Freya Winters."
units.italian: "Di solito facevo rapporto a un'ufficiale di nome Freya Winters."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I don't want to talk about this. I'm leaving."|246|0
units.english: "I don't want to talk about this. I'm leaving."
units.italian: "Non voglio parlare di questo. Me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Oh well," he says, "it was worth asking. Would you at least be willing to tell me the nature of the missions you were performing?"|248|0
units.english: "Oh well," he says, "it was worth asking. Would you at least be willing to tell me the nature of the missions you were performing?"
units.italian: "Pazienza," dice, "valeva la pena chiedere. Sarebbe almeno disposto a dirmi la natura delle missioni che svolgeva?"

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Ah yes, Miss Winters," he says. "A very capable woman, although she's more skilled as an engineer than as a leader. Can you tell me what sort of work you were performing for her?"|251|0
units.english: "Ah yes, Miss Winters," he says. "A very capable woman, although she's more skilled as an engineer than as a leader. Can you tell me what sort of work you were performing for her?"
units.italian: "Ah, sì, la signorina Winters," dice. "Una donna molto capace, anche se è più abile come ingegnere che come comandante. Può dirmi che tipo di lavoro svolgeva per lei?"

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I'd rather not say."|254|0
units.english: "I'd rather not say."
units.italian: "Preferirei non dirlo."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Who are you? Why are you asking me these questions?"|256|0
units.english: "Who are you? Why are you asking me these questions?"
units.italian: "Lei chi è? Perché mi fa queste domande?"

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Reconnaissance missions, tracking pirate movements."|258|0
units.english: "Reconnaissance missions, tracking pirate movements."
units.italian: "Missioni di ricognizione, per seguire i movimenti dei pirati."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Sorry, I'm done talking to you."|260|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm done talking to you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ho finito di parlare con lei."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Are you certain your reconnaissance was only targeted at pirates?" he asks. "Did they collect only your logs on pirate ships, or on every ship you saw?"|263|0
units.english: "Are you certain your reconnaissance was only targeted at pirates?" he asks. "Did they collect only your logs on pirate ships, or on every ship you saw?"
units.italian: "È certo che la sua ricognizione fosse rivolta solo ai pirati?" chiede. "Raccoglievano solo i suoi registri sulle navi pirata, o su ogni nave che vedeva?"

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I honestly don't know."|265|0
units.english: "I honestly don't know."
units.italian: "Sinceramente non lo so."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I think it was only the pirate ships."|266|0
units.english: "I think it was only the pirate ships."
units.italian: "Credo che fossero solo le navi pirata."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I just gave them all my logs. I'm not sure what parts of them they ended up using."|267|0
units.english: "I just gave them all my logs. I'm not sure what parts of them they ended up using."
units.italian: "Ho dato loro tutti i miei registri. Non so bene quali parti abbiano finito per usare."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I see," he says. "I wonder why they didn't share more of the details of their work with you."|268|0
units.english: "I see," he says. "I wonder why they didn't share more of the details of their work with you."
units.italian: "Capisco," dice. "Mi chiedo perché non le abbiano condiviso più dettagli del loro lavoro."

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Why are you asking me all these questions?" you say.|269|0
units.english: "Why are you asking me all these questions?" you say.
units.italian: "Perché mi fa tutte queste domande?" dici.

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"I'm just collecting information," he says. "Anything you tell me is interesting to me." Then, with a mischievous grin, he adds, "Anything you refuse to tell me is also interesting. Anyway, I won't detain you any longer. Thank you for your time." He smiles and walks away, leaving you with no idea of what is going on.|271|0
units.english: "I'm just collecting information," he says. "Anything you tell me is interesting to me." Then, with a mischievous grin, he adds, "Anything you refuse to tell me is also interesting. Anyway, I won't detain you any longer. Thank you for your time." He smiles and walks away, leaving you with no idea of what is going on.
units.italian: "Sto solo raccogliendo informazioni," dice. "Qualunque cosa lei mi dica è interessante per me." Poi, con un sorriso malizioso, aggiunge: "Anche qualunque cosa si rifiuti di dirmi è interessante. Comunque non la trattengo oltre. Grazie per il suo tempo." Sorride e si allontana, lasciandoti senza idea di che cosa stia succedendo.

units.id: mission:Pact Questioning|	"Understood," he says. "Thank you for your time." He makes no effort to detain you, and walks away in the direction of the Navy garrison.|274|0
units.english: "Understood," he says. "Thank you for your time." He makes no effort to detain you, and walks away in the direction of the Navy garrison.
units.italian: "Ho capito," dice. "Grazie per il suo tempo." Non fa nulla per trattenerti, e si allontana in direzione della guarnigione della Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|name|282|0
units.english: Transport Militia Officer
units.italian: Trasporta un ufficiale della milizia

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|description|283|0
units.english: Transport a Free Worlds militia officer to <destination>.
units.italian: Trasporta un ufficiale della milizia delle Free Worlds fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|A man approaches you in the spaceport. "Hello. Would you be able to give me a lift to <destination>? I'd be able to pay you <payment>." You notice that he is dressed in a militia uniform.|305|0
units.english: A man approaches you in the spaceport. "Hello. Would you be able to give me a lift to <destination>? I'd be able to pay you <payment>." You notice that he is dressed in a militia uniform.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto ti si avvicina un uomo. "Salve. Potrebbe darmi un passaggio fino a <destination>? Le pagherei <payment>." Noti che indossa l'uniforme della milizia.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|	"Sure, I'd be glad to help!"|307|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to help!"
units.italian: "Certo, sarò lieto di aiutare!"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|	"Sorry, I'm busy with something else right now."|309|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm busy with something else right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, al momento sono occupato con altro."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|	"Are you connected to the Free Worlds?"|311|0
units.english: "Are you connected to the Free Worlds?"
units.italian: "Hai legami con le Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|	"Yes, I'm an officer in their militia." The man takes a half step back. "Is that a problem?"|312|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm an officer in their militia." The man takes a half step back. "Is that a problem?"
units.italian: "Sì, sono un ufficiale della loro milizia." L'uomo fa mezzo passo indietro. "È un problema?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|	"No problem at all. I'd be glad to help with your cause!"|314|0
units.english: "No problem at all. I'd be glad to help with your cause!"
units.italian: "Nessun problema. Sarò lieto di aiutare la vostra causa!"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|	"Not a problem, but I'm afraid I don't have space for you right now."|316|0
units.english: "Not a problem, but I'm afraid I don't have space for you right now."
units.italian: "Nessun problema, ma temo di non avere spazio per te adesso."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|	"I don't help rebels. Find someone else."|318|0
units.english: "I don't help rebels. Find someone else."
units.italian: "Non aiuto i ribelli. Cerca qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|dialog|322|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that the militia officer is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che l'ufficiale della milizia è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 0|dialog|325|0
units.english: The militia officer thanks you for the ride and pays you <payment>. As he is leaving, he says, "If you're interested in doing more work for us, head to the spaceport bar and find my commander. I'll tell him to keep an eye out for you."
units.italian: L'ufficiale della milizia ti ringrazia per il passaggio e ti paga <payment>. Mentre se ne va, dice: "Se ti interessa fare altro lavoro per noi, vai al bar dello spazioporto e cerca il mio comandante. Gli dirò di tenere gli occhi aperti per te."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|name|330|0
units.english: Free Worlds Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|description|331|0
units.english: Perform an outfit scan on the Cruiser <npc>, which is currently patrolling <system>, then report to a Free Worlds officer on <planet>.
units.italian: Esegui una scansione dell'equipaggiamento sull'incrociatore <npc>, che al momento pattuglia <system>, poi presenta il rapporto a un ufficiale delle Free Worlds su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|log|338|0
units.english: Bailed on some reconnaissance work from the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai rinunciato a un lavoro di ricognizione per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|log|341|0
units.english: Turned down reconnaissance work from the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato un lavoro di ricognizione per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|When you walk into the spaceport bar, a man in a militia uniform flags you down, and says, "Captain <last>. One of my officers told me to keep an eye out for you. Would you be willing to do another small service for the Free Worlds?"|346|0
units.english: When you walk into the spaceport bar, a man in a militia uniform flags you down, and says, "Captain <last>. One of my officers told me to keep an eye out for you. Would you be willing to do another small service for the Free Worlds?"
units.italian: Quando entri nel bar dello spazioporto, un uomo in uniforme della milizia ti fa cenno e dice: "Capitano <last>. Uno dei miei ufficiali mi ha detto di tenere gli occhi aperti per te. Saresti disposto a fare un altro piccolo servizio per le Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"Perhaps. What do you want me to do?"|348|0
units.english: "Perhaps. What do you want me to do?"
units.italian: "Forse. Che cosa vuoi che faccia?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"I only agreed to a transport job. I want no part in your rebellion."|349|0
units.english: "I only agreed to a transport job. I want no part in your rebellion."
units.italian: "Ho accettato solo un lavoro di trasporto. Non voglio avere niente a che fare con la vostra ribellione."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"It's a rather simple matter," he says. "Most of the Republic ships that have come through this system seem to be outfitted for surveillance, not combat. But there is one in orbit right now, the <npc>, that seems to be equipped as a warship. Would you be willing to scan its outfits and report to us what you find? The outfitter stocks scanners if you don't have one, though you might want to install a few of them to improve performance. We will pay <payment>."|351|0
units.english: "It's a rather simple matter," he says. "Most of the Republic ships that have come through this system seem to be outfitted for surveillance, not combat. But there is one in orbit right now, the <npc>, that seems to be equipped as a warship. Would you be willing to scan its outfits and report to us what you find? The outfitter stocks scanners if you don't have one, though you might want to install a few of them to improve performance. We will pay <payment>."
units.italian: "È una cosa piuttosto semplice," dice. "La maggior parte delle navi della Repubblica che sono passate per questo sistema sembra equipaggiata per la sorveglianza, non per il combattimento. Ma ce n'è una in orbita proprio ora, la <npc>, che sembra attrezzata come nave da guerra. Saresti disposto a scansionarne l'equipaggiamento e a riferirci che cosa trovi? Il negozio di equipaggiamento tiene gli scanner, se non ne hai, anche se potresti volerne installare più di uno per migliorare le prestazioni. Pagheremo <payment>."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"Sure, that sounds simple enough."|353|0
units.english: "Sure, that sounds simple enough."
units.italian: "Certo, sembra abbastanza semplice."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"Why can't you scan the ship yourself?"|355|0
units.english: "Why can't you scan the ship yourself?"
units.italian: "Perché non puoi scansionare la nave da solo?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"I'm sure you understand the... tensions between the Free Worlds and the Republic at the moment. We're just trying to look out for ourselves, but we don't want to provoke anything with the Navy. It'd be much simpler if we could get a sympathetic merchant to scan the ship for us."|356|0
units.english: "I'm sure you understand the... tensions between the Free Worlds and the Republic at the moment. We're just trying to look out for ourselves, but we don't want to provoke anything with the Navy. It'd be much simpler if we could get a sympathetic merchant to scan the ship for us."
units.italian: "Sono sicuro che capisci le... tensioni fra le Free Worlds e la Repubblica in questo momento. Stiamo solo cercando di badare a noi stessi, ma non vogliamo provocare nulla con la Marina. Sarebbe molto più semplice se un mercante comprensivo scansionasse la nave per noi."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"Sounds reasonable enough. I'll do it."|358|0
units.english: "Sounds reasonable enough. I'll do it."
units.italian: "Mi sembra abbastanza ragionevole. Lo farò."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"If shady jobs like this are what constitute 'helping the Free Worlds,' then count me out."|360|0
units.english: "If shady jobs like this are what constitute 'helping the Free Worlds,' then count me out."
units.italian: "Se 'aiutare le Free Worlds' vuol dire lavori loschi come questo, allora lasciami fuori."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|As soon as you scan the <npc> its captain hails you. "Excuse me, captain," he says, "can I assist you with something?"|373|0
units.english: As soon as you scan the <npc> its captain hails you. "Excuse me, captain," he says, "can I assist you with something?"
units.italian: Appena scansionate la <npc>, il suo capitano ti chiama. "Mi scusi, capitano," dice, "posso esserle utile in qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"I was just wondering what sort of engines you've got that let you move so fast."|375|0
units.english: "I was just wondering what sort of engines you've got that let you move so fast."
units.italian: "Mi chiedevo che tipo di motori abbiate, per muovervi così veloci."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"Never mind sir, I was just admiring your... impressive equipment."|377|0
units.english: "Never mind sir, I was just admiring your... impressive equipment."
units.italian: "Non importa, signore, stavo solo ammirando il vostro... equipaggiamento impressionante."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	"Nice, aren't they?" he says. "Atomic engines, the very latest in propulsion technology from Deep Sky. They're so smooth and responsive, I feel like I'm back piloting a shuttlecraft again."|380|0
units.english: "Nice, aren't they?" he says. "Atomic engines, the very latest in propulsion technology from Deep Sky. They're so smooth and responsive, I feel like I'm back piloting a shuttlecraft again."
units.italian: "Belli, vero?" dice. "Motori atomici, l'ultimissima tecnologia di propulsione della Deep Sky. Sono così fluidi e reattivi che mi sembra di essere tornato a pilotare una navetta."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	He pauses, then adds, "They pay me a thousand credits every time I say that."|381|0
units.english: He pauses, then adds, "They pay me a thousand credits every time I say that."
units.italian: Si ferma, poi aggiunge: "Mi pagano mille crediti ogni volta che dico questa frase."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	He looks awfully pleased with himself. "Yes, I suppose a ship like this is sure to turn a few heads. Next time we're on the same planet, stop by my berth and I'd be glad to give you a... private tour." He winks at you.|384|0
units.english: He looks awfully pleased with himself. "Yes, I suppose a ship like this is sure to turn a few heads. Next time we're on the same planet, stop by my berth and I'd be glad to give you a... private tour." He winks at you.
units.italian: Sembra terribilmente soddisfatto di sé. "Sì, immagino che una nave così farà girare qualche testa. La prossima volta che siamo sullo stesso pianeta, passa dal mio posto di attracco e sarò lieto di farti fare un... giro privato." Ti fa l'occhiolino.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|	You cut the commlink and breathe a sigh of relief that the conversation is over.|387|0
units.english: You cut the commlink and breathe a sigh of relief that the conversation is over.
units.italian: Chiudi la comunicazione e tiri un sospiro di sollievo che la conversazione sia finita.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|dialog|390|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you haven't yet scanned the Navy Cruiser patrolling the system. Depart and scan the Cruiser's outfits before returning.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non hai ancora scansionato l'incrociatore della Marina che pattuglia il sistema. Decolla e scansiona l'equipaggiamento dell'incrociatore prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|log|392|0
units.english: Scanned a Republic Cruiser as part of some reconnaissance work for the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai scansionato un incrociatore della Repubblica come parte di un lavoro di ricognizione per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 1|dialog|394|0
units.english: Soon after you land, the militia captain comes to your ship and pays you <payment> in exchange for your sensor logs regarding the <npc>. He says, "If you would be interested in continuing to work for us, meet me in the spaceport bar in an hour."
units.italian: Poco dopo che atterri, il capitano della milizia viene alla tua nave e ti paga <payment> in cambio dei registri dei sensori sulla <npc>. Dice: "Se ti interessa continuare a lavorare per noi, incontrami al bar dello spazioporto fra un'ora."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|name|399|0
units.english: Free Worlds Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|description|400|0
units.english: Scan any ships in the <waypoints> system that are equipped like the combat-ready Cruiser you scanned previously, then return to <destination>.
units.italian: Scansiona i sistemi <waypoints> cercando navi equipaggiate come l'incrociatore da combattimento che hai scansionato prima, poi torna a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|log|408|0
units.english: Turned down any further reconnaissance work from the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato ogni ulteriore lavoro di ricognizione per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|log|411|0
units.english: Turned down any further reconnaissance work from the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato ogni ulteriore lavoro di ricognizione per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|You meet up with the militia captain in the spaceport bar. "Glad you showed up," he says, "I'm Jean-Jacques, by the way, but you can call me JJ."|416|0
units.english: You meet up with the militia captain in the spaceport bar. "Glad you showed up," he says, "I'm Jean-Jacques, by the way, but you can call me JJ."
units.italian: Incontri il capitano della milizia al bar dello spazioporto. "Sono contento che ti sia presentato," dice, "io sono Jean-Jacques, comunque, ma puoi chiamarmi JJ."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|	You introduce yourself in return, and he continues. "Here's the deal. I'm the commander of the militia on Glaze. So far, we and the Navy are not shooting at each other, because no one wants to fire the first shot. But if they're getting ready to change that, they'll start refitting their Cruisers with heavy weaponry instead of surveillance equipment. So, I need to know how many more of their ships are equipped like the one you just scanned."|417|0
units.english: You introduce yourself in return, and he continues. "Here's the deal. I'm the commander of the militia on Glaze. So far, we and the Navy are not shooting at each other, because no one wants to fire the first shot. But if they're getting ready to change that, they'll start refitting their Cruisers with heavy weaponry instead of surveillance equipment. So, I need to know how many more of their ships are equipped like the one you just scanned."
units.italian: Ti presenti a tua volta, e lui continua. "Il punto è questo. Sono il comandante della milizia su Glaze. Finora noi e la Marina non ci stiamo sparando, perché nessuno vuole esplodere il primo colpo. Ma se si stanno preparando a cambiare le cose, cominceranno a riarmare i loro incrociatori con armi pesanti invece che con apparecchiature di sorveglianza. Quindi devo sapere quante altre loro navi sono equipaggiate come quella che hai appena scansionato."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|	He continues, "I'd like you to go to <waypoints>, where our reports say there's a build-up of Navy ships. Scan any ships you think match the Cruiser we just saw, then bring your scanner logs back here for me to look at."|418|0
units.english: He continues, "I'd like you to go to <waypoints>, where our reports say there's a build-up of Navy ships. Scan any ships you think match the Cruiser we just saw, then bring your scanner logs back here for me to look at."
units.italian: Continua: "Vorrei che andassi su <waypoints>, dove secondo i nostri rapporti si sta concentrando un numero crescente di navi della Marina. Scansiona le navi che pensi corrispondano all'incrociatore che abbiamo appena visto, poi porta qui i registri dei tuoi scanner perché io li guardi."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|	"Sure, I'd be glad to do that."|420|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to do that."
units.italian: "Certo, lo farò volentieri."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|	"Sorry. After the way the last captain responded to me scanning him, I'm not risking my head for the Free Worlds again."|422|0
units.english: "Sorry. After the way the last captain responded to me scanning him, I'm not risking my head for the Free Worlds again."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace. Dopo come ha reagito l'ultimo capitano a cui ho scansionato la nave, non rischio più la testa per le Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|dialog|435|0
units.english: You've scanned all the ships you can find here that seem to be upgraded for combat. Time to return to <planet> to collect your payment.
units.italian: Hai scansionato tutte le navi che riesci a trovare qui che sembrano potenziate per il combattimento. È tempo di tornare su <planet> a ritirare il pagamento.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|dialog|438|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you haven't yet scanned the Navy Cruisers patrolling Menkent. Depart and scan the Cruisers' outfits before returning.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non hai ancora scansionato gli incrociatori della Marina che pattugliano Menkent. Decolla e scansiona l'equipaggiamento degli incrociatori prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 2|dialog|441|0
units.english: JJ meets you as soon as you land, and you hand over the scanner data in exchange for <payment>. "Thank you again," he says. "If you're willing to take on one more recon mission, meet me in the bar."
units.italian: JJ ti viene incontro appena atterri, e tu gli consegni i dati degli scanner in cambio di <payment>. "Grazie ancora," dice. "Se sei disposto ad accettare un'altra missione di ricognizione, incontrami al bar."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|name|446|0
units.english: Free Worlds Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|description|447|0
units.english: Land on <destination> and secretly collect information on the developing Navy base there.
units.italian: Atterra su <destination> e raccogli di nascosto informazioni sulla base della Marina che stanno costruendo lì.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|log|455|0
units.english: Turned down any further reconnaissance work from the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato ogni ulteriore lavoro di ricognizione per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|log|458|0
units.english: Turned down any further reconnaissance work from the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato ogni ulteriore lavoro di ricognizione per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|You meet JJ again in the bar. "I have one more reconnaissance mission for you," he says. "The Navy is building a base on New Wales, adjacent to the existing spaceport. From what I understand, they're employing thousands of locals to build it, so one more worker walking around would not seem out of place. I need you to walk around the base, take notes on the number and size of the landing pads and hangars, take pictures if you can, and report back to me. What do you say?"|463|0
units.english: You meet JJ again in the bar. "I have one more reconnaissance mission for you," he says. "The Navy is building a base on New Wales, adjacent to the existing spaceport. From what I understand, they're employing thousands of locals to build it, so one more worker walking around would not seem out of place. I need you to walk around the base, take notes on the number and size of the landing pads and hangars, take pictures if you can, and report back to me. What do you say?"
units.italian: Incontri di nuovo JJ al bar. "Ho ancora una missione di ricognizione per te," dice. "La Marina sta costruendo una base su New Wales, accanto allo spazioporto esistente. Da quanto ho capito, stanno assumendo migliaia di persone del posto per costruirla, quindi un operaio in più che gira non sembrerebbe fuori luogo. Mi serve che tu cammini per la base, prenda nota del numero e delle dimensioni delle piazzole di atterraggio e degli hangar, scatti qualche foto se puoi, e poi mi riferisca. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|	"Sure, I can do that."|465|0
units.english: "Sure, I can do that."
units.italian: "Certo, posso farlo."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|	"What if they arrest me?"|467|0
units.english: "What if they arrest me?"
units.italian: "E se mi arrestano?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|	"From what I understand," says JJ, "the base is not actually closed off to civilians. So as long as you keep out of any areas that are marked off limits, you won't be committing any crime."|468|0
units.english: "From what I understand," says JJ, "the base is not actually closed off to civilians. So as long as you keep out of any areas that are marked off limits, you won't be committing any crime."
units.italian: "Da quanto ho capito," dice JJ, "la base non è davvero chiusa ai civili. Quindi, finché stai fuori dalle aree segnalate come off limits, non commetterai nessun reato."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|	"Okay, I'll do it."|470|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo farò."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|	"This is too far. I'm not trespassing on Navy property for you."|472|0
units.english: "This is too far. I'm not trespassing on Navy property for you."
units.italian: "Questo è troppo. Non mi intrufolo in una proprietà della Marina per te."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3|	"I'm really sorry to hear that," says JJ. "We had high hopes for you." He leaves the bar.|473|0
units.english: "I'm really sorry to hear that," says JJ. "We had high hopes for you." He leaves the bar.
units.italian: "Mi dispiace molto sentirlo," dice JJ. "Avevamo grandi speranze per te." Esce dal bar.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|name|479|0
units.english: Free Worlds Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|description|480|0
units.english: Return to <destination> with information on the Navy base on <origin>.
units.italian: Torna a <destination> con le informazioni sulla base della Marina su <origin>.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|log|489|0
units.english: Turned down any further reconnaissance work from the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato ogni ulteriore lavoro di ricognizione per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|You walk through the new section of the spaceport that the Navy is building, trying to look inconspicuous. When it seems that no one is watching, you snap a few photographs. You count seven hangars large enough to house a Carrier, and workers are clearing and blasting level surfaces for many more. An entire new village of identical prefabricated houses has sprung up nearby. And every few minutes, a warship flies overhead with a roar that shakes the entire mountain. It is an intimidating sight.|494|0
units.english: You walk through the new section of the spaceport that the Navy is building, trying to look inconspicuous. When it seems that no one is watching, you snap a few photographs. You count seven hangars large enough to house a Carrier, and workers are clearing and blasting level surfaces for many more. An entire new village of identical prefabricated houses has sprung up nearby. And every few minutes, a warship flies overhead with a roar that shakes the entire mountain. It is an intimidating sight.
units.italian: Attraversi la nuova sezione dello spazioporto che la Marina sta costruendo, cercando di sembrare uno dei tanti. Quando ti pare che nessuno ti stia guardando, scatti qualche fotografia. Conti sette hangar abbastanza grandi da ospitare una Carrier, e gli operai stanno livellando e facendo brillare superfici piane per molti altri. Lì vicino è spuntato un intero villaggio nuovo di case prefabbricate tutte uguali. E ogni pochi minuti una nave da guerra passa sopra la testa con un rombo che fa tremare tutta la montagna. È una vista che intimorisce.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	As you are heading back to your ship after taking note of everything you think JJ would be interested in, two officers walk past you and you overhear one saying to the other, "Secret message from fleet command."|495|0
units.english: As you are heading back to your ship after taking note of everything you think JJ would be interested in, two officers walk past you and you overhear one saying to the other, "Secret message from fleet command."
units.italian: Mentre torni alla tua nave dopo aver preso nota di tutto ciò che pensi possa interessare a JJ, due ufficiali ti passano accanto e senti uno dei due dire all'altro: "Messaggio segreto dal comando della flotta."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	You stop to tie your shoe and try to listen in. "What's the message?" asks the other.|496|0
units.english: You stop to tie your shoe and try to listen in. "What's the message?" asks the other.
units.italian: Ti fermi a legarti una scarpa e provi ad ascoltare. "Qual è il messaggio?" chiede l'altro.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"I can't tell you here," says the first, and they duck behind one of the storage sheds.|497|0
units.english: "I can't tell you here," says the first, and they duck behind one of the storage sheds.
units.italian: "Non posso dirtelo qui," dice il primo, e si infilano dietro uno dei capannoni.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	(Ignore them and return to my ship.)|499|0
units.english: (Ignore them and return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Ignorali e torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	(Follow them and listen in.)|501|0
units.english: (Follow them and listen in.)
units.italian: (Seguili e ascolta.)

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	You follow the officers into a supply yard and hide behind a large stack of crates. "Lieutenant," says one of them, "we just received word that the Free Worlds have contracted with someone to spy on this facility."|505|0
units.english: You follow the officers into a supply yard and hide behind a large stack of crates. "Lieutenant," says one of them, "we just received word that the Free Worlds have contracted with someone to spy on this facility."
units.italian: Segui gli ufficiali in un deposito di rifornimenti e ti nascondi dietro una grande pila di casse. "Tenente," dice uno dei due, "ci è appena arrivata voce che le Free Worlds hanno ingaggiato qualcuno per spiare questa struttura."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"A professional, sir?"|506|0
units.english: "A professional, sir?"
units.italian: "Un professionista, signore?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Hardly. My grandmother would make a better spy. It's a merchant captain, clearly an amateur." They are both speaking quite loudly; you are having no trouble listening in.|507|0
units.english: "Hardly. My grandmother would make a better spy. It's a merchant captain, clearly an amateur." They are both speaking quite loudly; you are having no trouble listening in.
units.italian: "Macché. Mia nonna sarebbe una spia migliore. È un capitano mercantile, chiaramente un dilettante." Parlano entrambi piuttosto forte; non hai alcuna difficoltà ad ascoltare.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"What are we going to do, sir?" asks the lieutenant.|508|0
units.english: "What are we going to do, sir?" asks the lieutenant.
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo, signore?" chiede il tenente.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Nothing. If gawking at our ships were a crime, we'd have half the local population in prison by now. But if this captain should accept any further assignments, we may have to take action."|509|0
units.english: "Nothing. If gawking at our ships were a crime, we'd have half the local population in prison by now. But if this captain should accept any further assignments, we may have to take action."
units.italian: "Niente. Se sbirciare le nostre navi fosse un reato, a quest'ora avremmo metà della popolazione locale in prigione. Ma se questo capitano accettasse altri incarichi, potremmo dover intervenire."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Should we at least inform this individual that those crates make terrible cover?" asks the lieutenant, grinning.|510|0
units.english: "Should we at least inform this individual that those crates make terrible cover?" asks the lieutenant, grinning.
units.italian: "Dovremmo almeno informare questo individuo che quelle casse sono un nascondiglio pessimo?" chiede il tenente, sogghignando.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Now, now," says the other officer, "no need to be spiteful." They walk off, leaving you thoroughly embarrassed.|511|0
units.english: "Now, now," says the other officer, "no need to be spiteful." They walk off, leaving you thoroughly embarrassed.
units.italian: "Su, su," dice l'altro ufficiale, "non c'è bisogno di essere dispettosi." Se ne vanno, lasciandoti profondamente imbarazzato.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|dialog|524|0
units.english: A minute after you land, a Republic Gunboat, the <npc>, lands directly next to you. JJ does not approach you. You notice from your ship's logs that this Gunboat has been following you ever since you left <origin>; before you can hand over the information, you will need to escape its pursuit.
units.italian: Un minuto dopo che atterri, una cannoniera della Repubblica, la <npc>, atterra proprio accanto a te. JJ non ti si avvicina. Dai registri della nave noti che questa cannoniera ti segue da quando hai lasciato <origin>; prima di poter consegnare le informazioni, dovrai sfuggire al suo inseguimento.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|log|528|0
units.english: Gave the Free Worlds some photos and information on the Navy base on New Wales. Jean-Jacques, the militia contact, was very grateful for the help.
units.italian: Hai dato alle Free Worlds alcune foto e informazioni sulla base della Marina a New Wales. Jean-Jacques, il contatto della milizia, è stato molto grato per l'aiuto.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|JJ meets you as soon as you land. "Good job evading that Navy Gunboat," he says.|530|0
units.english: JJ meets you as soon as you land. "Good job evading that Navy Gunboat," he says.
units.italian: JJ ti viene incontro appena atterri. "Bel lavoro, a seminare quella cannoniera della Marina," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Gunboat? What Gunboat?"|537|0
units.english: "Gunboat? What Gunboat?"
units.italian: "Cannoniera? Quale cannoniera?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"I knew I had a feeling that I was being followed."|538|0
units.english: "I knew I had a feeling that I was being followed."
units.italian: "Sapevo di avere la sensazione di essere seguito."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"You didn't notice? I have scouts that report that you were being followed by a Gunboat by the name of the <npc> ever since you left <origin>. Keeping an eye on where you were going, no doubt.|540|0
units.english: "You didn't notice? I have scouts that report that you were being followed by a Gunboat by the name of the <npc> ever since you left <origin>. Keeping an eye on where you were going, no doubt.
units.italian: "Non te ne sei accorto? Ho esploratori che mi riferiscono che eri seguito da una cannoniera di nome <npc> da quando hai lasciato <origin>. Tenevano d'occhio dove andavi, senza dubbio.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"They knew I was gathering information on the base. It's no wonder they had someone following me."|545|0
units.english: "They knew I was gathering information on the base. It's no wonder they had someone following me."
units.italian: "Sapevano che stavo raccogliendo informazioni sulla base. Non c'è da stupirsi che avessero qualcuno che mi seguisse."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"How did they know I was involved with you?"|547|0
units.english: "How did they know I was involved with you?"
units.italian: "Come facevano a sapere che avevo a che fare con voi?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"I knew I had a feeling that I was being followed."|552|0
units.english: "I knew I had a feeling that I was being followed."
units.italian: "Sapevo di avere la sensazione di essere seguito."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"How did they know I was involved with you?"|553|0
units.english: "How did they know I was involved with you?"
units.italian: "Come facevano a sapere che avevo a che fare con voi?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"The Republic's intelligence gathering capabilities are vast, far beyond anything we can muster. I can only guess how they knew you were involved and kept an eye on you."|556|0
units.english: "The Republic's intelligence gathering capabilities are vast, far beyond anything we can muster. I can only guess how they knew you were involved and kept an eye on you."
units.italian: "Le capacità di raccolta informazioni della Repubblica sono vaste, molto oltre qualsiasi cosa possiamo mettere insieme noi. Posso solo immaginare come abbiano saputo che eri coinvolto e ti abbiano tenuto d'occhio."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"What should I do now that the Republic is watching me?"|558|0
units.english: "What should I do now that the Republic is watching me?"
units.italian: "Che cosa devo fare adesso che la Repubblica mi tiene d'occhio?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Knowing that, how can you possibly expect to stand up against the Republic?"|559|0
units.english: "Knowing that, how can you possibly expect to stand up against the Republic?"
units.italian: "Sapendo questo, come puoi pensare di opporti alla Repubblica?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Keep your head low. You're compromised, so I can't ask you to do any more recon work for us. So long as you don't cause them any trouble, they'll likely eventually leave you alone. We have a great number of merchants helping us, and as capable as the Republic is, they can only keep a close eye on so many people at a time."|561|0
units.english: "Keep your head low. You're compromised, so I can't ask you to do any more recon work for us. So long as you don't cause them any trouble, they'll likely eventually leave you alone. We have a great number of merchants helping us, and as capable as the Republic is, they can only keep a close eye on so many people at a time."
units.italian: "Tieni la testa bassa. Sei compromesso, quindi non posso chiederti altro lavoro di ricognizione. Finché non gli causi problemi, probabilmente prima o poi ti lasceranno in pace. Abbiamo un gran numero di mercanti che ci aiutano, e per quanto la Repubblica sia capace, può tenere d'occhio solo un certo numero di persone alla volta."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"I pray that we don't have to," JJ responds. "We're currently attempting to prove our innocence for the bombings on Geminus and Martini. But should it come to war, if we get continued help from merchants such as yourself, then, God willing, we might just stand a chance. While the Republic may be strong, they're not omnipotent."|565|0
units.english: "I pray that we don't have to," JJ responds. "We're currently attempting to prove our innocence for the bombings on Geminus and Martini. But should it come to war, if we get continued help from merchants such as yourself, then, God willing, we might just stand a chance. While the Republic may be strong, they're not omnipotent."
units.italian: "Prego che non dobbiamo farlo," risponde JJ. "Al momento stiamo cercando di dimostrare la nostra innocenza per gli attentati su Geminus e Martini. Ma se si arrivasse alla guerra, se continueremo ad avere l'aiuto di mercanti come te, allora, se Dio vuole, potremmo anche avere qualche possibilità. La Repubblica sarà pure forte, ma non è onnipotente."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	JJ takes the information and photos you gathered and pays you <payment> in return. "I'll be sure to let the rest of the Free Worlds Council know how helpful you have been."|568|0
units.english: JJ takes the information and photos you gathered and pays you <payment> in return. "I'll be sure to let the rest of the Free Worlds Council know how helpful you have been."
units.italian: JJ prende le informazioni e le foto che hai raccolto e ti paga <payment> in cambio. "Mi assicurerò di far sapere al resto del Consiglio delle Free Worlds quanto sei stato utile."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Thank you."|570|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"What are you going to do with this information?"|572|0
units.english: "What are you going to do with this information?"
units.italian: "Che cosa farete con queste informazioni?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Free Worlds Council? What's that?"|573|0
units.english: "Free Worlds Council? What's that?"
units.italian: "Consiglio delle Free Worlds? Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Full of questions, aren't we?" JJ chuckles. "We will not attack this naval base, so you don't need to worry about anyone being hurt by your actions today. But should the Free Worlds and the Republic go to war, information will be a vital resource, including the information that you've provided me, so thank you for that.|576|0
units.english: "Full of questions, aren't we?" JJ chuckles. "We will not attack this naval base, so you don't need to worry about anyone being hurt by your actions today. But should the Free Worlds and the Republic go to war, information will be a vital resource, including the information that you've provided me, so thank you for that.
units.italian: "Quante domande, eh?" JJ ridacchia. "Non attaccheremo questa base navale, quindi non devi preoccuparti che qualcuno si faccia male per quello che hai fatto oggi. Ma se le Free Worlds e la Repubblica dovessero entrare in guerra, le informazioni saranno una risorsa vitale, comprese quelle che mi hai fornito, quindi grazie.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Full of questions, aren't we?" JJ chuckles. "The Council is a collection of leaders born out of what used to be the Southern Mutual Defense Pact. It includes myself and a few others. We are currently responsible for commanding the militias of the Free Worlds, and should it come to it, we will be the commanding officers in a war with the Republic.|580|0
units.english: "Full of questions, aren't we?" JJ chuckles. "The Council is a collection of leaders born out of what used to be the Southern Mutual Defense Pact. It includes myself and a few others. We are currently responsible for commanding the militias of the Free Worlds, and should it come to it, we will be the commanding officers in a war with the Republic.
units.italian: "Quante domande, eh?" JJ ridacchia. "Il Consiglio è un insieme di leader nati da quello che una volta era il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud. Ne faccio parte anch'io insieme a qualche altro. Al momento siamo responsabili del comando delle milizie delle Free Worlds e, se dovesse servire, saremo noi gli ufficiali al comando in una guerra contro la Repubblica.

units.id: mission:FW Recon 3B|	"Now if you'll excuse me, Captain, I have other work to attend to," JJ says. "If you wish to continue helping us, I'm sure there are others who could call upon you if you go looking for them."|584|0
units.english: "Now if you'll excuse me, Captain, I have other work to attend to," JJ says. "If you wish to continue helping us, I'm sure there are others who could call upon you if you go looking for them."
units.italian: "Ora, se vuoi scusarmi, Capitano, ho altro lavoro da sbrigare," dice JJ. "Se desideri continuare ad aiutarci, sono sicuro che ci sono altri che potrebbero chiamarti, se vai a cercarli."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|name|592|0
units.english: Free Worlds Escort
units.italian: Scorta per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|description|593|0
units.english: Head to <destination> to meet up with a convoy of Free Worlds freighters.
units.italian: Dirigiti verso <destination> per incontrarti con un convoglio di mercantili delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|log|607|0
units.english: Declined an offer for escort work from Tomek Voigt, commanding officer of the Free Worlds militia.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato un'offerta di lavoro come scorta da parte di Tomek Voigt, ufficiale al comando della milizia delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|As you are walking through the spaceport, a man in a militia uniform approaches you. Judging by the markings on his uniform, you suspect that he is very highly ranked within the militia.|611|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, a man in a militia uniform approaches you. Judging by the markings on his uniform, you suspect that he is very highly ranked within the militia.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, ti si avvicina un uomo in uniforme della milizia. A giudicare dai segni sull'uniforme, sospetti che abbia un grado molto alto nella milizia.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"Captain <last>?" he asks. You nod. "Glad to finally meet you. I'm Tomek Voigt, commanding officer of the Free militias. I have officers and friends who have spoken very highly of you. They tell me that you've gone to great lengths to help us. I thank you for that."|612|0
units.english: "Captain <last>?" he asks. You nod. "Glad to finally meet you. I'm Tomek Voigt, commanding officer of the Free militias. I have officers and friends who have spoken very highly of you. They tell me that you've gone to great lengths to help us. I thank you for that."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>?" chiede. Annuisci. "Sono contento di incontrarti finalmente. Sono Tomek Voigt, ufficiale al comando delle milizie libere. Ho ufficiali e amici che hanno parlato molto bene di te. Mi dicono che ti sei dato molto da fare per aiutarci. Te ne sono grato."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"Oh, it was nothing. Just helping people out where I can."|614|0
units.english: "Oh, it was nothing. Just helping people out where I can."
units.italian: "Oh, non è stato niente. Aiuto la gente dove posso."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"I've gone to great lengths because I believe you have a great cause."|616|0
units.english: "I've gone to great lengths because I believe you have a great cause."
units.italian: "Mi sono dato da fare perché credo che la vostra sia una grande causa."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"I'm just looking to get paid, and the Free Worlds pays well."|618|0
units.english: "I'm just looking to get paid, and the Free Worlds pays well."
units.italian: "Voglio solo essere pagato, e le Free Worlds pagano bene."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	Tomek raises an eyebrow. "A no nonsense captain, I see. Well if it's pay you're looking for, I have another job for you on behalf of the Free Worlds.|619|0
units.english: Tomek raises an eyebrow. "A no nonsense captain, I see. Well if it's pay you're looking for, I have another job for you on behalf of the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Tomek alza un sopracciglio. "Un capitano che non le manda a dire, vedo. Beh, se quello che cerchi è la paga, ho un altro lavoro per te a nome delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	Tomek smiles. "A humble captain, I see. Well, if you're just looking to help people out, I have another job for you on behalf of the Free Worlds.|622|0
units.english: Tomek smiles. "A humble captain, I see. Well, if you're just looking to help people out, I have another job for you on behalf of the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Tomek sorride. "Un capitano modesto, vedo. Beh, se quello che cerchi è solo aiutare la gente, ho un altro lavoro per te a nome delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	Tomek grins. "Ah, a fellow freedom fighter. Always glad to see more captains earnestly joining the cause. I have another job for you on behalf of the Free Worlds.|625|0
units.english: Tomek grins. "Ah, a fellow freedom fighter. Always glad to see more captains earnestly joining the cause. I have another job for you on behalf of the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Tomek sogghigna. "Ah, un compagno combattente per la libertà. Sono sempre contento di vedere altri capitani che si uniscono sul serio alla causa. Ho un altro lavoro per te a nome delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"We're looking for ships to help escort a freighter convoy that is traveling to Tarazed to pick up supplies. Our last few convoys have been attacked by pirates, and we suspect this one will be as well. We already have a few captains on the job, but we could always use more help. Are you interested?"|627|0
units.english: "We're looking for ships to help escort a freighter convoy that is traveling to Tarazed to pick up supplies. Our last few convoys have been attacked by pirates, and we suspect this one will be as well. We already have a few captains on the job, but we could always use more help. Are you interested?"
units.italian: "Cerchiamo navi che aiutino a scortare un convoglio di mercantili diretto a Tarazed per caricare rifornimenti. Gli ultimi convogli sono stati attaccati dai pirati, e sospettiamo che lo sarà anche questo. Abbiamo già alcuni capitani sul lavoro, ma un aiuto in più fa sempre comodo. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"Sure, I'd be glad to assist in the escort."|629|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to assist in the escort."
units.italian: "Certo, sarò lieto di dare una mano nella scorta."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"What sort of supplies?"|631|0
units.english: "What sort of supplies?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di rifornimenti?"

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"Sorry, but that's not the type of work I'm looking for."|632|0
units.english: "Sorry, but that's not the type of work I'm looking for."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non è il tipo di lavoro che cerco."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"Outfits, weapons, and other miscellaneous materials needed for the manufacturing of new ships. The Free Worlds are looking to bolster its forces, and we're already using as much of our local industry as we can, so we've begun importing materials from companies that aren't concerned with dealing with what the Republic labels a 'terrorist organization,'" Tomek says with a smirk.|635|0
units.english: "Outfits, weapons, and other miscellaneous materials needed for the manufacturing of new ships.
