The Free Worlds are looking to bolster its forces, and we're already using as much of our local industry as we can, so we've begun importing materials from companies that aren't concerned with dealing with what the Republic labels a 'terrorist organization,'" Tomek says with a smirk.
units.italian: "Equipaggiamento, armi e altri materiali vari necessari per costruire nuove navi. Le Free Worlds vogliono rafforzare le proprie forze, e stiamo già sfruttando al massimo la nostra industria locale, quindi abbiamo cominciato a importare materiali da aziende che non si preoccupano di trattare con quella che la Repubblica definisce un'organizzazione terroristica," dice Tomek con un sorriso beffardo.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"Well, then I'd be glad to help."|637|0
units.english: "Well, then I'd be glad to help."
units.italian: "Beh, allora sarò lieto di aiutare."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"Sorry, but that's not the type of work I'm looking for."|638|0
units.english: "Sorry, but that's not the type of work I'm looking for."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non è il tipo di lavoro che cerco."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 0|	"Great!" he says. "The convoy will start from <destination> once all the escorts have arrived. I suggest you head there immediately."|642|0

units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice. "Il convoglio partirà da <destination> appena tutte le scorte saranno arrivate. Ti consiglio di andarci subito."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 1|You meet up with the convoy on <origin> in the spaceport: six freighters with an escort of... seven interceptors. Given how prevalent piracy is in this region and how strong some pirate fleets can be, you would have expected a larger escort, but it seems that this is all the Free Worlds are capable of mustering at the moment. It's no wonder they're asking merchant captains such as yourself to lend a hand.|724|0
units.english: You meet up with the convoy on <origin> in the spaceport: six freighters with an escort of... seven interceptors. Given how prevalent piracy is in this region and how strong some pirate fleets can be, you would have expected a larger escort, but it seems that this is all the Free Worlds are capable of mustering at the moment. It's no wonder they're asking merchant captains such as yourself to lend a hand.
units.italian: Ti incontri con il convoglio su <origin>, nello spazioporto: sei mercantili con una scorta di... sette intercettori. Visto quanto è diffusa la pirateria in questa regione e quanto possono essere forti alcune flotte pirata, ti saresti aspettato una scorta più numerosa, ma sembra che al momento le Free Worlds non riescano a mettere insieme altro. Non c'è da stupirsi che chiedano una mano a capitani mercantili come te.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 1|	Shortly after you arrive, the convoy is ready to go and charts a course for <destination>.|725|0
units.english: Shortly after you arrive, the convoy is ready to go and charts a course for <destination>.
units.italian: Poco dopo il tuo arrivo, il convoglio è pronto a partire e traccia una rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 1|log|729|0
units.english: Serving as an escort for a Free Worlds supply convoy to Tarazed. It sounds like pirates have been specifically targeting their convoys recently, and the Free Worlds don't have many ships to spare defending them.
units.italian: Stai facendo da scorta a un convoglio di rifornimenti delle Free Worlds diretto a Tarazed. Pare che ultimamente i pirati stiano prendendo di mira proprio i loro convogli, e le Free Worlds non hanno molte navi da spendere per difenderli.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 1|log|761|0
units.english: Aborted some escort work from the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai interrotto un lavoro di scorta per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 1|dialog|768|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of the convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 1B|Your convoy of freighters reaches <origin> intact, despite numerous encounters with pirates. The escort of interceptors was just enough to hold them off. units.english: Your convoy of freighters reaches <origin> intact, despite numerous encounters with pirates. The escort of interceptors was just enough to hold them off. The merchant captains sell their trade goods and stock up with weapons and ship outfits that will be used to build new ships for the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Il tuo convoglio di mercantili raggiunge <origin> intatto, nonostante i numerosi incontri con i pirati. La scorta di intercettori è bastata appena a respingerli. I capitani mercantili vendono le loro merci e si riforniscono di armi e equipaggiamenti che serviranno a costruire nuove navi per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 1B|	Before you leave, a Free Worlds militia officer who you didn't arrive with approaches you, saying that he's finished doing business with the Tarazed Corporation and will join the convoy back to <planet>. The officer is commanding a Falcon, a much more formidable warship than your group of interceptors. Which is good, since, now that the freighters are carrying much more valuable cargo, the pirate attacks are likely to get even worse...|787|0
units.english: Before you leave, a Free Worlds militia officer who you didn't arrive with approaches you, saying that he's finished doing business with the Tarazed Corporation and will join the convoy back to <planet>. The officer is commanding a Falcon, a much more formidable warship than your group of interceptors. Which is good, since, now that the freighters are carrying much more valuable cargo, the pirate attacks are likely to get even worse...
units.italian: Prima che tu parta, ti si avvicina un ufficiale della milizia delle Free Worlds che non era arrivato con te: dice che ha finito i suoi affari con la Tarazed Corporation e che si unirà al convoglio per tornare su <planet>. L'ufficiale comanda un Falcon, una nave da guerra molto più temibile del tuo gruppo di intercettori. Il che è un bene, visto che, ora che i mercantili trasportano un carico molto più prezioso, è probabile che gli attacchi dei pirati peggiorino ancora...

units.id: mission:FW Escort 2|Tomek is waiting in <origin>'s spaceport to receive the freighters. units.english: Tomek is waiting in <origin>'s spaceport to receive the freighters. After double-checking that the cargo is all intact, he turns to you and the rest of the escort captains and says, "All of you have done a great service for the Free Worlds." He walks over and personally presents a credit chip to each captain.
units.italian: Tomek aspetta nello spazioporto di <origin> per ricevere i mercantili. Dopo aver ricontrollato che il carico sia intatto, si volta verso di te e gli altri capitani della scorta e dice: "Tutti voi avete reso un grande servizio alle Free Worlds." Passa accanto a ciascun capitano e gli consegna personalmente un chip di credito.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 2|	After handing over your payment, Tomek announces, "The convoy is heading back to <planet> immediately. Same deal as before: 400,000 credits for the safe return of the freighters, their crew, and their cargo. And I swear your courage will never be forgotten by the Council or the Free Worlds. If you're willing to volunteer a second time, please stay here."|850|0
units.english: After handing over your payment, Tomek announces, "The convoy is heading back to <planet> immediately. Same deal as before: 400,000 credits for the safe return of the freighters, their crew, and their cargo. And I swear your courage will never be forgotten by the Council or the Free Worlds. If you're willing to volunteer a second time, please stay here."
units.italian: Dopo aver consegnato il tuo pagamento, Tomek annuncia: "Il convoglio riparte subito per <planet>. Stesse condizioni di prima: 400.000 crediti per il ritorno sicuro dei mercantili, del loro equipaggio e del loro carico. E giuro che il vostro coraggio non sarà mai dimenticato dal Consiglio né dalle Free Worlds. Se siete disposti a offrirvi una seconda volta, restate qui."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 2|	Tomek leaves, presumably to gather replacements for the captains who have already run off.|851|0
units.english: Tomek leaves, presumably to gather replacements for the captains who have already run off.
units.italian: Tomek se ne va, presumibilmente a cercare sostituti per i capitani che sono già scappati.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 2|	You stick around with a few of the other escort pilots and watch as most of the others wander away. Soon Tomek returns, luckily with some new faces in tow. units.english: You stick around with a few of the other escort pilots and watch as most of the others wander away. Soon Tomek returns, luckily with some new faces in tow. "You know the drill," he says. "We can't afford to lose any of these freighters. Good luck to all of you, and I pray to see you all safely back here in a couple of weeks."
units.italian: Resti lì con alcuni degli altri piloti della scorta e guardi la maggior parte degli altri allontanarsi. Presto Tomek torna, per fortuna con qualche faccia nuova al seguito. "Sapete come funziona," dice. "Non possiamo permetterci di perdere nessuno di questi mercantili. Buona fortuna a tutti voi, e prego di rivedervi tutti qui sani e salvi fra un paio di settimane."

units.italian: Ancora una volta il convoglio si rifornisce di armi ed equipaggiamenti e comincia a prepararsi per il viaggio di ritorno. Ma questa volta, purtroppo, non c'è nessun ufficiale della milizia con una nave da guerra a rinforzarvi. Non puoi fare a meno di preoccuparti che, più questi convogli continuano, più pirati scopriranno la loro rotta e cominceranno a tendere imboscate.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|description|967|0
units.english: Repair the <npc>, which is stranded in the <waypoints> system, and escort it safely back to <destination>.
units.italian: Ripara la <npc>, rimasta in avaria nel sistema <waypoints>, e scortala sana e salva fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|Once again, Tomek Voigt meets you and the rest of the convoy at the spaceport, thanks you all for your courage and dedication, and pays you each 400,000 credits. Afterwards, he pulls you aside and says, "Captain <last>, please follow me."|977|0
units.english: Once again, Tomek Voigt meets you and the rest of the convoy at the spaceport, thanks you all for your courage and dedication, and pays you each 400,000 credits. Afterwards, he pulls you aside and says, "Captain <last>, please follow me."
units.italian: Ancora una volta Tomek Voigt ti incontra insieme al resto del convoglio allo spazioporto, ringrazia tutti per il coraggio e la dedizione e paga a ciascuno 400.000 crediti. Poi ti prende da parte e dice: "Capitano <last>, mi segua, per favore."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	Tomek brings you to one of the spaceport bars, exchanging greetings with the patrons before sitting at the counter. "Here's the deal," he says. "One of our freighters, the <npc>, was just disabled in the <waypoints> system. We need you to fly there immediately, repair it, and bring it back here before it can be captured by pirates. Do you think you're up to the task?"|978|0
units.english: Tomek brings you to one of the spaceport bars, exchanging greetings with the patrons before sitting at the counter. "Here's the deal," he says. "One of our freighters, the <npc>, was just disabled in the <waypoints> system. We need you to fly there immediately, repair it, and bring it back here before it can be captured by pirates. Do you think you're up to the task?"
units.italian: Tomek ti porta in uno dei bar dello spazioporto, scambia saluti con gli avventori e si siede al bancone. "Il punto è questo," dice. "Uno dei nostri mercantili, la <npc>, è appena stato messo fuori uso nel sistema <waypoints>. Dobbiamo che tu voli subito là, lo ripari e lo riporti qui prima che i pirati possano catturarlo. Te la senti di farlo?"

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"Sure!"|980|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Certo!"

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"Sorry, no. I'm a merchant captain with bills to pay. I'm not going to go search for your missing ships in the middle of nowhere."|981|0
units.english: "Sorry, no. I'm a merchant captain with bills to pay. I'm not going to go search for your missing ships in the middle of nowhere."
units.italian: "No, mi dispiace. Sono un capitano mercantile con delle bollette da pagare. Non vado a cercare le vostre navi disperse in mezzo al nulla."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"Glad to hear it," he says. "The crew of that freighter is depending on you. I know I don't have to tell you what will happen to them if pirates board them before you get there, so get moving quickly."|984|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it," he says. "The crew of that freighter is depending on you. I know I don't have to tell you what will happen to them if pirates board them before you get there, so get moving quickly."
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirlo," dice. "L'equipaggio di quel mercantile conta su di te. So che non devo dirti che cosa succederà se i pirati li abbordano prima che tu arrivi, quindi muoviti in fretta."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|log|996|0

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|dialog|1003|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but the <npc> is not with you. If you have not repaired it yet, travel to <waypoints> to do so, or take off wait for it to arrive in this system if you already have.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma la <npc> non è con te. Se non l'hai ancora riparata, vai su <waypoints> a farlo, oppure decolla e aspetta che arrivi in questo sistema se ce l'hai già fatta.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|log|1007|0
units.english: Helped rescue a Free Worlds freighter that had been disabled by pirates. Earned the gratitude of Tomek Voigt, the Council member in charge of the supply convoys.
units.italian: Hai aiutato a salvare un mercantile delle Free Worlds messo fuori uso dai pirati. Ti sei guadagnato la gratitudine di Tomek Voigt, il membro del Consiglio responsabile dei convogli di rifornimento.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|Tomek is immensely relieved to see the <npc> returned safely home. "You have done us a great service today, Captain," he says, as he hands you credit chips for <payment>. "I'll be sure to let the rest of the Council know how helpful you have been, and I pray we can call on you in the future."|1009|0
units.english: Tomek is immensely relieved to see the <npc> returned safely home. "You have done us a great service today, Captain," he says, as he hands you credit chips for <payment>. "I'll be sure to let the rest of the Council know how helpful you have been, and I pray we can call on you in the future."
units.italian: Tomek è immensamente sollevato nel vedere la <npc> tornata a casa sana e salva. "Oggi ci hai reso un grande servizio, Capitano," dice, porgendoti i chip di credito per <payment>. "Mi assicurerò di far sapere al resto del Consiglio quanto sei stato utile, e prego che possiamo chiamarti in futuro."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"I'll be ready to answer the call whenever it comes."|1011|0
units.english: "I'll be ready to answer the call whenever it comes."
units.italian: "Sarò pronto a rispondere alla chiamata, quando arriverà."

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"What exactly is the Council?"|1013|0
units.english: "What exactly is the Council?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è esattamente il Consiglio?"

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	Tomek pauses to think for a moment. "Before there was the Free Worlds, there was the Southern Mutual Defense Pact, little more than a defense agreement between the worlds that now comprise the Free Worlds. Any group needs leadership, and the Council is what was once the leadership of the Pact.|1015|0
units.english: Tomek pauses to think for a moment. "Before there was the Free Worlds, there was the Southern Mutual Defense Pact, little more than a defense agreement between the worlds that now comprise the Free Worlds. Any group needs leadership, and the Council is what was once the leadership of the Pact.
units.italian: Tomek si ferma a riflettere un momento. "Prima delle Free Worlds c'era il Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud, poco più di un accordo di difesa fra i mondi che ora formano le Free Worlds. Ogni gruppo ha bisogno di una guida, e il Consiglio è quello che un tempo era la guida del Patto.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"We've retained all our powers that we held under the Pact, being the organizers and commanding officers of the various militias of the Free Worlds. With the Free Worlds having declared itself as a formal government and with tensions with the Republic so high, however, the militias are now obligated to answer to the Council as an emergency power, as opposed to the prior agreement where worlds could refuse to answer to the Pact if, for whatever reason, they chose not to.|1016|0
units.english: "We've retained all our powers that we held under the Pact, being the organizers and commanding officers of the various militias of the Free Worlds. With the Free Worlds having declared itself as a formal government and with tensions with the Republic so high, however, the militias are now obligated to answer to the Council as an emergency power, as opposed to the prior agreement where worlds could refuse to answer to the Pact if, for whatever reason, they chose not to.
units.italian: "Abbiamo conservato tutti i poteri che avevamo sotto il Patto, essendo gli organizzatori e gli ufficiali al comando delle varie milizie delle Free Worlds. Ma ora che le Free Worlds si sono dichiarate un governo formale e che le tensioni con la Repubblica sono così alte, le milizie sono obbligate a rispondere al Consiglio come autorità di emergenza, al contrario dell'accordo precedente in cui i mondi potevano rifiutarsi di rispondere al Patto, se per qualsiasi ragione sceglievano di non farlo.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"But the Council is only a transitional organization; upon the establishment of the Free Worlds Senate, which is already in the works, the Council will be dissolved and all its responsibilities moved to the Senate.|1017|0
units.english: "But the Council is only a transitional organization; upon the establishment of the Free Worlds Senate, which is already in the works, the Council will be dissolved and all its responsibilities moved to the Senate.
units.italian: "Ma il Consiglio è solo un'organizzazione di transizione; con l'istituzione del Senato delle Free Worlds, che è già in preparazione, il Consiglio sarà sciolto e tutte le sue responsabilità passeranno al Senato.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"Does that answer your question?" Tomek asks.|1018|0
units.english: "Does that answer your question?" Tomek asks.
units.italian: "Questo risponde alla tua domanda?" chiede Tomek.

units.id: mission:FW Escort 3|	"It does," you say. "Thank you."|1019|0
units.english: "It does," you say. "Thank you."
units.italian: "Sì, questo risponde," dici. "Grazie."

units.italian: Seconda possibilità

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|description|1026|0
units.english: Return to <destination> to meet up with Tomek Voigt and see if he will forgive you for failing the escort mission he gave you.
units.italian: Torna a <destination> per incontrare Tomek Voigt e vedere se ti perdonerà per aver fallito la missione di scorta che ti aveva affidato.

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|Soon after you exit your ship a man approaches you. "Captain <last>?" he asks. You nod. "My name is Alondo," he says. "I'm a member of the Free Worlds Council. Katya speaks so highly of you that I would like to see you officially join us as a part of the Free Worlds militia, even though you messed up that escort mission that was given to you."|1041|0
units.english: Soon after you exit your ship a man approaches you. "Captain <last>?" he asks. You nod. "My name is Alondo," he says. "I'm a member of the Free Worlds Council. Katya speaks so highly of you that I would like to see you officially join us as a part of the Free Worlds militia, even though you messed up that escort mission that was given to you."
units.italian: Poco dopo che esci dalla nave ti si avvicina un uomo. "Capitano <last>?" chiede. Annuisci. "Mi chiamo Alondo," dice. "Sono un membro del Consiglio delle Free Worlds. Katya parla così bene di te che vorrei vederti entrare ufficialmente nella milizia delle Free Worlds, anche se hai fatto un pasticcio con quella missione di scorta che ti era stata affidata."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"Yes, I'm very sorry about that."|1043|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm very sorry about that."
units.italian: "Sì, me ne dispiace molto."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"Sorry, but I decided I don't want to assist the Free Worlds anyway."|1044|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I decided I don't want to assist the Free Worlds anyway."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma ho deciso che non voglio comunque aiutare le Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"I'm sure," he says, "but I'm not the one you need to say that to. Right now Tomek is refusing to let us offer you a job, but if you speak with him in person, he might change his mind. Or he might not. But if you really want to work for us, you should visit him on <planet>, take full responsibility for what happened, and apologize. Just a suggestion." He walks off.|1047|0
units.english: "I'm sure," he says, "but I'm not the one you need to say that to. Right now Tomek is refusing to let us offer you a job, but if you speak with him in person, he might change his mind. Or he might not. But if you really want to work for us, you should visit him on <planet>, take full responsibility for what happened, and apologize. Just a suggestion." He walks off.
units.italian: "Ne sono sicuro," dice, "ma non sono io quello a cui devi dirlo. Al momento Tomek rifiuta di lasciarci offrirti un incarico, ma se parli con lui di persona potrebbe cambiare idea. O potrebbe non cambiarla. Ma se vuoi davvero lavorare per noi, dovresti andare a trovarlo su <planet>, prenderti la piena responsabilità di quello che è successo e scusarti. È solo un suggerimento." Si allontana.

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|log|1051|0
units.english: Refused an offer to talk with Tomek Voigt about my failed escort mission.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato un colloquio con Tomek Voigt sulla missione di scorta fallita.

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|log|1053|0
units.english: Refused an offer to talk with Tomek Voigt about my failed escort mission.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato un colloquio con Tomek Voigt sulla missione di scorta fallita.

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|Nervously, you contact Tomek and ask if he would be willing to meet with you. After a long pause, he says, "Okay. Meet me at the cantina in fifteen minutes." You wait for about twenty minutes before he finally shows up and says, without preamble, "Now, what do you have to say for yourself?"|1057|0
units.english: Nervously, you contact Tomek and ask if he would be willing to meet with you. After a long pause, he says, "Okay. Meet me at the cantina in fifteen minutes." You wait for about twenty minutes before he finally shows up and says, without preamble, "Now, what do you have to say for yourself?"
units.italian: Con una certa apprensione, contatti Tomek e gli chiedi se sarebbe disposto a incontrarti. Dopo una lunga pausa dice: "Va bene. Ci vediamo alla cantina fra quindici minuti." Aspetti una ventina di minuti prima che finalmente si presenti e dica, senza preamboli: "Ebbene, che cosa hai da dire a tua discolpa?"

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"I take full responsibility for the loss of that freighter. I'm sorry."|1059|0
units.english: "I take full responsibility for the loss of that freighter. I'm sorry."
units.italian: "Mi prendo la piena responsabilità della perdita di quel mercantile. Mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"There was really nothing I could have done against so many pirates."|1061|0
units.english: "There was really nothing I could have done against so many pirates."
units.italian: "Non potevo davvero fare nulla contro così tanti pirati."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"I'm sorry for what happened. It won't happen again."|1062|0
units.english: "I'm sorry for what happened. It won't happen again."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace per quello che è successo. Non succederà più."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	He doesn't look entirely satisfied with that response. "I had to write letters to five different families telling them why their son or daughter or husband had been killed on a routine cargo mission. You promised to keep them safe, and you failed. You understand that, right?"|1063|0
units.english: He doesn't look entirely satisfied with that response. "I had to write letters to five different families telling them why their son or daughter or husband had been killed on a routine cargo mission. You promised to keep them safe, and you failed. You understand that, right?"
units.italian: Non sembra del tutto soddisfatto di quella risposta. "Ho dovuto scrivere lettere a cinque famiglie diverse per spiegare perché il loro figlio o la loro figlia o il loro marito è stato ucciso in una normale missione di trasporto merci. Avevi promesso di tenerli al sicuro, e hai fallito. Lo capisci, vero?"

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"Well, space is a dangerous place. Bad things happen. I can't stop that."|1065|0
units.english: "Well, space is a dangerous place. Bad things happen. I can't stop that."
units.italian: "Beh, lo spazio è un posto pericoloso. Succedono cose brutte. Non posso impedirlo."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"Yes, I know that I failed, and I'm very sorry for their loss."|1066|0
units.english: "Yes, I know that I failed, and I'm very sorry for their loss."
units.italian: "Sì, so di aver fallito, e mi dispiace molto per la loro perdita."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|log|1069|0
units.english: Met with Tomek about my failure to protect a Free Worlds freighter. Tried to point out that there wasn't anything I could have done, but he was not happy about it.
units.italian: Ti sei incontrato con Tomek sul tuo fallimento nel proteggere un mercantile delle Free Worlds. Hai cercato di fargli notare che non potevi fare nulla, ma non ne è stato contento.

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"That is not an appropriate response," he says. "If we offer you a mission, we have to be able to trust that you will complete it, with no excuses. I'm sorry, but I have no interest in working with you in the future. Goodbye, Captain." He walks away.|1071|0
units.english: "That is not an appropriate response," he says. "If we offer you a mission, we have to be able to trust that you will complete it, with no excuses. I'm sorry, but I have no interest in working with you in the future. Goodbye, Captain." He walks away.
units.italian: "Questa non è una risposta appropriata," dice. "Se ti affidiamo una missione, dobbiamo poter contare sul fatto che la porterai a termine, senza scuse. Mi dispiace, ma non ho alcun interesse a lavorare con te in futuro. Addio, Capitano." Si allontana.

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"If we offer you a mission in the future," he says, "we have to be able to trust that you will complete it. No excuses, no second tries. Do you understand?" You nod. "Fine," he says, with a long sigh. "Katya said she trusts you, so I'll give you a second chance this one time. But please try to be more responsible in the future, okay?"|1075|0
units.english: "If we offer you a mission in the future," he says, "we have to be able to trust that you will complete it. No excuses, no second tries. Do you understand?" You nod. "Fine," he says, with a long sigh. "Katya said she trusts you, so I'll give you a second chance this one time. But please try to be more responsible in the future, okay?"
units.italian: "Se in futuro ti affidiamo una missione," dice, "dobbiamo poter contare sul fatto che la porterai a termine. Niente scuse, niente secondi tentativi. Hai capito?" Annuisci. "Bene," dice, con un lungo sospiro. "Katya ha detto che si fida di te, quindi questa volta ti do una seconda possibilità. Ma cerca di essere più responsabile in futuro, va bene?"

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"I will. Thank you for giving me a second chance, sir."|1077|0
units.english: "I will. Thank you for giving me a second chance, sir."
units.italian: "Lo sarò. Grazie per avermi dato una seconda possibilità, signore."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	"I'll try my best."|1078|0
units.english: "I'll try my best."
units.italian: "Farò del mio meglio."

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|	He shakes your hand and leaves, without ordering anything to drink. You get the feeling that he still does not think very highly of you.|1079|0
units.english: He shakes your hand and leaves, without ordering anything to drink. You get the feeling that he still does not think very highly of you.
units.italian: Ti stringe la mano e se ne va, senza ordinare niente da bere. Ti resta la sensazione che continui a non stimarti molto.

units.id: mission:FW Escort Second Chance|log|1081|0
units.english: Apologized to Tomek about my failed escort mission. He appears to have forgiven me.
units.italian: Ti sei scusato con Tomek per la missione di scorta fallita. Sembra che ti abbia perdonato.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|name|1088|0
units.english: Free Worlds Bounty Hunting
units.italian: Taglie per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|description|1089|0
units.english: Hunt down and destroy the "Rat Pack," a gang of pirate ships led by a flagship named "Cluny" who have been harassing merchants in Free Worlds space. They were last seen just northeast of Kornephoros. After defeating them, return to <destination>.
units.italian: Dai la caccia e distruggi la "Rat Pack", una banda di navi pirata guidata da una nave ammiraglia di nome "Cluny" che ha tormentato i mercanti nello spazio delle Free Worlds. Sono stati visti l'ultima volta a nord-est di Kornephoros. Dopo averli sconfitti, torna a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|log|1097|0
units.english: Told a militia officer that I wouldn't do any bounty hunting for the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai detto a un ufficiale della milizia che non avresti dato la caccia a nessun ricercato per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|As you walk through the spaceport, a woman in a militia uniform approaches you. "Are you Captain <last>?" she asks. You nod. "I'm a commander of the local militia," she says. "There's a pirate fleet that has attacked freighters in this sector several times in the last few months, but now it seems they've moved outside of Free space. I'd like to strike at them before they return and do more damage here, but right now the Free Worlds Council won't allow militia ships to be used for preemptive attacks, so instead we're looking to enlist the help of a merchant captain, and I was told that you're a formidable pilot."|1104|0
units.english: As you walk through the spaceport, a woman in a militia uniform approaches you. "Are you Captain <last>?" she asks. You nod. "I'm a commander of the local militia," she says. "There's a pirate fleet that has attacked freighters in this sector several times in the last few months, but now it seems they've moved outside of Free space. I'd like to strike at them before they return and do more damage here, but right now the Free Worlds Council won't allow militia ships to be used for preemptive attacks, so instead we're looking to enlist the help of a merchant captain, and I was told that you're a formidable pilot."
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, ti si avvicina una donna in uniforme della milizia. "È lei il Capitano <last>?" chiede. Annuisci. "Sono una comandante della milizia locale," dice. "C'è una flotta pirata che negli ultimi mesi ha attaccato più volte i mercantili in questo settore, ma ora sembra che si sia spostata fuori dallo spazio delle Free Worlds. Vorrei colpirla prima che torni a fare altri danni qui, ma al momento il Consiglio delle Free Worlds non permette che le navi della milizia siano usate per attacchi preventivi, quindi stiamo cercando di reclutare un capitano mercantile, e mi hanno detto che lei è un pilota formidabile."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"Well, I'd be glad to destroy them for you."|1106|0
units.english: "Well, I'd be glad to destroy them for you."
units.italian: "Beh, sarò lieto di distruggerli per voi."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"How powerful of a fleet do these pirates have?"|1108|0
units.english: "How powerful of a fleet do these pirates have?"
units.italian: "Quanto è potente la flotta di questi pirati?"

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"How much will you be paying me to take out this fleet?"|1109|0
units.english: "How much will you be paying me to take out this fleet?"
units.italian: "Quanto mi pagherete per eliminare questa flotta?"

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"I don't want to have anything to do with the Free Worlds."|1111|0
units.english: "I don't want to have anything to do with the Free Worlds."
units.italian: "Non voglio avere niente a che fare con le Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"Well they aren't exactly a powerful fleet. They're just a collection of interceptors, but they're numerous and swift enough that we've had trouble taking them down before they can run or swarm our larger ships. We can pay you <payment> if you can take them out."|1114|0
units.english: "Well they aren't exactly a powerful fleet. They're just a collection of interceptors, but they're numerous and swift enough that we've had trouble taking them down before they can run or swarm our larger ships. We can pay you <payment> if you can take them out."
units.italian: "Beh, non è esattamente una flotta potente. È solo un insieme di intercettori, ma sono abbastanza numerosi e rapidi che abbiamo avuto difficoltà a eliminarli prima che riuscissero a fuggire o ad avventarsi sulle nostre navi più grandi. Possiamo pagarle <payment> se riesce a eliminarli."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"Just a group of interceptors? That should be no problem for me to destroy."|1116|0
units.english: "Just a group of interceptors? That should be no problem for me to destroy."
units.italian: "Solo un gruppo di intercettori? Non dovrebbe essere un problema per me distruggerli."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"If you can't take them out then I don't know how I will. You're on your own."|1118|0
units.english: "If you can't take them out then I don't know how I will. You're on your own."
units.italian: "Se non ci riuscite voi, non so come potrei riuscirci io. Arrangiatevi."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"Since these pirates have been particularly troublesome, we've placed a bounty of <payment> on their heads. Take them out for us and those credits are all yours."|1122|0
units.english: "Since these pirates have been particularly troublesome, we've placed a bounty of <payment> on their heads. Take them out for us and those credits are all yours."
units.italian: "Dato che questi pirati sono stati particolarmente molesti, abbiamo messo una taglia di <payment> sulle loro teste. Eliminali per noi e quei crediti sono tutti tuoi."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"That sounds reasonable enough. Okay, I'll destroy them for you."|1124|0
units.english: "That sounds reasonable enough. Okay, I'll destroy them for you."
units.italian: "Mi sembra abbastanza ragionevole. Va bene, li distruggerò per voi."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"Only <payment>? You're going to need to find someone else for the job."|1125|0
units.english: "Only <payment>? You're going to need to find someone else for the job."
units.italian: "Solo <payment>? Dovrete trovare qualcun altro per questo lavoro."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|	"Excellent," she says. "They call themselves the 'Rat Pack,' and you'll recognize them because most of their ships are named after various vermin, although for some unknown reason their flagship is just named 'Cluny.' Our sources tell us that they're just northeast of the Kornephoros system. Thank you in advance for your help."|1129|0
units.english: "Excellent," she says. "They call themselves the 'Rat Pack,' and you'll recognize them because most of their ships are named after various vermin, although for some unknown reason their flagship is just named 'Cluny.' Our sources tell us that they're just northeast of the Kornephoros system. Thank you in advance for your help."
units.italian: "Eccellente," dice. "Si fanno chiamare 'Rat Pack', e li riconoscerai perché la maggior parte delle loro navi porta il nome di qualche parassita, anche se per qualche ragione sconosciuta la loro ammiraglia si chiama solo 'Cluny'. Le nostre fonti dicono che sono appena a nord-est del sistema Kornephoros. Grazie in anticipo per il tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|dialog|1143|0
units.english: The "Rat Pack" has been eliminated. You can claim the bounty payment by returning to <destination>.
units.italian: La "Rat Pack" è stata eliminata. Puoi riscuotere la taglia tornando a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|log|1148|0
units.english: Hunted down a fleet of pirates called the Rat Pack who had been giving the Free Worlds trouble.
units.italian: Hai dato la caccia a una flotta di pirati chiamata Rat Pack che stava creando problemi alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 1|dialog|1150|0
units.english: The militia officer who asked you to hunt down the "Rat Pack" arrives at your ship soon after you land and thanks you profusely. "Now we won't have to worry about them bothering ships in this sector anymore." She pays you the bounty of <payment> and says she'll tell other militia leaders how helpful you were.
units.italian: L'ufficiale della milizia che ti aveva chiesto di dare la caccia alla "Rat Pack" arriva alla tua nave poco dopo che atterri e ti ringrazia profusamente. "Ora non dovremo più preoccuparci che diano fastidio alle navi di questo settore." Ti paga la taglia di <payment> e dice che racconterà agli altri capi della milizia quanto sei stato utile.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|name|1183|0
units.english: Free Worlds Bounty Hunting
units.italian: Taglie per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|description|1184|0
units.english: A Free Worlds militia officer from <destination> asked you to hunt down the <npc>, a pirate ship pillaging ships headed to Tarazed. The militia officer suggested trying to attack the ship from a distance.
units.italian: Un ufficiale della milizia delle Free Worlds di <destination> ti ha chiesto di dare la caccia alla <npc>, una nave pirata che saccheggia le navi dirette a Tarazed. L'ufficiale della milizia ha suggerito di provare ad attaccarla da lontano.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|A Free Worlds officer waves to you as you are walking through the spaceport. "Hello Captain <last>," he says. "I've heard you've helped us in the past to deal with pirate threats. Interested in another bounty hunting mission?"|1196|0
units.english: A Free Worlds officer waves to you as you are walking through the spaceport. "Hello Captain <last>," he says. "I've heard you've helped us in the past to deal with pirate threats. Interested in another bounty hunting mission?"
units.italian: Un ufficiale delle Free Worlds ti fa un cenno mentre attraversi lo spazioporto. "Salve, Capitano <last>," dice. "Ho saputo che in passato ci hai aiutato a fronteggiare le minacce dei pirati. Ti interessa un'altra missione di caccia al ricercato?"

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|	"What will it be this time?"|1198|0
units.english: "What will it be this time?"
units.italian: "Di che si tratta questa volta?"

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|	"Sure, I do love destroying pirates!"|1199|0
units.english: "Sure, I do love destroying pirates!"
units.italian: "Certo, adoro distruggere i pirati!"

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|	"Sorry, I'm way too busy right now."|1201|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm way too busy right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, adesso sono troppo occupato."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|	"There's a retrofitted heavy freighter by the name of <npc> that has been stealing large amounts of cargo from our supply convoys headed to Tarazed. Be warned that this ship is a tough one, fitted with more Heavy Lasers than I've ever seen anyone install on a single ship, but it's slow as a sloth, so you might be able to hit it from afar. The bounty on it is <payment>."|1204|0
units.english: "There's a retrofitted heavy freighter by the name of <npc> that has been stealing large amounts of cargo from our supply convoys headed to Tarazed. Be warned that this ship is a tough one, fitted with more Heavy Lasers than I've ever seen anyone install on a single ship, but it's slow as a sloth, so you might be able to hit it from afar. The bounty on it is <payment>."
units.italian: "C'è un mercantile pesante riadattato di nome <npc> che sta rubando grandi quantità di carico ai nostri convogli di rifornimento diretti a Tarazed. Ti avverto che questa nave è tosta: monta più laser pesanti di quanti ne abbia mai visti installati su una sola nave, ma è lenta come un bradipo, quindi potresti riuscire a colpirla da lontano. La taglia su di essa è <payment>."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|	"Sounds like this shouldn't be too difficult. I'm in."|1206|0
units.english: "Sounds like this shouldn't be too difficult. I'm in."
units.italian: "Non sembra troppo difficile. Ci sto."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|	"I could handle a group of interceptors, but this sounds like too much for me. You'll have to find someone else."|1207|0
units.english: "I could handle a group of interceptors, but this sounds like too much for me. You'll have to find someone else."
units.italian: "Potrei cavarmela con un gruppo di intercettori, ma questa mi sembra troppo per me. Dovrete trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|	He grins. "Glad to hear you're on board. Good luck, Captain."|1210|0
units.english: He grins. "Glad to hear you're on board. Good luck, Captain."
units.italian: Sogghigna. "Sono contento che tu sia dei nostri. Buona fortuna, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|	He grins. "Your target is a retrofitted heavy freighter by the name of <npc> that has been stealing large amounts of cargo from our supply convoys. It was last seen in the Delta Sagittarii system. Be warned that this ship is a tough one, fitted with more Heavy Lasers than I've ever seen anyone install on a single ship, but it's slow as a sloth, so you might be able to hit it from afar. Good luck, Captain."|1214|0
units.english: He grins. "Your target is a retrofitted heavy freighter by the name of <npc> that has been stealing large amounts of cargo from our supply convoys. It was last seen in the Delta Sagittarii system. Be warned that this ship is a tough one, fitted with more Heavy Lasers than I've ever seen anyone install on a single ship, but it's slow as a sloth, so you might be able to hit it from afar. Good luck, Captain."
units.italian: Sogghigna. "Il tuo bersaglio è un mercantile pesante riadattato di nome <npc> che sta rubando grandi quantità di carico ai nostri convogli di rifornimento. È stato visto l'ultima volta nel sistema Delta Sagittarii. Ti avverto che questa nave è tosta: monta più laser pesanti di quanti ne abbia mai visti installati su una sola nave, ma è lenta come un bradipo, quindi potresti riuscire a colpirla da lontano. Buona fortuna, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|log|1228|0
units.english: Hunted down the Moonless Night, a retrofitted heavy freighter that had been terrorizing Free Worlds supply routes.
units.italian: Hai dato la caccia alla Moonless Night, un mercantile pesante riadattato che terrorizzava le rotte di rifornimento delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 2|dialog|1230|0
units.english: The militia officer who asked you to hunt down the <npc> meets you in the spaceport and pays you <payment>. "Once again, thank you for assisting us," he says.
units.italian: L'ufficiale della milizia che ti aveva chiesto di dare la caccia alla <npc> ti incontra nello spazioporto e ti paga <payment>. "Ancora una volta, grazie per il tuo aiuto," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|name|1235|0
units.english: Free Worlds Bounty Hunting
units.italian: Taglie per le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|description|1236|0
units.english: A Free Worlds militia officer from <destination> asked you to hunt down the <npc>, a powerful pirate ship last seen in the Shaula system.
units.italian: Un ufficiale della milizia delle Free Worlds di <destination> ti ha chiesto di dare la caccia alla <npc>, una potente nave pirata vista l'ultima volta nel sistema Shaula.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|log|1244|0
units.english: Told a militia officer that I wouldn't do any more bounty hunting for the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai detto a un ufficiale della milizia che non avresti dato la caccia ad altri ricercati per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|Once again, as you are walking through the spaceport a Free Worlds officer flags you down. "We've got another bounty hunting mission for you," he says. "This one is a bit more dangerous; this pirate ship has weapons we've never seen before, that may be alien in origin. Interested in helping us to destroy it?"|1251|0
units.english: Once again, as you are walking through the spaceport a Free Worlds officer flags you down. "We've got another bounty hunting mission for you," he says. "This one is a bit more dangerous; this pirate ship has weapons we've never seen before, that may be alien in origin. Interested in helping us to destroy it?"
units.italian: Ancora una volta, mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, un ufficiale delle Free Worlds ti fa cenno di fermarti. "Abbiamo un'altra missione di caccia al ricercato per te," dice. "Questa è un po' più pericolosa: questa nave pirata ha armi che non abbiamo mai visto, forse di origine aliena. Ti interessa aiutarci a distruggerla?"

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|	"Yes, I'm sure my ship will be up to the challenge."|1253|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm sure my ship will be up to the challenge."
units.italian: "Sì, sono sicuro che la mia nave sarà all'altezza della sfida."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|	"Alien in origin? What sort of weapons does it have?"|1255|0
units.english: "Alien in origin? What sort of weapons does it have?"
units.italian: "Di origine aliena? Che tipo di armi ha?"

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|	"Sorry, I'm not interested in giving the Free Worlds more assistance."|1256|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested in giving the Free Worlds more assistance."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho intenzione di dare altre mano alle Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|	"It has a pair of strange cannons that seem to interfere with a ship's electrical systems, draining its power and causing its weapons to malfunction. It's similar to those lasers the Quarg have, which is why we think the weapons are alien technology."|1259|0
units.english: "It has a pair of strange cannons that seem to interfere with a ship's electrical systems, draining its power and causing its weapons to malfunction. It's similar to those lasers the Quarg have, which is why we think the weapons are alien technology."
units.italian: "Ha un paio di cannoni strani che sembrano interferire con i sistemi elettrici di una nave, prosciugandone l'energia e facendo funzionare male le armi. È simile ai laser che hanno i Quarg, ed è per questo che pensiamo che siano tecnologia aliena."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|	"Well you came to the right person. I'll take it out for you."|1261|0
units.english: "Well you came to the right person. I'll take it out for you."
units.italian: "Beh, ti sei rivolto alla persona giusta. La eliminerò per voi."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|	"Sorry, but that sounds like a job for someone else."|1262|0
units.english: "Sorry, but that sounds like a job for someone else."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma sembra un lavoro per qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|	"Great," he says. "Your target is named the <npc>. After we nearly destroyed it, it went to the Shaula system to hide out, which means that you'll probably have to deal with other pirates at the same time. Good luck, Captain."|1266|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "Your target is named the <npc>. After we nearly destroyed it, it went to the Shaula system to hide out, which means that you'll probably have to deal with other pirates at the same time. Good luck, Captain."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Il tuo bersaglio si chiama <npc>. Dopo che l'abbiamo quasi distrutta, è andata a nascondersi nel sistema Shaula, il che significa che probabilmente dovrai vedertela anche con altri pirati nello stesso momento. Buona fortuna, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|log|1281|0
units.english: Defeated the Silverhawk, an Osprey armed with alien technology, and earned a good reputation with the Free Worlds militia by hunting down other dangerous pirates.
units.italian: Hai sconfitto la Silverhawk, un Osprey armato con tecnologia aliena, e ti sei guadagnato una buona reputazione con la milizia delle Free Worlds dando la caccia ad altri pirati pericolosi.

units.id: mission:FW Bounty 3|dialog|1282|0
units.english: The militia officer who asked you to hunt down the <npc> contacts you soon after you land. "You've done us a great service," he says. "I'll be telling the Council how helpful you were." He hands you a payment of <payment>.
units.italian: L'ufficiale della milizia che ti aveva chiesto di dare la caccia alla <npc> ti contatta poco dopo che atterri. "Ci hai reso un grande servizio," dice. "Dirò al Consiglio quanto sei stato utile." Ti consegna un pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:FW Katya Failed|log|1312|0
units.english: Failed to complete a mission given to me by Katya, a Free Worlds officer.
units.italian: Non sei riuscito a completare una missione affidatati da Katya, un'ufficiale delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|name|1320|0
units.english: Assist the Free Worlds
units.italian: Aiuta le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|description|1321|0
units.english: Stop by <destination>, pick up two passengers and some cargo, and distract the Republic from a more important cargo exchange going on simultaneously.
units.italian: Passa da <destination>, prendi a bordo due passeggeri e un po' di carico, e distrai la Repubblica da uno scambio di merci più importante che avviene nello stesso momento.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|Wandering through the spaceport, you have stopped for a moment to read the menu posted in front of a restaurant, when your thoughts are interrupted by the click of a gun being cocked right behind your head, and a woman's voice saying, "Think fast, Captain."|1334|0
units.english: Wandering through the spaceport, you have stopped for a moment to read the menu posted in front of a restaurant, when your thoughts are interrupted by the click of a gun being cocked right behind your head, and a woman's voice saying, "Think fast, Captain."
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, ti sei fermato un momento a leggere il menù affisso davanti a un ristorante, quando i tuoi pensieri vengono interrotti dal clic di una pistola che viene armata proprio dietro la testa, e da una voce di donna che dice: "Pensa in fretta, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	(Do this karate move I saw in a video one time.)|1336|0
units.english: (Do this karate move I saw in a video one time.)
units.italian: (Fai quella mossa di karate che ho visto una volta in un video.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	(Raise my hands slowly into the air and find out what she wants.)|1338|0
units.english: (Raise my hands slowly into the air and find out what she wants.)
units.italian: (Alza le mani lentamente e scopri che cosa vuole.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Good choice," she says. "Now, turn around, slowly, and don't try any funny business. I've got a semiautomatic pistol pointed right at your head."|1340|0
units.english: "Good choice," she says. "Now, turn around, slowly, and don't try any funny business. I've got a semiautomatic pistol pointed right at your head."
units.italian: "Buona scelta," dice. "Ora girati, lentamente, e non provare scherzi. Ho una pistola semiautomatica puntata dritta alla tua testa."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	(Now, try that karate move.)|1342|0
units.english: (Now, try that karate move.)
units.italian: (Ora, prova quella mossa di karate.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	(Turn around slowly.)|1344|0
units.english: (Turn around slowly.)
units.italian: (Girati lentamente.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	You turn around and find yourself facing a woman in a Free Worlds uniform. The chevrons on her collar mark her as some sort of officer. She is grinning at you. "Beautifully done, Captain," she says. "Such restraint. Such remarkable levelheadedness. Not something I often see around here. If this thing were loaded, quite a few backcountry rubes in the last few months would've had their brains blown open before I could even get around to recruiting them." She lowers the gun.|1346|0
units.english: You turn around and find yourself facing a woman in a Free Worlds uniform. The chevrons on her collar mark her as some sort of officer. She is grinning at you. "Beautifully done, Captain," she says. "Such restraint. Such remarkable levelheadedness. Not something I often see around here. If this thing were loaded, quite a few backcountry rubes in the last few months would've had their brains blown open before I could even get around to recruiting them." She lowers the gun.
units.italian: Ti giri e ti trovi davanti una donna in uniforme delle Free Worlds. I galloni sul colletto la indicano come una specie di ufficiale. Ti sta sorridendo. "Magnificamente fatto, Capitano," dice. "Che autocontrollo. Che straordinaria freddezza. Non è una cosa che vedo spesso da queste parti. Se questa fosse carica, parecchi zotici di provincia negli ultimi mesi si sarebbero fatti aprire il cranio prima che riuscissi ad arrivare a reclutarli." Abbassa la pistola.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"You mean this was some sort of test? You're not trying to mug me?"|1348|0
units.english: "You mean this was some sort of test? You're not trying to mug me?"
units.italian: "Vuoi dire che era una specie di prova? Non stai cercando di rapinarmi?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	(Try that karate move, just for kicks.)|1350|0
units.english: (Try that karate move, just for kicks.)
units.italian: (Prova quella mossa di karate, tanto per ridere.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	You make a grab for the gun. A second later she's got your arm twisted behind your back, using just enough force to make it clear that things could get really painful if you continue to struggle. "Smart, and playful too," she says, "I like that. But, it'll be a cold day in hell before a kid like you gets the drop on me. Now, shall we talk?" She lets go of you, and you shake out your arm gingerly.|1352|0
units.english: You make a grab for the gun. A second later she's got your arm twisted behind your back, using just enough force to make it clear that things could get really painful if you continue to struggle. "Smart, and playful too," she says, "I like that. But, it'll be a cold day in hell before a kid like you gets the drop on me. Now, shall we talk?" She lets go of you, and you shake out your arm gingerly.
units.italian: Provi a strapparle la pistola. Un secondo dopo ti ha già bloccato il braccio dietro la schiena, usando appena la forza necessaria a farti capire che le cose potrebbero diventare molto dolorose se continui a divincolarti. "Sveglio, e anche giocherellone," dice, "mi piace. Ma dovrà nevicare all'inferno prima che un ragazzino come te mi colga di sorpresa. Ora, parliamo?" Ti lascia andare, e tu ti massaggi il braccio con prudenza.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"I need a civilian for some courier work," she says. "Nothing illegal, at least nothing the Republic can pin on you. It just needs to be done by a ship that isn't flying our colors, and by a captain who isn't going to scream, 'Death to all tyrants!' and go in with guns blazing the first time your cargo gets scanned. What do you say?"|1355|0
units.english: "I need a civilian for some courier work," she says. "Nothing illegal, at least nothing the Republic can pin on you. It just needs to be done by a ship that isn't flying our colors, and by a captain who isn't going to scream, 'Death to all tyrants!' and go in with guns blazing the first time your cargo gets scanned. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Mi serve un civile per un lavoro da corriere," dice. "Niente di illegale, almeno niente che la Repubblica possa appiopparti. Deve solo essere fatto da una nave che non vola con i nostri colori, e da un capitano che non si metta a urlare 'Morte a tutti i tiranni!' e ad aprire il fuoco la prima volta che il tuo carico viene scansionato. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"I'm not sure I'm ready to pick sides in this war, yet."|1357|0
units.english: "I'm not sure I'm ready to pick sides in this war, yet."
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro di essere pronto a schierarmi in questa guerra, non ancora."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Why would I help a group of terrorists?"|1358|0
units.english: "Why would I help a group of terrorists?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei aiutare un gruppo di terroristi?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Okay, tell me more."|1360|0
units.english: "Okay, tell me more."
units.italian: "Va bene, dimmi di più."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Look, kid," she says. "When I ask you to pick sides, when I offer you a mission that's gonna burn some bridges for you, I won't be sneaky about it. I'll tell you exactly what you're signing up for. What I'm offering you now is just a chance to get to know us, and let us get to know you, with no expectations. Heck, you can even run missions for the Reps at the same time."|1363|0
units.english: "Look, kid," she says. "When I ask you to pick sides, when I offer you a mission that's gonna burn some bridges for you, I won't be sneaky about it. I'll tell you exactly what you're signing up for. What I'm offering you now is just a chance to get to know us, and let us get to know you, with no expectations. Heck, you can even run missions for the Reps at the same time."
units.italian: "Senti, ragazzino," dice. "Quando ti chiederò di schierarti, quando ti offrirò una missione che ti brucerà qualche ponte, non userò sotterfugi. Ti dirò esattamente a che cosa stai andando incontro. Quello che ti offro adesso è solo la possibilità di conoscerci, e di farci conoscere te, senza aspettative. Accidenti, puoi anche fare missioni per i Repubblicani nello stesso tempo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"That sounds fair. I'll hear you out."|1365|0
units.english: "That sounds fair. I'll hear you out."
units.italian: "Mi sembra giusto. Ti ascolto."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"I don't like working with people who start conversations by pointing guns at my head. Even unloaded guns. Find someone else to do this job for you."|1367|0
units.english: "I don't like working with people who start conversations by pointing guns at my head. Even unloaded guns. Find someone else to do this job for you."
units.italian: "Non mi piace lavorare con chi comincia una conversazione puntandomi una pistola alla testa. Anche se scarica. Trova qualcun altro per questo lavoro."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Look, kid," she says. "I know the situation looks bad, but I'm telling the truth when I say that the Free Worlds aren't the ones who dropped those nukes, and we don't know who did, either. So I'll proudly be called treasonous for separating from the Republic, but I will not tolerate being called a terrorist."|1371|0
units.english: "Look, kid," she says. "I know the situation looks bad, but I'm telling the truth when I say that the Free Worlds aren't the ones who dropped those nukes, and we don't know who did, either. So I'll proudly be called treasonous for separating from the Republic, but I will not tolerate being called a terrorist."
units.italian: "Senti, ragazzino," dice. "So che la situazione sembra brutta, ma dico la verità quando affermo che non sono state le Free Worlds a sganciare quelle bombe, e non sappiamo nemmeno chi sia stato. Quindi accetterò con orgoglio di essere chiamata traditrice per essermi separata dalla Repubblica, ma non tollererò di essere chiamata terrorista."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"And what reason do I have to believe you?"|1373|0
units.english: "And what reason do I have to believe you?"
units.italian: "E quale motivo avrei di crederti?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"I'm not convinced. You'll need to find some other sucker to do your dirty work for you."|1374|0
units.english: "I'm not convinced. You'll need to find some other sucker to do your dirty work for you."
units.italian: "Non sono convinto. Dovrai trovare qualche altro sprovveduto per farti fare il lavoro sporco."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	She pauses for a moment. "You don't have a reason," she says with a sigh. "Sometimes you just need to take things on faith."|1377|0
units.english: She pauses for a moment. "You don't have a reason," she says with a sigh. "Sometimes you just need to take things on faith."
units.italian: Si ferma un momento. "Non hai nessun motivo," dice con un sospiro. "A volte bisogna solo avere fede."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Alright, I'm willing to hear you out."|1379|0
units.english: "Alright, I'm willing to hear you out."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono disposto ad ascoltarti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Well I don't have a lot of faith in people who start conversations by pointing guns at my head. Even unloaded guns. Find someone else to do this job for you."|1380|0
units.english: "Well I don't have a lot of faith in people who start conversations by pointing guns at my head. Even unloaded guns. Find someone else to do this job for you."
units.italian: "Beh, non ho molta fede nelle persone che cominciano una conversazione puntandomi una pistola alla testa. Anche se scarica. Trova qualcun altro per questo lavoro."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Okay, here's the deal. We need some cargo carried from <planet> to Skymoot. It's just medical supplies - no bombs, no contraband. But we'll load it onto your ship in the dead of night, trying our best to avoid any notice. But the Reps have the sharpest eyes in the galaxy, so you'll get noticed anyway. And since anything done in the dead of night is likely to arouse their suspicions, you'll get boarded and searched. Meanwhile, the real cargo will have been loaded onto one of our ships in broad daylight, and will pass through Republic space entirely unnoticed."|1384|0
units.english: "Okay, here's the deal. We need some cargo carried from <planet> to Skymoot. It's just medical supplies - no bombs, no contraband. But we'll load it onto your ship in the dead of night, trying our best to avoid any notice. But the Reps have the sharpest eyes in the galaxy, so you'll get noticed anyway. And since anything done in the dead of night is likely to arouse their suspicions, you'll get boarded and searched. Meanwhile, the real cargo will have been loaded onto one of our ships in broad daylight, and will pass through Republic space entirely unnoticed."
units.italian: "Va bene, il punto è questo. Dobbiamo far arrivare un carico da <planet> a Skymoot. Sono solo rifornimenti medici: niente bombe, niente contrabbando. Ma lo caricheremo sulla tua nave nel cuore della notte, cercando in ogni modo di non farci notare. Però i Repubblicani hanno gli occhi più acuti della galassia, quindi verrai notato comunque. E dato che qualunque cosa fatta nel cuore della notte è probabile che insospettisca, ti fermeranno e ti perquisiranno. Nel frattempo il carico vero sarà stato caricato su una delle nostre navi in pieno giorno, e passerà attraverso lo spazio della Repubblica del tutto inosservato."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"I like the way you think. Count me in."|1386|0
units.english: "I like the way you think. Count me in."
units.italian: "Mi piace come ragioni. Ci sto."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Sorry, it sounds a bit too shady for my liking. Please don't offer me any work in the future."|1388|0
units.english: "Sorry, it sounds a bit too shady for my liking. Please don't offer me any work in the future."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, mi sembra un po' troppo losco per i miei gusti. Per favore, non offrirmi altro lavoro in futuro."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Shucks," she says, "I liked you. I was looking forward to having you on my team." She looks genuinely crestfallen. "But fair is fair. You're free to go, and I'll tell my colleagues that you're not interested in working for us."|1390|0
units.english: "Shucks," she says, "I liked you. I was looking forward to having you on my team." She looks genuinely crestfallen. "But fair is fair. You're free to go, and I'll tell my colleagues that you're not interested in working for us."
units.italian: "Peccato," dice, "mi stavi simpatico. Non vedevo l'ora di averti nella mia squadra." Sembra davvero delusa. "Ma quel che è giusto è giusto. Sei libero di andare, e dirò ai miei colleghi che non ti interessa lavorare per noi."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Great," she says, grinning even more broadly. "My name's Katya Reynolds, by the way. Glad we'll be working together." She starts to walk away, then seems to remember something. "One last thing - some friends of mine on <planet>, tourists, need a lift off that rock, and I owe them a favor. Would you mind saving two bunks for them?"|1394|0
units.english: "Great," she says, grinning even more broadly. "My name's Katya Reynolds, by the way. Glad we'll be working together." She starts to walk away, then seems to remember something. "One last thing - some friends of mine on <planet>, tourists, need a lift off that rock, and I owe them a favor. Would you mind saving two bunks for them?"
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice, sorridendo ancora più apertamente. "Comunque mi chiamo Katya Reynolds. Sono contenta che lavoreremo insieme." Comincia ad allontanarsi, poi sembra ricordarsi qualcosa. "Un'ultima cosa: alcuni miei amici su <planet>, turisti, hanno bisogno di un passaggio per uscire da quel posto, e io gli devo un favore. Ti dispiacerebbe tenere libere due cuccette per loro?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Sure, no problem."|1396|0
units.english: "Sure, no problem."
units.italian: "Certo, nessun problema."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Excellent. I'm looking forward to doing business with you, Captain."|1398|0
units.english: "Excellent. I'm looking forward to doing business with you, Captain."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Non vedo l'ora di fare affari con te, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	You dodge sideways and spin quickly. As you do so you hear a loud click, but the gun does not fire. With one hand you knock aside the gun. With the other you land a karate chop which, if you had studied karate, would've shattered her collarbone and left her reeling in pain. But since you have not studied karate, instead your blow bounces harmlessly off her surprisingly muscular shoulder.|1402|0
units.english: You dodge sideways and spin quickly. As you do so you hear a loud click, but the gun does not fire. With one hand you knock aside the gun. With the other you land a karate chop which, if you had studied karate, would've shattered her collarbone and left her reeling in pain. But since you have not studied karate, instead your blow bounces harmlessly off her surprisingly muscular shoulder.
units.italian: Scarti di lato e ti giri in fretta. Mentre lo fai senti un clic sonoro, ma la pistola non spara. Con una mano scosti l'arma. Con l'altra sferri un colpo di karate che, se avessi studiato karate, le avrebbe frantumato la clavicola lasciandola piegata dal dolore. Ma dato che non hai studiato karate, il tuo colpo rimbalza innocuo sulla sua spalla sorprendentemente muscolosa.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	Your assailant turns out to be wearing a Free Worlds uniform and a disappointed expression. "Well aren't you a dumb reckless bastard!" she says, "I'd hoped for something better from you. First of all, if this gun were loaded, your brains would be splattered all over the sidewalk. And second, you fight like a girl. I have no use for hotheads like you." She stalks off, leaving you very confused. It would appear that you've just failed some sort of test.|1403|0
units.english: Your assailant turns out to be wearing a Free Worlds uniform and a disappointed expression. "Well aren't you a dumb reckless bastard!" she says, "I'd hoped for something better from you. First of all, if this gun were loaded, your brains would be splattered all over the sidewalk. And second, you fight like a girl. I have no use for hotheads like you." She stalks off, leaving you very confused. It would appear that you've just failed some sort of test.
units.italian: Il tuo aggressore si rivela vestito con un'uniforme delle Free Worlds e con un'espressione delusa. "Beh, ma sei proprio un bastardo stupido e imprudente!" dice. "Speravo qualcosa di meglio da te. Prima di tutto, se questa pistola fosse carica, il tuo cervello sarebbe spalmato su tutto il marciapiede. E secondo, combatti come una ragazza. Non ho alcun uso per le teste calde come te." Si allontana a grandi passi, lasciandoti molto confuso. Sembra che tu abbia appena fallito una specie di prova.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	(Let her go.)|1405|0
units.english: (Let her go.)
units.italian: (Lasciala andare.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Oh yeah? Well you ARE a girl!"|1407|0
units.english: "Oh yeah? Well you ARE a girl!"
units.italian: "Ah sì? Beh, tu SEI una ragazza!"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	She turns back around, with a fearsome gleam in her eyes, and walks up to you until your faces are only inches apart. "Yeah, but I don't fight like one," she says. "I... fight like a she-badger."|1409|0
units.english: She turns back around, with a fearsome gleam in her eyes, and walks up to you until your faces are only inches apart. "Yeah, but I don't fight like one," she says. "I... fight like a she-badger."
units.italian: Si volta di nuovo, con un bagliore terribile negli occhi, e ti si avvicina fino ad avere i visi a pochi centimetri. "Sì, ma io non combatto come una ragazza," dice. "Io... combatto come una femmina di tasso."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"A she... badger?"|1411|0
units.english: "A she... badger?"
units.italian: "Una femmina di... tasso?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|	"Fearsome creatures." She walks away, leaving you even more confused.|1413|0
units.english: "Fearsome creatures." She walks away, leaving you even more confused.
units.italian: "Creature terrificanti." Se ne va, lasciandoti ancora più confuso.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|log|1418|0
units.english: Was held up at gunpoint by a militia woman in some sort of ill-conceived Free Worlds recruitment test.
units.italian: Sei stato minacciato con una pistola da una donna della milizia, in una specie di mal concepita prova di reclutamento delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1|log|1421|0
units.english: Agreed to run interference for the Free Worlds by pretending to be a smuggler while actually carrying harmless medical supplies. It seems like this might be a ploy to make the Navy look bad.
units.italian: Hai accettato di fare da diversivo per le Free Worlds fingendo di essere un contrabbandiere mentre trasportavi in realtà rifornimenti medici innocui. Sembra che possa essere un trucco per far fare brutta figura alla Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|name|1427|0
units.english: Assist the Free Worlds
units.italian: Aiuta le Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|description|1428|0
units.english: Bring some cargo (harmless but intended to look suspicious) and two tourists to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta un carico (innocuo ma fatto per sembrare sospetto) e due turisti fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|blocked|1433|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you need <capacity> in order to take on Katya's mission for the Free Worlds. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione di Katya per le Free Worlds. Torna qui quando avrai libero lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|Soon after you land, a middle-aged tourist couple approach you and ask if you'd be willing to take them to Skymoot, "to see the dragons. Katerina recommended you." You tell them you would be glad to.|1441|0
units.english: Soon after you land, a middle-aged tourist couple approach you and ask if you'd be willing to take them to Skymoot, "to see the dragons. Katerina recommended you." You tell them you would be glad to.
units.italian: Poco dopo che atterri, ti si avvicina una coppia di turisti di mezza età e ti chiede se saresti disposto a portarli a Skymoot, "a vedere i draghi. Ce l'ha consigliata Katerina." Dici che ne sarai lieto.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|	The man, who is wearing floral print shorts and carrying an absurdly large camera, introduces himself as Marty. "And this is my wife, Sarah," he adds. "Would you mind taking a picture of us?" They pose in front of your ship. "Better take two pictures in case she blinks," says Marty. As you help them bring their oversized suitcases on board, you can't help wondering why Katya would be friends with such a quintessential pair of rich, uncultured buffoons.|1442|0
units.english: The man, who is wearing floral print shorts and carrying an absurdly large camera, introduces himself as Marty. "And this is my wife, Sarah," he adds. "Would you mind taking a picture of us?" They pose in front of your ship. "Better take two pictures in case she blinks," says Marty. As you help them bring their oversized suitcases on board, you can't help wondering why Katya would be friends with such a quintessential pair of rich, uncultured buffoons.
units.italian: L'uomo, che indossa pantaloncini a fiori e porta una macchina fotografica assurdamente grande, si presenta come Marty. "E questa è mia moglie, Sarah," aggiunge. "Le dispiacerebbe farci una foto?" Si mettono in posa davanti alla tua nave. "Meglio farne due, in caso chiuda gli occhi," dice Marty. Mentre li aiuti a portare a bordo le loro valigie smisurate, non puoi fare a meno di chiederti perché Katya sia amica di una coppia così tipica di ricchi buzzurri senza cultura.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|	Much later that night, as planned, three shadowy figures load a set of unmarked crates into your cargo bay. Katya assured you that the contents are harmless, just intended to distract the Republic security officers, but you can't help feeling like you're getting involved in something shady.|1443|0
units.english: Much later that night, as planned, three shadowy figures load a set of unmarked crates into your cargo bay. Katya assured you that the contents are harmless, just intended to distract the Republic security officers, but you can't help feeling like you're getting involved in something shady.
units.italian: Molto più tardi quella notte, come previsto, tre figure nell'ombra caricano una serie di casse senza contrassegni nella tua stiva. Katya ti ha assicurato che il contenuto è innocuo, serve solo a distrarre gli ufficiali della sicurezza della Repubblica, ma non puoi fare a meno di sentirti coinvolto in qualcosa di losco.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|dialog|1447|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Marty, Sarah, and the medical supplies hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Marty, Sarah e i rifornimenti medici non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|When you land on <planet>, before your engines have even had a chance to cool, Katya comes aboard your ship. When she sees your passengers, she breaks into a wide grin. "Lynn!" she says, running up and hugging the woman who introduced herself as "Sarah." Then she turns to "Marty" and says, "And Henry! So good to see you both. Captain <last>, allow me to introduce you to Professor Lynn Anderson, one of the galaxy's premier planetary scientists, and her husband Henry, a former Navy intelligence officer."|1451|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, before your engines have even had a chance to cool, Katya comes aboard your ship. When she sees your passengers, she breaks into a wide grin. "Lynn!" she says, running up and hugging the woman who introduced herself as "Sarah." Then she turns to "Marty" and says, "And Henry! So good to see you both. Captain <last>, allow me to introduce you to Professor Lynn Anderson, one of the galaxy's premier planetary scientists, and her husband Henry, a former Navy intelligence officer."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, prima ancora che i motori abbiano avuto il tempo di raffreddarsi, Katya sale sulla tua nave. Quando vede i tuoi passeggeri, si apre in un sorriso largo. "Lynn!" dice, correndo ad abbracciare la donna che si era presentata come "Sarah". Poi si volta verso "Marty" e dice: "E Henry! Che bello vedervi entrambi. Capitano <last>, permettimi di presentarti la professoressa Lynn Anderson, una delle massime scienziate planetarie della galassia, e suo marito Henry, ex ufficiale dell'intelligence della Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|	"Pleased to meet you both. Why the deception?"|1453|0
units.english: "Pleased to meet you both. Why the deception?"
units.italian: "Piacere di conoscervi. Perché tutto questo inganno?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|	"Wait a minute... were they the secret cargo?"|1454|0
units.english: "Wait a minute... were they the secret cargo?"
units.italian: "Aspetta un momento... erano loro il carico segreto?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|	Katya explains, "The Andersons are defecting to the Free Worlds. Their dream is to make terraforming a public service, supported by government funds, rather than a luxury available only to the richest of planets. We worked for years to get Parliament to accept that idea, but with no luck. And because of Henry's background and knowledge about the intelligence community, the Republic would have stopped them if they knew they were defecting."|1456|0
units.english: Katya explains, "The Andersons are defecting to the Free Worlds. Their dream is to make terraforming a public service, supported by government funds, rather than a luxury available only to the richest of planets. We worked for years to get Parliament to accept that idea, but with no luck. And because of Henry's background and knowledge about the intelligence community, the Republic would have stopped them if they knew they were defecting."
units.italian: Katya spiega: "Gli Anderson stanno passando dalla parte delle Free Worlds. Il loro sogno è rendere il terraformaggio un servizio pubblico, finanziato dal governo, invece di un lusso riservato ai pianeti più ricchi. Abbiamo lavorato per anni perché il Parlamento accettasse quell'idea, ma senza successo. E a causa del passato di Henry e delle sue conoscenze sull'ambiente dell'intelligence, la Repubblica li avrebbe fermati se avesse saputo che stavano defezionando."
