units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|	She adds, "The real secret cargo, which arrived several days ago via a faster ship, was their personal possessions and Lynn's lab equipment and instruments, which were loaded onto a ship supposedly bound for Hestia."|1457|0
units.english: She adds, "The real secret cargo, which arrived several days ago via a faster ship, was their personal possessions and Lynn's lab equipment and instruments, which were loaded onto a ship supposedly bound for Hestia."
units.italian: Aggiunge: "Il vero carico segreto, che è arrivato diversi giorni fa con una nave più veloce, erano i loro beni personali e le attrezzature e gli strumenti di laboratorio di Lynn, caricati su una nave diretta, ufficialmente, verso Hestia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|	"We had just rented a cottage there," says Henry, "saying we were downsizing. We'll lose the security deposit, of course, but it gave us an excuse to pack up and move."|1458|0
units.english: "We had just rented a cottage there," says Henry, "saying we were downsizing. We'll lose the security deposit, of course, but it gave us an excuse to pack up and move."
units.italian: "Avevamo appena affittato un cottage là," dice Henry, "dicendo che ci riducevamo a una casa più piccola. Perderemo la caparra, naturalmente, ma ci ha dato una scusa per fare i bagagli e trasferirci."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1B|	Katya says, "You might not guess it from the outfit he's wearing, but Henry is an absolute mastermind at subtlety and misdirection. He planned the whole thing." She hands you a credit chip for <payment>. "Thanks so much for your help. If you're willing to continue helping the Free Worlds, meet me in the spaceport bar in half an hour."|1459|0
units.english: Katya says, "You might not guess it from the outfit he's wearing, but Henry is an absolute mastermind at subtlety and misdirection. He planned the whole thing." She hands you a credit chip for <payment>. "Thanks so much for your help. If you're willing to continue helping the Free Worlds, meet me in the spaceport bar in half an hour."
units.italian: Katya dice: "Non lo diresti dall'abbigliamento che indossa, ma Henry è un vero genio della sottigliezza e del depistaggio. Ha organizzato tutto lui." Ti porge un chip di credito per <payment>. "Grazie mille per l'aiuto. Se sei disposto a continuare ad aiutare le Free Worlds, incontrami al bar dello spazioporto fra mezz'ora."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|When you land on <origin> and open your ship's main hatch, you find yourself facing a Navy officer with several armed guards in tow. He says, "Sorry captain, but you've been selected for a random cargo screening."|1476|0
units.english: When you land on <origin> and open your ship's main hatch, you find yourself facing a Navy officer with several armed guards in tow. He says, "Sorry captain, but you've been selected for a random cargo screening."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin> e apri il portello principale della nave, ti trovi davanti un ufficiale della Marina con diverse guardie armate al seguito. Dice: "Mi dispiace, capitano, ma è stato selezionato per un controllo casuale del carico."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	(Let them in.)|1478|0
units.english: (Let them in.)
units.italian: (Lasciali entrare.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	(Attack them.)|1480|0
units.english: (Attack them.)
units.italian: (Attaccali.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	(Shut the hatch and escape into space.)|1481|0
units.english: (Shut the hatch and escape into space.)
units.italian: (Chiudi il portello e fuggi nello spazio.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	You draw your gun while screaming "Death to all tyrants!" The officer shouts in alarm and dives out of the way. His companions, who turn out to be wearing body armor, open fire. You die quickly. Katya will be very disappointed.|1484|0
units.english: You draw your gun while screaming "Death to all tyrants!" The officer shouts in alarm and dives out of the way. His companions, who turn out to be wearing body armor, open fire. You die quickly. Katya will be very disappointed.
units.italian: Estrai la pistola urlando "Morte a tutti i tiranni!" L'ufficiale grida allarmato e si butta di lato. I suoi compagni, che si scoprono indossare giubbotti antiproiettile, aprono il fuoco. Muori in fretta. Katya sarà molto delusa.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	You slam the hatch shut in their faces, quickly fire up your engines, and flee for the sky. Before you have even broken out of the atmosphere, your communicator picks up a broadcast message marking you as a wanted criminal. Also, your radar informs you that several Navy vessels are on your tail.|1488|0
units.english: You slam the hatch shut in their faces, quickly fire up your engines, and flee for the sky. Before you have even broken out of the atmosphere, your communicator picks up a broadcast message marking you as a wanted criminal. Also, your radar informs you that several Navy vessels are on your tail.
units.italian: Sbattici il portello in faccia, accendi in fretta i motori e fuggi verso il cielo. Prima ancora di essere uscito dall'atmosfera, il tuo comunicatore capta un messaggio che ti segnala come ricercato. Inoltre il radar ti informa che diverse navi della Marina ti stanno alle calcagna.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	You let the officer and his companions into your cargo bay. They immediately zero in on the crates that were loaded up during the night. One of the guards runs a quick scan and says, "No explosives, no radiation."|1492|0
units.english: You let the officer and his companions into your cargo bay. They immediately zero in on the crates that were loaded up during the night. One of the guards runs a quick scan and says, "No explosives, no radiation."
units.italian: Fai entrare l'ufficiale e i suoi compagni nella stiva. Si dirigono subito verso le casse caricate durante la notte. Una delle guardie fa una scansione veloce e dice: "Niente esplosivi, niente radiazioni."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	The Navy officer says, "Would you mind telling us what's in these crates?"|1493|0
units.english: The Navy officer says, "Would you mind telling us what's in these crates?"
units.italian: L'ufficiale della Marina dice: "Le dispiace dirci che cosa c'è in queste casse?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"Just medical supplies. Surgical gear, mostly."|1495|0
units.english: "Just medical supplies. Surgical gear, mostly."
units.italian: "Solo rifornimenti medici. Per lo più strumenti chirurgici."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"Just some secret illegal things."|1496|0
units.english: "Just some secret illegal things."
units.italian: "Solo un po' di cose segrete e illegali."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"I've never seen those crates before in my life. I don't know where they came from."|1498|0
units.english: "I've never seen those crates before in my life. I don't know where they came from."
units.italian: "Non ho mai visto quelle casse in vita mia. Non so da dove vengano."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"Any biological material or restricted medications?" he asks.|1501|0
units.english: "Any biological material or restricted medications?" he asks.
units.italian: "Materiale biologico o farmaci soggetti a restrizioni?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"No, sir," you say.|1502|0
units.english: "No, sir," you say.
units.italian: "No, signore," dici.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	He laughs. "Sorry," he says, "you probably think we're just being paranoid, but rules are rules." Clearly he took what you said as a joke.|1506|0
units.english: He laughs. "Sorry," he says, "you probably think we're just being paranoid, but rules are rules." Clearly he took what you said as a joke.
units.italian: Ride. "Mi dispiace," dice, "probabilmente pensa che siamo solo paranoici, ma le regole sono regole." Chiaramente ha preso la tua risposta come uno scherzo.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	He frowns. "We're going to have to frisk you," he says. One of the guards pats you down and takes your gun and your pocketknife. "Have a seat," says the officer. They force you to sit on the ground, and one of the guards points a very large gun at you.|1510|0
units.english: He frowns. "We're going to have to frisk you," he says. One of the guards pats you down and takes your gun and your pocketknife. "Have a seat," says the officer. They force you to sit on the ground, and one of the guards points a very large gun at you.
units.italian: Si acciglia. "Dovremo perquisirla," dice. Una delle guardie ti palpa e ti prende la pistola e il coltellino tascabile. "Si accomodi," dice l'ufficiale. Ti costringono a sederti per terra, e una delle guardie ti punta contro un fucile molto grande.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	He says, "I'm afraid we're going to have to search these crates." The guards grab a couple of crowbars and begin prying the lids off them. The contents turn out to be relatively innocuous, although one box full of scalpels and other surgical implements gives them pause. As they open crate after crate without finding anything incriminating, you can tell the officer is getting more and more frustrated and uncomfortable. When the last crate turns out to contain nothing but bandages and gauze pads, his frustration turns to embarrassment. They re-pack the crates and nail the lids back on.|1514|0
units.english: He says, "I'm afraid we're going to have to search these crates." The guards grab a couple of crowbars and begin prying the lids off them. The contents turn out to be relatively innocuous, although one box full of scalpels and other surgical implements gives them pause. As they open crate after crate without finding anything incriminating, you can tell the officer is getting more and more frustrated and uncomfortable. When the last crate turns out to contain nothing but bandages and gauze pads, his frustration turns to embarrassment. They re-pack the crates and nail the lids back on.
units.italian: Dice: "Temo che dovremo perquisire queste casse." Le guardie prendono un paio di piedi di porco e cominciano a scoperchiarle. Il contenuto si rivela relativamente innocuo, anche se una scatola piena di bisturi e altri strumenti chirurgici li fa esitare. Mentre aprono cassa dopo cassa senza trovare niente di compromettente, ti accorgi che l'ufficiale è sempre più frustrato e a disagio. Quando l'ultima cassa si rivela contenere solo bende e garze, la sua frustrazione diventa imbarazzo. Richiudono le casse e inchiodano di nuovo i coperchi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"I'm sorry," says the officer, "we must have been responding to a bad tip. I'm very sorry for this invasion of your privacy, Captain."|1515|0
units.english: "I'm sorry," says the officer, "we must have been responding to a bad tip. I'm very sorry for this invasion of your privacy, Captain."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace," dice l'ufficiale, "dobbiamo aver reagito a una soffiata sbagliata. Mi dispiace molto per questa invasione della sua privacy, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"Never mind, I know you're just doing your job."|1517|0
units.english: "Never mind, I know you're just doing your job."
units.italian: "Non importa, so che sta solo facendo il suo lavoro."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"Since when has the Republic gotten so heavy handed about searching civilian ships?"|1518|0
units.english: "Since when has the Republic gotten so heavy handed about searching civilian ships?"
units.italian: "Da quando la Repubblica è diventata così manesca nel perquisire le navi civili?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"You are very gracious, Captain. We will not detain you any longer." They leave.|1521|0
units.english: "You are very gracious, Captain. We will not detain you any longer." They leave.
units.italian: "È molto cortese, Capitano. Non la tratteniamo oltre." Se ne vanno.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 1C|	"I am sorry, Captain. Since the terrorist attacks everyone has been on edge. I hope you won't think badly of us." They leave.|1525|0
units.english: "I am sorry, Captain. Since the terrorist attacks everyone has been on edge. I hope you won't think badly of us." They leave.
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, Capitano. Dopo gli attentati tutti sono nervosi. Spero che non penserà male di noi." Se ne vanno.

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|name|1542|0
units.english: Transport Mr. Eyes
units.italian: Trasporta Mr. Eyes

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|description|1543|0
units.english: Katya Reynolds asked you to travel to <destination>, where her friend Mr. Eyes is waiting for you.
units.italian: Katya Reynolds ti ha chiesto di andare su <destination>, dove ti aspetta il suo amico Mr. Eyes.

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|log|1557|0
units.english: Turned down a mission from the Free Worlds officer who threatened me. If they want someone to help them, they can look somewhere else.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato una missione dall'ufficiale delle Free Worlds che ti ha minacciato. Se vogliono qualcuno che li aiuti, possono cercare altrove.

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|As you are walking through the spaceport, someone calls out, "Captain <last>!" A Free Worlds officer is approaching you; you recognize her as the same woman who pulled a gun on you earlier as a way to "test" you. "I apologize for pulling that trick on you before," she says. "My name is Katya Reynolds. I've heard really good things about you from some other members of the Free Worlds Council, and I'm hoping you'd reconsider working with me."|1562|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, someone calls out, "Captain <last>!" A Free Worlds officer is approaching you; you recognize her as the same woman who pulled a gun on you earlier as a way to "test" you. "I apologize for pulling that trick on you before," she says. "My name is Katya Reynolds. I've heard really good things about you from some other members of the Free Worlds Council, and I'm hoping you'd reconsider working with me."
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, qualcuno chiama: "Capitano <last>!" Ti si avvicina un'ufficiale delle Free Worlds; la riconosci: è la stessa donna che prima ti ha puntato una pistola per "mettersi alla prova". "Mi scuso per quel trucco di prima," dice. "Mi chiamo Katya Reynolds. Ho sentito parlare molto bene di te da altri membri del Consiglio delle Free Worlds, e spero che tu voglia riconsiderare l'idea di lavorare con me."

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|	"Okay, as long as you don't point any more guns at me."|1564|0
units.english: "Okay, as long as you don't point any more guns at me."
units.italian: "Va bene, purché tu non mi punti più nessuna pistola addosso."

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|	"No. I just don't like you. Or the Free Worlds."|1565|0
units.english: "No. I just don't like you. Or the Free Worlds."
units.italian: "No. Semplicemente non mi piaci tu. Né le Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|	"Great," she says. "Here's the deal. I have a friend named Mr. Eyes, who needs a lift from <destination>. For his safety, I'd rather not tell you anything about his work, but I assure you he's an upstanding citizen. A little unpopular with big corporations and certain corrupt local governments, though. Can you give him a lift?"|1567|0
units.english: "Great," she says. "Here's the deal. I have a friend named Mr. Eyes, who needs a lift from <destination>. For his safety, I'd rather not tell you anything about his work, but I assure you he's an upstanding citizen. A little unpopular with big corporations and certain corrupt local governments, though. Can you give him a lift?"
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Il punto è questo. Ho un amico di nome Mr. Eyes, che ha bisogno di un passaggio da <destination>. Per la sua sicurezza preferirei non dirti niente del suo lavoro, ma ti assicuro che è un cittadino irreprensibile. Un po' impopolare presso le grandi aziende e certi governi locali corrotti, questo sì. Puoi dargli un passaggio?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|	"Sure, I would be glad to."|1569|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to."
units.italian: "Certo, con piacere."

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|	"This sounds too shady. Find someone else to help you."|1571|0
units.english: "This sounds too shady. Find someone else to help you."
units.italian: "Mi sembra troppo losco. Trova qualcun altro che ti aiuti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya Alt 2|dialog|1575|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but your escort with room for Mr. Eyes hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma la tua scorta con lo spazio per Mr. Eyes non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2|name|1582|0
units.english: Transport Mr. Eyes
units.italian: Trasporta Mr. Eyes

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2|description|1583|0
units.english: Katya Reynolds asked you to travel to <destination>, where her friend Mr. Eyes is waiting for you.
units.italian: Katya Reynolds ti ha chiesto di andare su <destination>, dove ti aspetta il suo amico Mr. Eyes.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2|When you enter the bar, Katya waves you over to her table. "I've got another friend who needs to be transported," she says. "This one is on a boondock planet near the Core right now."|1594|0
units.english: When you enter the bar, Katya waves you over to her table. "I've got another friend who needs to be transported," she says. "This one is on a boondock planet near the Core right now."
units.italian: Quando entri nel bar, Katya ti fa cenno di avvicinarti al suo tavolo. "Ho un altro amico che ha bisogno di essere trasportato," dice. "Questo è su un pianeta sperduto vicino al Nucleo, al momento."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2|	"Sure, I'd be glad to transport him."|1596|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to transport him."
units.italian: "Certo, sarò lieto di trasportarlo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2|	"Sorry, but I've decided working for the Free Worlds just isn't worth the risk."|1597|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I've decided working for the Free Worlds just isn't worth the risk."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma ho deciso che lavorare per le Free Worlds non vale il rischio."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2|	"Great!" she says. "His name is Mr. Eyes, and he'll meet you on <destination>. For his safety, I'd rather not tell you anything about his work, but I assure you he's an upstanding citizen. A little unpopular with big corporations and certain corrupt planetary governments, though."|1600|0
units.english: "Great!" she says. "His name is Mr. Eyes, and he'll meet you on <destination>. For his safety, I'd rather not tell you anything about his work, but I assure you he's an upstanding citizen. A little unpopular with big corporations and certain corrupt planetary governments, though."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice. "Si chiama Mr. Eyes, e ti incontrerà su <destination>. Per la sua sicurezza preferirei non dirti niente del suo lavoro, ma ti assicuro che è un cittadino irreprensibile. Un po' impopolare presso le grandi aziende e certi governi planetari corrotti, questo sì."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2|dialog|1604|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but your escort with room for Mr. Eyes hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma la tua scorta con lo spazio per Mr. Eyes non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|name|1610|0
units.english: Transport Mr. Eyes
units.italian: Trasporta Mr. Eyes

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|description|1611|0
units.english: Transport Mr. Eyes to <destination>, where the recent terrorist attack took place.
units.italian: Trasporta Mr. Eyes fino a <destination>, dove è avvenuto il recente attentato.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|log|1622|0
units.english: A former member of Parliament representing the impoverished Dirt Belt worlds, Katya is now a leader in the Free Worlds movement. She is well-known for standing up for the "common people" when they are being overlooked or mistreated by the government or by corporations.
units.italian: Ex membro del Parlamento in rappresentanza dei mondi impoveriti della Fascia di Terra, Katya è ora una leader del movimento delle Free Worlds. È nota per difendere la "gente comune" quando viene trascurata o maltrattata dal governo o dalle aziende.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|log|1623|0
units.english: Also known as "Mr. Eyes," Ijs worked for years as a self-appointed "vigilante nuclear power plant inspector," trying to catch and report environmental abuses that the government officials were turning a blind eye to. He has now agreed to join the Free Worlds movement.
units.italian: Noto anche come "Mr. Eyes", Ijs ha lavorato per anni come "ispettore nucleare autonomo", cercando di scoprire e denunciare gli abusi ambientali che i funzionari governativi fingevano di non vedere. Ora ha accettato di unirsi al movimento delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|As soon as you land and open your ship's hatch, a man wearing sunglasses and a ridiculous hat and carrying a large metal suitcase runs past you and into your ship, casting a quick furtive glance behind him to see if anyone is following.|1625|0
units.english: As soon as you land and open your ship's hatch, a man wearing sunglasses and a ridiculous hat and carrying a large metal suitcase runs past you and into your ship, casting a quick furtive glance behind him to see if anyone is following.
units.italian: Appena atterri e apri il portello della nave, un uomo con gli occhiali da sole, un cappello ridicolo e una grande valigia di metallo ti passa accanto di corsa ed entra nella nave, lanciando una rapida occhiata furtiva alle spalle per vedere se qualcuno lo segua.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	(Draw my weapon to defend myself against him.)|1627|0
units.english: (Draw my weapon to defend myself against him.)
units.italian: (Estrai l'arma per difendermi da lui.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	(Quickly shut the hatch and find out if he is okay.)|1628|0
units.english: (Quickly shut the hatch and find out if he is okay.)
units.italian: (Chiudi in fretta il portello e scopri se sta bene.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	You shut the hatch to keep anyone else from boarding your ship uninvited, then confront him. "Who are you and what are you doing on my ship?" you ask.|1631|0
units.english: You shut the hatch to keep anyone else from boarding your ship uninvited, then confront him. "Who are you and what are you doing on my ship?" you ask.
units.italian: Chiudi il portello per impedire a chiunque altro di salire senza invito, poi lo affronti. "Chi sei e che cosa ci fai sulla mia nave?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	You shut the hatch to keep anyone else from boarding your ship, then turn around to find out who your visitor is. "My name is <first>," you say. "How can I help you?"|1635|0
units.english: You shut the hatch to keep anyone else from boarding your ship, then turn around to find out who your visitor is. "My name is <first>," you say. "How can I help you?"
units.italian: Chiudi il portello per impedire a chiunque altro di salire, poi ti giri per scoprire chi sia il tuo visitatore. "Mi chiamo <first>," dici. "Come posso aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"I'm Ijs Springborn," he says, pronouncing the name like "Eyes." He takes off the glasses and hat. "Councilor Reynolds told me to meet you here."|1638|0
units.english: "I'm Ijs Springborn," he says, pronouncing the name like "Eyes." He takes off the glasses and hat. "Councilor Reynolds told me to meet you here."
units.italian: "Sono Ijs Springborn," dice, pronunciando il nome come "Eyes". Si toglie gli occhiali e il cappello. "La consigliera Reynolds mi ha detto di incontrarti qui."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"Wait, 'Councilor' Reynolds? You mean Katya is in Parliament?"|1640|0
units.english: "Wait, 'Councilor' Reynolds? You mean Katya is in Parliament?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, 'consigliera' Reynolds? Vuoi dire che Katya è in Parlamento?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	He looks genuinely shocked. "You didn't know? That woman is a legend. Did two terms representing the Dirt Belt. Defender of small worlds and the common people. In some circles her work has made her almost as unpopular as me. But she got tired of working for reform and decided to create her own government instead."|1642|0
units.english: He looks genuinely shocked. "You didn't know? That woman is a legend. Did two terms representing the Dirt Belt. Defender of small worlds and the common people. In some circles her work has made her almost as unpopular as me. But she got tired of working for reform and decided to create her own government instead."
units.italian: Sembra davvero scioccato. "Non lo sapevi? Quella donna è una leggenda. Ha fatto due mandati in rappresentanza della Fascia di Terra. Difensore dei piccoli mondi e della gente comune. In certi ambienti il suo lavoro l'ha resa quasi impopolare quanto me. Ma si è stancata di lavorare per le riforme e ha deciso di creare un governo tutto suo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"And what do you do for work?" you ask.|1643|0
units.english: "And what do you do for work?" you ask.
units.italian: "E tu che lavoro fai?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"Vigilante nuclear power plant inspector," he says, nonchalantly.|1644|0
units.english: "Vigilante nuclear power plant inspector," he says, nonchalantly.
units.italian: "Ispettore nucleare autonomo," dice, con nonchalance.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"Um... what?"|1646|0
units.english: "Um... what?"
units.italian: "Ehm... come?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"How does that even work?"|1647|0
units.english: "How does that even work?"
units.italian: "E come funzionerebbe, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"Is that even legal?"|1648|0
units.english: "Is that even legal?"
units.italian: "È anche legale?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"I go from world to world checking out plant emissions, to see if they're leaking isotopes into the air, the sea, or the groundwater. And if they are I sic the Department of Atomic Safety on them. The Syndicate hates my guts right now."|1650|0
units.english: "I go from world to world checking out plant emissions, to see if they're leaking isotopes into the air, the sea, or the groundwater. And if they are I sic the Department of Atomic Safety on them. The Syndicate hates my guts right now."
units.italian: "Vado di mondo in mondo a controllare le emissioni degli impianti, per vedere se perdono isotopi nell'aria, nel mare o nelle falde acquifere. E se lo fanno, gli mando contro il Dipartimento per la Sicurezza Atomica. Il Sindacato mi odia con tutto il cuore, in questo momento."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"So, what has Katya asked you to do for the Free Worlds?" you ask.|1651|0
units.english: "So, what has Katya asked you to do for the Free Worlds?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora, che cosa ti ha chiesto Katya di fare per le Free Worlds?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"Isn't it obvious?" he says. "We're going to hunt down certain naughty people who have been developing nuclear weapons, and the Free Worlds will turn them over to the Republic. Then the Republic will know that the Free Worlds weren't behind the attacks, and we'll stop this whole mess before it devolves into a civil war."|1652|0
units.english: "Isn't it obvious?" he says. "We're going to hunt down certain naughty people who have been developing nuclear weapons, and the Free Worlds will turn them over to the Republic. Then the Republic will know that the Free Worlds weren't behind the attacks, and we'll stop this whole mess before it devolves into a civil war."
units.italian: "Non è ovvio?" dice. "Diamo la caccia a certi personaggi poco raccomandabili che stanno sviluppando armi nucleari, e le Free Worlds li consegneranno alla Repubblica. Così la Repubblica saprà che non sono state le Free Worlds a fare gli attentati, e fermeremo tutto questo pasticcio prima che degeneri in una guerra civile."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"So, you're convinced that the Free Worlds are innocent?"|1654|0
units.english: "So, you're convinced that the Free Worlds are innocent?"
units.italian: "Quindi sei convinto che le Free Worlds siano innocenti?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"Okay, what's our plan to do that?"|1655|0
units.english: "Okay, what's our plan to do that?"
units.italian: "Va bene, e qual è il nostro piano per farlo?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"Absolutely," he says. "It makes no sense. First of all, that attack hurt their cause more than it helped it. And second, I've known Katerina and her friends in the Free Worlds for a long time. There's no way they would agree to such a thing. So, whoever is responsible is out there somewhere, and the Free Worlds will bring them to justice."|1658|0
units.english: "Absolutely," he says. "It makes no sense. First of all, that attack hurt their cause more than it helped it. And second, I've known Katerina and her friends in the Free Worlds for a long time. There's no way they would agree to such a thing. So, whoever is responsible is out there somewhere, and the Free Worlds will bring them to justice."
units.italian: "Assolutamente," dice. "Non ha alcun senso. Prima di tutto, quell'attacco ha danneggiato la loro causa più di quanto l'abbia aiutata. E secondo, conosco Katerina e i suoi amici delle Free Worlds da molto tempo. Non accetterebbero mai una cosa del genere. Quindi chi è responsabile è là fuori da qualche parte, e le Free Worlds lo porteranno davanti alla giustizia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"Well, then, what's our plan?"|1660|0
units.english: "Well, then, what's our plan?"
units.italian: "Beh, allora qual è il nostro piano?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|	"First," he says, "we need to go to Geminus, where the attack happened. I can explain more when we get there. In the meantime, I should also warn you that I seem to have terrible luck with pirates showing up wherever I go. It's almost like someone has put a price on my head." He grins.|1663|0
units.english: "First," he says, "we need to go to Geminus, where the attack happened. I can explain more when we get there. In the meantime, I should also warn you that I seem to have terrible luck with pirates showing up wherever I go. It's almost like someone has put a price on my head." He grins.
units.italian: "Primo," dice, "dobbiamo andare su Geminus, dove è avvenuto l'attacco. Potrò spiegarti di più quando saremo là. Nel frattempo devo anche avvertirti che sembro avere una sfortuna terribile: i pirati compaiono ovunque io vada. È quasi come se qualcuno avesse messo una taglia sulla mia testa." Sorride.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|log|1667|0
units.english: Met up with a friend of Katya's named Mr. Eyes, who calls himself a "vigilante nuclear power plant inspector." He thinks he can help hunt down the people who bombed Geminus and Martini, to prove that the Free Worlds were not behind it.
units.italian: Ti sei incontrato con un'amica di Katya di nome Mr. Eyes, che si definisce "ispettore nucleare autonomo". Pensa di poter aiutare a dare la caccia a chi ha bombardato Geminus e Martini, per dimostrare che le Free Worlds non c'entravano.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2B|dialog|1675|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Mr. Eyes is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Mr. Eyes è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2C|name|1681|0
units.english: Transport Mr. Eyes
units.italian: Trasporta Mr. Eyes

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2C|description|1682|0
units.english: Bring Mr. Eyes to <destination>, where you will meet up with Katya (and hopefully get paid).
units.italian: Porta Mr. Eyes fino a <destination>, dove incontrerai Katya (e speriamo ti paghi).

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2C|It turns out that the suitcase Mr. Eyes is carrying is full of portable sensors. He fires them up while explaining to you what he is doing. "Each world, and even each mine, has a slightly different mix of isotopes in their fissionable elements," he explains. "So what I'm doing right now is almost like taking a fingerprint. Once we've got it, we can try to find a match on another planet. I'd be willing to bet the material just came from a civilian reactor core, so tracking it back to the mine wouldn't necessarily incriminate anyone. But developing nukes is tricky, so they probably did tests. And if we can find the test site, that may lead us to the perpetrators."|1693|0
units.english: It turns out that the suitcase Mr. Eyes is carrying is full of portable sensors. He fires them up while explaining to you what he is doing. "Each world, and even each mine, has a slightly different mix of isotopes in their fissionable elements," he explains. "So what I'm doing right now is almost like taking a fingerprint. Once we've got it, we can try to find a match on another planet. I'd be willing to bet the material just came from a civilian reactor core, so tracking it back to the mine wouldn't necessarily incriminate anyone. But developing nukes is tricky, so they probably did tests. And if we can find the test site, that may lead us to the perpetrators."
units.italian: Salta fuori che la valigia che Mr. Eyes porta con sé è piena di sensori portatili. Li accende mentre ti spiega che cosa sta facendo. "Ogni mondo, e persino ogni miniera, ha una miscela leggermente diversa di isotopi nei suoi elementi fissili," spiega. "Quindi quello che sto facendo adesso è più o meno come prendere un'impronta digitale. Una volta che l'abbiamo, possiamo cercare una corrispondenza su un altro pianeta. Scommetterei che il materiale viene semplicemente dal nucleo di un reattore civile, quindi risalire alla miniera non incriminerebbe necessariamente nessuno. Ma sviluppare ordigni nucleari è complicato, quindi probabilmente hanno fatto dei test. E se troviamo il sito dei test, questo può portarci ai responsabili."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2C|	A few minutes later, his measurements are done. "Got it," he says. "Time to start hunting. Katya said to meet up with her on <planet>. It's not our best bet, but it's on the list of suspects."|1694|0
units.english: A few minutes later, his measurements are done. "Got it," he says. "Time to start hunting. Katya said to meet up with her on <planet>. It's not our best bet, but it's on the list of suspects."
units.italian: Pochi minuti dopo, le sue misurazioni sono finite. "Fatto," dice. "È ora di cominciare la caccia. Katya ha detto di incontrarla su <planet>. Non è la nostra pista migliore, ma è sulla lista dei sospetti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2C|dialog|1698|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Mr. Eyes is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Mr. Eyes è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2C|As soon as you land, Mr. Eyes fires up his sensors and begins collecting data. A few minutes later, Katya shows up. "Eyes!" she says. "It's great to see you again."|1702|0
units.english: As soon as you land, Mr. Eyes fires up his sensors and begins collecting data. A few minutes later, Katya shows up. "Eyes!" she says. "It's great to see you again."
units.italian: Appena atterri, Mr. Eyes accende i sensori e comincia a raccogliere dati. Pochi minuti dopo arriva Katya. "Eyes!" dice. "Che bello rivederti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2C|	"You too, Councilor," he says.|1703|0
units.english: "You too, Councilor," he says.
units.italian: "Anche per me, consigliera," dice lui.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 2C|	Katya hands you a credit chip for another <payment>. "Thanks again, Captain. Did Eyes explain the plan to you?" You nod. "Well," she says, "if you've got space for the two of us and want to be a part of seeing justice done, let's meet up in the spaceport once Eyes is done analyzing his data."|1704|0
units.english: Katya hands you a credit chip for another <payment>. "Thanks again, Captain. Did Eyes explain the plan to you?" You nod. "Well," she says, "if you've got space for the two of us and want to be a part of seeing justice done, let's meet up in the spaceport once Eyes is done analyzing his data."
units.italian: Katya ti porge un chip di credito per altri <payment>. "Grazie ancora, Capitano. Eyes ti ha spiegato il piano?" Annuisci. "Beh," dice, "se hai spazio per noi due e vuoi far parte di questa storia di giustizia, incontriamoci allo spazioporto quando Eyes ha finito di analizzare i suoi dati."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|name|1709|0
units.english: Drone Hunting
units.italian: Caccia ai droni

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|description|1710|0
units.english: Disable a surveillance drone (ideally when no Cruisers are watching), board it, "salvage" its surveillance equipment, and return to <destination>. (Until you leave the system where you disabled the drone, other Republic ships may attack you.)
units.italian: Metti fuori uso un drone da sorveglianza (idealmente quando nessun incrociatore sta guardando), abbordalo, "recupera" il suo equipaggiamento di sorveglianza e torna a <destination>. (Finché non lasci il sistema dove hai messo fuori uso il drone, altre navi della Repubblica potrebbero attaccarti.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|log|1717|0
units.english: Rejected an ill-conceived mission from Katya and Eyes to plunder Republic property.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato una missione mal concepita di Katya ed Eyes per saccheggiare proprietà della Repubblica.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|You find Eyes and Katya sitting in the shade of one of the few trees in the port, drinking some sort of frozen milkshakes while they stare out at the desert and talk in hushed voices. When you join them, Katya says, "I was just filling Eyes in on the Navy's recent fleet mobilization. Half the Dirt Belt is swarming with Cruisers and surveillance drones right now. It's hard to believe that we can find the attackers before they do, unless they're somewhere the Navy hasn't thought to look."|1722|0
units.english: You find Eyes and Katya sitting in the shade of one of the few trees in the port, drinking some sort of frozen milkshakes while they stare out at the desert and talk in hushed voices. When you join them, Katya says, "I was just filling Eyes in on the Navy's recent fleet mobilization. Half the Dirt Belt is swarming with Cruisers and surveillance drones right now. It's hard to believe that we can find the attackers before they do, unless they're somewhere the Navy hasn't thought to look."
units.italian: Trovi Eyes e Katya seduti all'ombra di uno dei pochi alberi del porto, che bevono una specie di frullato ghiacciato mentre guardano il deserto e parlano a voce bassa. Quando ti unisci a loro, Katya dice: "Stavo solo aggiornando Eyes sulla recente mobilitazione della flotta della Marina. Metà della Fascia di Terra brulica di incrociatori e droni da sorveglianza, in questo momento. È difficile credere che possiamo trovare gli attentatori prima di loro, a meno che non siano da qualche parte dove la Marina non ha pensato di guardare."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Agreed," says Eyes, "and to make matters worse, their sensors are probably much better than mine."|1723|0
units.english: "Agreed," says Eyes, "and to make matters worse, their sensors are probably much better than mine."
units.italian: "D'accordo," dice Eyes, "e per peggiorare le cose, i loro sensori sono probabilmente molto migliori dei miei."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	Katya appears to be struck by a sudden idea. "The sensors on their drones," she says, "their unmanned drones..."|1724|0
units.english: Katya appears to be struck by a sudden idea. "The sensors on their drones," she says, "their unmanned drones..."
units.italian: Katya sembra colpita da un'idea improvvisa. "I sensori dei loro droni," dice, "i loro droni senza equipaggio..."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	Eyes glances at her, sees her expression, and says, "No, Councilor, don't even think of it. That's a horrible idea."|1725|0
units.english: Eyes glances at her, sees her expression, and says, "No, Councilor, don't even think of it. That's a horrible idea."
units.italian: Eyes le lancia un'occhiata, vede la sua espressione e dice: "No, consigliera, non pensarci nemmeno. È un'idea orribile."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"No," she says, "it's brilliant. Captain <last>, are you familiar with the Dereliction and Salvage Act of 2976?"|1726|0
units.english: "No," she says, "it's brilliant. Captain <last>, are you familiar with the Dereliction and Salvage Act of 2976?"
units.italian: "No," dice lei, "è geniale. Capitano <last>, conosci la Legge sull'abbandono e il recupero del 2976?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"No, I've never heard of it."|1728|0
units.english: "No, I've never heard of it."
units.italian: "No, non ne ho mai sentito parlare."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Of course. I read parliamentary proceedings every night when I'm trying to fall asleep."|1730|0
units.english: "Of course. I read parliamentary proceedings every night when I'm trying to fall asleep."
units.italian: "Certo. Leggo gli atti parlamentari ogni sera, quando cerco di prendere sonno."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Well then," she says, "you'll probably agree that legally speaking, Navy surveillance drones count as abandoned goods the moment their owners have left the system."|1732|0
units.english: "Well then," she says, "you'll probably agree that legally speaking, Navy surveillance drones count as abandoned goods the moment their owners have left the system."
units.italian: "Beh, allora," dice, "sarai d'accordo che, giuridicamente parlando, i droni da sorveglianza della Marina contano come beni abbandonati nel momento in cui i loro proprietari hanno lasciato il sistema."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Well," she says, "it started when the Syndicate began experimenting with fully automated mining facilities on uninhabitable planets. Pirates started raiding the mines to steal equipment, and the Syndicate claimed that these installations were 'colonies' and it was the Navy's job to defend them. The Act was Parliament's response, stating that taking goods from a human being is piracy, but if the owner or some living representative of theirs is not present in the system, taking those goods is a legal salvage operation. The point was to keep the Navy from being obligated to defend every equipment cache or abandoned station in the galaxy. But by the same law, those Navy surveillance drones become abandoned goods the moment their motherships leave the system."|1736|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "it started when the Syndicate began experimenting with fully automated mining facilities on uninhabitable planets. Pirates started raiding the mines to steal equipment, and the Syndicate claimed that these installations were 'colonies' and it was the Navy's job to defend them. The Act was Parliament's response, stating that taking goods from a human being is piracy, but if the owner or some living representative of theirs is not present in the system, taking those goods is a legal salvage operation. The point was to keep the Navy from being obligated to defend every equipment cache or abandoned station in the galaxy. But by the same law, those Navy surveillance drones become abandoned goods the moment their motherships leave the system."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "è cominciato quando il Sindacato ha cominciato a sperimentare strutture minerarie completamente automatizzate su pianeti inabitabili. I pirati hanno cominciato a saccheggiare le miniere per rubare l'equipaggiamento, e il Sindacato sosteneva che quegli impianti erano 'colonie' e che spettava alla Marina difenderli. La Legge è stata la risposta del Parlamento: prendere beni da un essere umano è pirateria, ma se il proprietario o un suo rappresentante vivente non è presente nel sistema, prendere quei beni è una legale operazione di recupero. Lo scopo era evitare che la Marina fosse obbligata a difendere ogni deposito di equipaggiamento o stazione abbandonata della galassia. Ma per la stessa legge, quei droni da sorveglianza della Marina diventano beni abbandonati nel momento in cui le loro navi madri lasciano il sistema."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Yup. That makes perfect sense to me."|1740|0
units.english: "Yup. That makes perfect sense to me."
units.italian: "Già. Per me ha perfettamente senso."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"So first you have me smuggling people across the galaxy, and now you want me to attack Navy ships? Next you'll ask me to start taking prisoners."|1742|0
units.english: "So first you have me smuggling people across the galaxy, and now you want me to attack Navy ships? Next you'll ask me to start taking prisoners."
units.italian: "Quindi prima mi fai contrabbandare persone per la galassia, e ora vuoi che attacchi navi della Marina? La prossima volta mi chiederai di fare prigionieri."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"That sounds like a terrible idea."|1743|0
units.english: "That sounds like a terrible idea."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un'idea terribile."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	Eyes laughs, spitting out his milkshake in the process. "We won't be asking you to do anything of that sort," Katya responds somewhat aggressively. "Look, if we want to track down who dropped those bombs then we need to get our hands on better scanning equipment, equipment that the Navy has on their unmanned surveillance drones, and you're the one with a ship unconnected to the Free Worlds. All you need to do is find a lone surveillance drone to plunder. Legally the Navy can't do anything about it, and no one will be hurt in the process. If we succeed in finding who's responsible for the bombings, we could prevent war between the Republic and the Free Worlds, saving thousands or even potentially millions of lives. So are you with us or not?"|1746|0
units.english: Eyes laughs, spitting out his milkshake in the process. "We won't be asking you to do anything of that sort," Katya responds somewhat aggressively. "Look, if we want to track down who dropped those bombs then we need to get our hands on better scanning equipment, equipment that the Navy has on their unmanned surveillance drones, and you're the one with a ship unconnected to the Free Worlds. All you need to do is find a lone surveillance drone to plunder. Legally the Navy can't do anything about it, and no one will be hurt in the process. If we succeed in finding who's responsible for the bombings, we could prevent war between the Republic and the Free Worlds, saving thousands or even potentially millions of lives. So are you with us or not?"
units.italian: Eyes ride, sputando fuori il frullato mentre lo fa. "Non ti chiederemo niente del genere," risponde Katya, in modo piuttosto aggressivo. "Senti, se vogliamo scoprire chi ha sganciato quelle bombe, dobbiamo mettere le mani su un equipaggiamento di scansione migliore, quello che la Marina tiene sui suoi droni da sorveglianza senza equipaggio, e tu sei quello con una nave non collegata alle Free Worlds. Ti basta trovare un drone da sorveglianza isolato da saccheggiare. Legalmente la Marina non può fare nulla, e nessuno si farà male. Se riusciamo a scoprire chi è responsabile degli attentati, potremmo evitare una guerra fra la Repubblica e le Free Worlds, salvando migliaia o addirittura milioni di vite. Quindi sei con noi o no?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Are you saying we're going to need to find a different captain to work with?" says Katya. "If we want to track down who dropped those bombs then we need to get our hands on better scanning equipment, equipment that the Navy has on their unmanned surveillance drones. All you need to do is find a lone surveillance drone to plunder. Legally the Navy can't do anything about it, and no one will be hurt in the process. If we succeed in finding who's responsible for the bombings, we could prevent war between the Republic and the Free Worlds, saving thousands or even potentially millions of lives. So are you with us or not?"|1750|0
units.english: "Are you saying we're going to need to find a different captain to work with?" says Katya. "If we want to track down who dropped those bombs then we need to get our hands on better scanning equipment, equipment that the Navy has on their unmanned surveillance drones. All you need to do is find a lone surveillance drone to plunder. Legally the Navy can't do anything about it, and no one will be hurt in the process. If we succeed in finding who's responsible for the bombings, we could prevent war between the Republic and the Free Worlds, saving thousands or even potentially millions of lives. So are you with us or not?"
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che dovremo trovare un altro capitano con cui lavorare?" dice Katya. "Se vogliamo scoprire chi ha sganciato quelle bombe, dobbiamo mettere le mani su un equipaggiamento di scansione migliore, quello che la Marina tiene sui suoi droni da sorveglianza senza equipaggio. Ti basta trovare un drone da sorveglianza isolato da saccheggiare. Legalmente la Marina non può fare nulla, e nessuno si farà male. Se riusciamo a scoprire chi è responsabile degli attentati, potremmo evitare una guerra fra la Repubblica e le Free Worlds, salvando migliaia o addirittura milioni di vite. Quindi sei con noi o no?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Fine, I'll do it. But I still think it's an unwise idea."|1753|0
units.english: "Fine, I'll do it. But I still think it's an unwise idea."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo farò. Ma continuo a pensare che sia un'idea poco saggia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Even still, that doesn't justify destroying Navy property. Count me out."|1754|0
units.english: "Even still, that doesn't justify destroying Navy property. Count me out."
units.italian: "Anche così, questo non giustifica distruggere proprietà della Marina. Lasciatemi fuori."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"If this is the sort of reasoning the Free Worlds runs on, then you can kiss goodbye to working with me ever again."|1756|0
units.english: "If this is the sort of reasoning the Free Worlds runs on, then you can kiss goodbye to working with me ever again."
units.italian: "Se è su questo tipo di ragionamento che si reggono le Free Worlds, allora potete dire addio per sempre all'idea di lavorare con me."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	"Great!" says Katya. "All we have to do is disable a drone, board it, yank out the surveillance equipment, and bring it back here to test it out."|1760|0
units.english: "Great!" says Katya. "All we have to do is disable a drone, board it, yank out the surveillance equipment, and bring it back here to test it out."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice Katya. "Dobbiamo solo mettere fuori uso un drone, abbordarlo, strappargli via l'equipaggiamento di sorveglianza e riportarlo qui per provarlo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	Ijs says, "Captain, we should warn you: when you attack a drone, any Republic folks in that system will get mad at you. But once you jump out of the system, they'll calm down again."|1761|0
units.english: Ijs says, "Captain, we should warn you: when you attack a drone, any Republic folks in that system will get mad at you. But once you jump out of the system, they'll calm down again."
units.italian: Ijs dice: "Capitano, dobbiamo avvertirla: quando attaccherai un drone, tutti i Repubblicani in quel sistema si arrabbieranno con te. Ma appena salterai fuori dal sistema si calmeranno di nuovo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|log|1765|0
units.english: Katya's plan for hunting down the nuclear terrorists involves stealing the sensor equipment from a Navy surveillance drone. Supposedly taking equipment from a drone counts as a salvage operation as long as none of its owners are present, due to a legal loophole in an old act of Parliament.
units.italian: Il piano di Katya per dare la caccia ai terroristi nucleari prevede di rubare l'equipaggiamento dei sensori da un drone da sorveglianza della Marina. A quanto pare, prendere l'equipaggiamento da un drone conta come operazione di recupero, purché nessuno dei suoi proprietari sia presente, grazie a una scappatoia legale in un'antica legge del Parlamento.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|dialog|1768|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you don't have a Surveillance Pod. You must disable a Navy surveillance drone and plunder the outfit from it before returning.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non hai una capsula di sorveglianza. Devi mettere fuori uso un drone da sorveglianza della Marina e saccheggiargli l'equipaggiamento prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|You hand over the "salvaged" equipment to Mr. Eyes and Katya. Eyes begins fiddling with it, and soon discovers how to work the atmospheric scanner. "This is really nice stuff!" he says, enthusiastically.|1772|0
units.english: You hand over the "salvaged" equipment to Mr. Eyes and Katya. Eyes begins fiddling with it, and soon discovers how to work the atmospheric scanner. "This is really nice stuff!" he says, enthusiastically.
units.italian: Consegni l'equipaggiamento "recuperato" a Mr. Eyes e a Katya. Eyes comincia a trafficarci e presto scopre come far funzionare lo scanner atmosferico. "Roba davvero ottima!" dice, entusiasta.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 3|	Katya says, "We found a halfway decent restaurant in the spaceport village. If you want to keep working with us, meet us there this evening."|1773|0
units.english: Katya says, "We found a halfway decent restaurant in the spaceport village. If you want to keep working with us, meet us there this evening."
units.italian: Katya dice: "Abbiamo trovato un ristorante decente nel villaggio dello spazioporto. Se vuoi continuare a lavorare con noi, incontraci lì stasera."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|name|1778|0
units.english: Katya and Mr. Eyes
units.italian: Katya e Mr. Eyes

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|description|1779|0
units.english: Stop on <destination> and check the planet for signs of nuclear testing.
units.italian: Fermati su <destination> e controlla il pianeta cercando segni di test nucleari.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|blocked|1783|0
units.english: You need bunks for both Katya and Eyes in order to continue this mission.
units.italian: Ti servono cuccette sia per Katya sia per Eyes per continuare questa missione.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|log|1794|0
units.english: Katya grew up on Hope, a Dirt Belt world that is no longer inhabited because of a supervolcano eruption that triggered a new ice age. Despite her distrust of the Republic she has high regard for the Navy because they were the ones, acting without clearance from Parliament, who helped the settlers on Hope to evacuate safely.
units.italian: Katya è cresciuta su Hope, un mondo della Fascia di Terra non più abitato a causa dell'eruzione di un supervulcano che ha innescato una nuova era glaciale. Nonostante diffidi della Repubblica, ha grande stima della Marina, perché è stata la Marina, agendo senza l'autorizzazione del Parlamento, ad aiutare i coloni di Hope a evacuare in sicurezza.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|You join Katya and Mr. Eyes in the restaurant, and order your meals. They are both in high spirits. While you are waiting for the food to arrive, Mr. Eyes raises his glass of wine and says, "A toast, to Captain <last> and our marvelous new toy. May it bring us good information and swift justice."|1796|0
units.english: You join Katya and Mr. Eyes in the restaurant, and order your meals. They are both in high spirits. While you are waiting for the food to arrive, Mr. Eyes raises his glass of wine and says, "A toast, to Captain <last> and our marvelous new toy. May it bring us good information and swift justice."
units.italian: Raggiungi Katya e Mr. Eyes al ristorante e ordini il tuo pasto. Sono entrambi di ottimo umore. Mentre aspettate che arrivi il cibo, Mr. Eyes alza il bicchiere di vino e dice: "Un brindisi al Capitano <last> e al nostro meraviglioso giocattolo nuovo. Che ci porti buone informazioni e una giustizia rapida."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"We're thinking that while we're in the area, we should stop on <planet> next," says Katya, "and then work our way toward the Rim."|1797|0
units.english: "We're thinking that while we're in the area, we should stop on <planet> next," says Katya, "and then work our way toward the Rim."
units.italian: "Stavamo pensando che, visto che siamo in zona, dovremmo fare tappa su <planet>," dice Katya, "e poi proseguire verso il Bordo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	Your meals arrive. The food is excellent, and you spend a relaxed evening sharing stories of your childhoods. Katya turns out to be a Dirt Belt native<dirt belt origin> from a planet named Hope. "No longer settled," she explains. "Supervolcano. It was a cold planet to start out with, and the eruption sent it into an ice age that could last for millennia. My home town is under thirty meters of glacier by now."|1798|0
units.english: Your meals arrive. The food is excellent, and you spend a relaxed evening sharing stories of your childhoods. Katya turns out to be a Dirt Belt native<dirt belt origin> from a planet named Hope. "No longer settled," she explains. "Supervolcano. It was a cold planet to start out with, and the eruption sent it into an ice age that could last for millennia. My home town is under thirty meters of glacier by now."
units.italian: Arrivano i pasti. Il cibo è ottimo, e passate una serata rilassata raccontandovi le vostre infanzie. Katya viene dalla Fascia di Terra<dirt belt origin>, da un pianeta chiamato Hope. "Non più abitato," spiega. "Un supervulcano. Era già un pianeta freddo all'inizio, e l'eruzione lo ha spinto in un'era glaciale che potrebbe durare millenni. La mia città natale ormai è sotto trenta metri di ghiacciaio."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"Was anyone killed?"|1800|0
units.english: "Was anyone killed?"
units.italian: "È morto qualcuno?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"How did you escape?"|1801|0
units.english: "How did you escape?"
units.italian: "Come sei riuscita a scappare?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"The eruption was on the other continent," she explains, "so no one was killed in the blast. It was a slow-moving disaster. We had six months or so to move two million settlers off-world before the temperatures would drop too low to be livable. More than half of the Navy was mobilized to ferry our people to other planets."|1803|0
units.english: "The eruption was on the other continent," she explains, "so no one was killed in the blast. It was a slow-moving disaster. We had six months or so to move two million settlers off-world before the temperatures would drop too low to be livable. More than half of the Navy was mobilized to ferry our people to other planets."
units.italian: "L'eruzione è stata sull'altro continente," spiega, "quindi nessuno è morto nell'esplosione. È stato un disastro lento. Abbiamo avuto sei mesi circa per spostare due milioni di coloni fuori dal pianeta prima che le temperature scendessero troppo per viverci. Più di metà della Marina è stata mobilitata per trasportare la nostra gente su altri pianeti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"Here's the best part," says Eyes. "The Navy operates with a certain amount of autonomy. Turns out when they found out about the disaster, they mobilized without even waiting to clear it with Parliament. Which was technically within their mandate, this being a natural disaster. But the Navy is funded by taxes, and the Paradise Planets pay ten times as much in taxes as the Dirt Belt."|1804|0
units.english: "Here's the best part," says Eyes. "The Navy operates with a certain amount of autonomy. Turns out when they found out about the disaster, they mobilized without even waiting to clear it with Parliament. Which was technically within their mandate, this being a natural disaster. But the Navy is funded by taxes, and the Paradise Planets pay ten times as much in taxes as the Dirt Belt."
units.italian: "Questa è la parte migliore," dice Eyes. "La Marina opera con una certa autonomia. Salta fuori che, quando hanno saputo del disastro, si sono mobilitati senza nemmeno aspettare l'autorizzazione del Parlamento. Il che era tecnicamente nel loro mandato, trattandosi di un disastro naturale. Ma la Marina è finanziata con le tasse, e i Mondi Paradisiaci pagano dieci volte le tasse della Fascia di Terra."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"The Paradise Planets viewed the Navy as their own private security force," says Katya, "so they got really mad when half the Navy suddenly vanished to assist some dirty refugees. Because those admirals gave the order to assist us, millions of lives were saved. And then Parliament fired them."|1805|0
units.english: "The Paradise Planets viewed the Navy as their own private security force," says Katya, "so they got really mad when half the Navy suddenly vanished to assist some dirty refugees. Because those admirals gave the order to assist us, millions of lives were saved. And then Parliament fired them."
units.italian: "I Mondi Paradisiaci consideravano la Marina una loro forza di sicurezza privata," dice Katya, "quindi si sono arrabbiati moltissimo quando metà della Marina è improvvisamente sparita per assistere dei sudici profughi. E dato che quegli ammiragli hanno dato l'ordine di aiutarci, milioni di vite sono state salvate. E poi il Parlamento li ha licenziati."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"You're making the Navy sound like heroes. I thought they were your enemies."|1807|0
units.english: "You're making the Navy sound like heroes. I thought they were your enemies."
units.italian: "Mi stai facendo sembrare la Marina una banda di eroi. Pensavo che fossero i vostri nemici."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"You've almost convinced me to join the Navy."|1808|0
units.english: "You've almost convinced me to join the Navy."
units.italian: "Mi hai quasi convinto a entrare nella Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"Our fight isn't with the Navy," says Katya. "Most of them are good people. I'm sure they don't want war any more than we do. They're like police officers who are suddenly being asked to fight against the very people they swore to protect and serve."|1810|0
units.english: "Our fight isn't with the Navy," says Katya. "Most of them are good people. I'm sure they don't want war any more than we do. They're like police officers who are suddenly being asked to fight against the very people they swore to protect and serve."
units.italian: "La nostra battaglia non è con la Marina," dice Katya. "La maggior parte di loro sono brave persone. Sono sicura che non vogliono la guerra più di noi. Sono come agenti di polizia a cui improvvisamente viene chiesto di combattere proprio contro le persone che avevano giurato di proteggere e servire."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"I was a child on Vinci while this was happening," says Eyes. "A Paradise World. I would listen to the news and could never understand why all the adults around me were so very, very angry that the Navy had gone off to rescue two million people from freezing to death. But they told me that we lived in one little island of safety in a dangerous galaxy, and that without the Navy protecting us the pirates or even maybe aliens would sweep in and destroy our homes and take our money. That it was us against the whole galaxy."|1811|0
units.english: "I was a child on Vinci while this was happening," says Eyes. "A Paradise World. I would listen to the news and could never understand why all the adults around me were so very, very angry that the Navy had gone off to rescue two million people from freezing to death. But they told me that we lived in one little island of safety in a dangerous galaxy, and that without the Navy protecting us the pirates or even maybe aliens would sweep in and destroy our homes and take our money. That it was us against the whole galaxy."
units.italian: "Io ero un bambino su Vinci mentre succedeva tutto questo," dice Eyes. "Un Mondo Paradisiaco. Ascoltavo le notizie e non riuscivo mai a capire perché tutti gli adulti intorno a me fossero così tanto, tanto arrabbiati perché la Marina se n'era andata a salvare due milioni di persone dal morire assiderate. Ma mi dicevano che vivevamo su una piccola isola di sicurezza in una galassia pericolosa, e che senza la protezione della Marina i pirati o magari persino gli alieni sarebbero piombati dentro a distruggere le nostre case e a prendersi i nostri soldi. Che eravamo noi contro tutta la galassia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	You talk to Eyes about your own upbringing on Mainsail, how you always dreamed of taking to the stars instead of your family's business, and how your father bought you a pilot's license for your eighteenth birthday.|1815|0
units.english: You talk to Eyes about your own upbringing on Mainsail, how you always dreamed of taking to the stars instead of your family's business, and how your father bought you a pilot's license for your eighteenth birthday.
units.italian: Parli con Eyes della tua infanzia su Mainsail, di come hai sempre sognato di andare fra le stelle invece di occuparti dell'attività di famiglia, e di come tuo padre ti abbia comprato la licenza di pilota per il tuo diciottesimo compleanno.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"It sounds like you've come a long way from the Paradise Worlds too," says Eyes. "If you don't mind me asking, what do you think your father would think about you helping the Free Worlds?"|1816|0
units.english: "It sounds like you've come a long way from the Paradise Worlds too," says Eyes. "If you don't mind me asking, what do you think your father would think about you helping the Free Worlds?"
units.italian: "Sembra che anche tu abbia fatto molta strada dai Mondi Paradisiaci," dice Eyes. "Se non ti dispiace che te lo chieda, che cosa pensi che direbbe tuo padre se ti vedesse aiutare le Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"I'm sure he'd be happy with the path I've chosen."|1818|0
units.english: "I'm sure he'd be happy with the path I've chosen."
units.italian: "Sono sicuro che sarebbe contento della strada che ho scelto."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"I don't think he would like it."|1820|0
units.english: "I don't think he would like it."
units.italian: "Non credo che gli piacerebbe."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"I'm not sure myself, to be honest."|1821|0
units.english: "I'm not sure myself, to be honest."
units.italian: "A dire il vero, non ne sono sicuro nemmeno io."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"I'd rather not say."|1822|0
units.english: "I'd rather not say."
units.italian: "Preferirei non dirlo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	Eyes raises an eyebrow, but keeps his mouth sealed as he nods.|1824|0
units.english: Eyes raises an eyebrow, but keeps his mouth sealed as he nods.
units.italian: Eyes alza un sopracciglio, ma tiene la bocca chiusa e annuisce.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	Eyes looks at you and nods.|1828|0
units.english: Eyes looks at you and nods.
units.italian: Eyes ti guarda e annuisce.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	"I'd hate to be rich," says Katya. "So much to fear."|1832|0
units.english: "I'd hate to be rich," says Katya. "So much to fear."
units.italian: "Non vorrei mai essere ricco," dice Katya. "Troppe cose da temere."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|	You finish your meal (Katya pays the tab), and agree to take off for <planet> first thing in the morning.|1833|0
units.english: You finish your meal (Katya pays the tab), and agree to take off for <planet> first thing in the morning.
units.italian: Finisci il pasto (il conto lo paga Katya) e concordate di partire per <planet> la mattina dopo.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 4|dialog|1836|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Katya and Mr. Eyes are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya e Mr. Eyes sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|name|1842|0
units.english: Information Gathering
units.italian: Raccolta di informazioni

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|description|1843|0
units.english: Bring Katya and Mr. Eyes to <destination>, where some monks may be able to help you negotiate with the pirates for information.
units.italian: Porta Katya e Mr. Eyes fino a <destination>, dove alcuni monaci potrebbero aiutarti a negoziare con i pirati per ottenere informazioni.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|log|1852|0
units.english: Gave up on searching for evidence of nuclear testing to clear the Free Worlds' name.
units.italian: Hai rinunciato a cercare prove di test nucleari per scagionare le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|You land on <origin>, and Mr. Eyes fires up the new Navy surveillance equipment to make atmospheric measurements. "Nothing here," he says after a few minutes. "Guess we should move on."|1857|0
units.english: You land on <origin>, and Mr. Eyes fires up the new Navy surveillance equipment to make atmospheric measurements. "Nothing here," he says after a few minutes. "Guess we should move on."
units.italian: Atterri su <origin>, e Mr. Eyes accende il nuovo equipaggiamento di sorveglianza della Marina per fare misurazioni atmosferiche. "Qui non c'è niente," dice dopo qualche minuto. "Credo che dovremmo andare avanti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"Are we just going to search every planet in this sector? Won't that take months?"|1859|0
units.english: "Are we just going to search every planet in this sector? Won't that take months?"
units.italian: "Cercheremo su ogni pianeta di questo settore? Non ci vorranno mesi?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"Are there any other ships helping us search, or is it just us?"|1860|0
units.english: "Are there any other ships helping us search, or is it just us?"
units.italian: "Ci sono altre navi che ci aiutano nella ricerca, o siamo solo noi?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"You've got a point," says Eyes. "And we don't even know for sure that the terrorists originated from around here. Without any additional information, we're looking for a needle in a galaxy-sized haystack."|1863|0
units.english: "You've got a point," says Eyes. "And we don't even know for sure that the terrorists originated from around here. Without any additional information, we're looking for a needle in a galaxy-sized haystack."
units.italian: "Hai ragione," dice Eyes. "E non sappiamo nemmeno per certo che i terroristi vengano da queste parti. Senza altre informazioni, stiamo cercando un ago in un pagliaio grande quanto la galassia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"No," says Eyes, "we've tried to keep this search a secret so the terrorists won't know we're looking for them. Any group with the resources to develop nuclear weapons likely has the resources to also cover their tracks, and if they know we're coming for them, they could make our job even harder than it already is."|1867|0
units.english: "No," says Eyes, "we've tried to keep this search a secret so the terrorists won't know we're looking for them. Any group with the resources to develop nuclear weapons likely has the resources to also cover their tracks, and if they know we're coming for them, they could make our job even harder than it already is."
units.italian: "No," dice Eyes, "abbiamo cercato di tenere segreta questa ricerca, così i terroristi non sapranno che li stiamo cercando. Qualsiasi gruppo con le risorse per sviluppare armi nucleari probabilmente ha anche le risorse per coprire le proprie tracce, e se sapessero che stiamo arrivando potrebbero rendere il nostro compito ancora più difficile di quanto già sia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	Katya says, "What we need is some leads to follow. I bet we could buy information on Greenrock. Whenever anyone is doing something illegal in this sector, there's a good chance the pirates are helping them."|1870|0
units.english: Katya says, "What we need is some leads to follow. I bet we could buy information on Greenrock. Whenever anyone is doing something illegal in this sector, there's a good chance the pirates are helping them."
units.italian: Katya dice: "Quello che ci serve sono delle piste da seguire. Scommetto che potremmo comprare informazioni su Greenrock. Ogni volta che qualcuno fa qualcosa di illegale in questo settore, ci sono buone probabilità che i pirati lo stiano aiutando."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	Mr. Eyes says, "Unless you've got boatloads of money to give the pirates, we need someone who's friendly with them, who can convince them to talk for free. We should go to the Brothers on Harmony."|1871|0
units.english: Mr. Eyes says, "Unless you've got boatloads of money to give the pirates, we need someone who's friendly with them, who can convince them to talk for free. We should go to the Brothers on Harmony."
units.italian: Mr. Eyes dice: "A meno che tu non abbia navi intere di soldi da dare ai pirati, ci serve qualcuno che sia in buoni rapporti con loro, che possa convincerli a parlare gratis. Dovremmo andare dai Fratelli su Harmony."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"That's not a bad idea," says Katya, "as long as they don't make me sit through one of their church services. I'm usually all for service, but theirs always makes me fall asleep."|1872|0
units.english: "That's not a bad idea," says Katya, "as long as they don't make me sit through one of their church services. I'm usually all for service, but theirs always makes me fall asleep."
units.italian: "Non è una cattiva idea," dice Katya, "purché non mi costringano a sorbirmi una delle loro funzioni religiose. Di solito sono favorevole alle funzioni, ma le loro mi fanno sempre addormentare."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"What do you say, Captain?" asks Eyes. "Want to visit a monastery?"|1873|0
units.english: "What do you say, Captain?" asks Eyes. "Want to visit a monastery?"
units.italian: "Che ne dici, Capitano?" chiede Eyes. "Ti va di visitare un monastero?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"Sure, sounds like fun."|1875|0
units.english: "Sure, sounds like fun."
units.italian: "Certo, sembra divertente."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"You guys have interesting friends. How do you know these monks?"|1877|0
units.english: "You guys have interesting friends. How do you know these monks?"
units.italian: "Avete amici interessanti, voi due. Come fate a conoscere questi monaci?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"Sounds boring. Can't we go shoot down more surveillance drones instead?"|1878|0
units.english: "Sounds boring. Can't we go shoot down more surveillance drones instead?"
units.italian: "Sembra noioso. Non possiamo invece andare ad abbattere altri droni da sorveglianza?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"When I grew up and left the Paradise sector, as a young idealist," says Eyes, "I decided I wanted to take a vow of poverty, so I came to live with the Brothers. But it turns out they also wanted me to take a vow of obedience. And chastity. Not so much my cup of tea." He winks at Katya.|1881|0
units.english: "When I grew up and left the Paradise sector, as a young idealist," says Eyes, "I decided I wanted to take a vow of poverty, so I came to live with the Brothers. But it turns out they also wanted me to take a vow of obedience. And chastity. Not so much my cup of tea." He winks at Katya.
units.italian: "Quando sono cresciuto e ho lasciato il settore Paradiso, da giovane idealista," dice Eyes, "ho deciso che volevo prendere il voto di povertà, così sono andato a vivere con i Fratelli. Ma salta fuori che volevano che prendessi anche il voto di obbedienza. E di castità. Non proprio il mio genere." Fa l'occhiolino a Katya.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"Are the monks really as boring as Katya says?" you ask.|1882|0
units.english: "Are the monks really as boring as Katya says?" you ask.
units.italian: "I monaci sono davvero noiosi come dice Katya?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"Sorry kid," says Eyes. "Take it from me, working for justice is not always exciting."|1885|0
units.english: "Sorry kid," says Eyes. "Take it from me, working for justice is not always exciting."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ragazzino," dice Eyes. "Credimi, lavorare per la giustizia non è sempre emozionante."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"Fine, I'm in."|1887|0
units.english: "Fine, I'm in."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci sto."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|	"Sorry, but I think I'm done with helping the Free Worlds. I'd rather strike out on my own."|1889|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I think I'm done with helping the Free Worlds. I'd rather strike out on my own."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma credo di aver finito di aiutare le Free Worlds. Preferisco andare per la mia strada."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5|dialog|1893|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Katya and Mr. Eyes are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya e Mr. Eyes sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|name|1899|0
units.english: Information Gathering
units.italian: Raccolta di informazioni

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|description|1900|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> with Brother Greg and see if he can get any information from the pirates there. (Hail the planet to have him negotiate landing clearance.)
units.italian: Va' su <planet> con fratello Greg e vedi se riesce a ottenere qualche informazione dai pirati che ci sono. (Chiama il pianeta perché sia lui a negoziare il permesso di atterraggio.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|clearance|1903|0
units.english: Brother Greg talks briefly with the spaceport traffic controller. When they realize who he is, they agree to let you land "without paying the usual fee."
units.italian: Fratello Greg parla brevemente con il controllore di traffico dello spazioporto. Quando capiscono chi è, accettano di lasciarti atterrare "senza pagare la solita tassa".

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|log|1911|0
units.english: Pirate ships are often crewed by children, the equivalent of street gangs or child soldiers. Many lawless worlds are so poor that joining a pirate gang is one of the only attractive options for earning a living.
units.italian: Le navi pirata hanno spesso equipaggi composti da ragazzi, l'equivalente di bande di strada o di bambini soldato. Molti mondi senza legge sono così poveri che unirsi a una banda di pirati è una delle poche opzioni attraenti per guadagnarsi da vivere.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|Katya and Eyes lead you to the monastery. As you are approaching, you meet a monk who is wearing a long black robe and kneeling in a small vegetable garden, pulling weeds. When he looks up and sees you, he leaps to his feet and runs over. "Katya! And Ijs! Welcome back!" Then he turns to you. "I'm David," he says.|1913|0
units.english: Katya and Eyes lead you to the monastery. As you are approaching, you meet a monk who is wearing a long black robe and kneeling in a small vegetable garden, pulling weeds. When he looks up and sees you, he leaps to his feet and runs over. "Katya! And Ijs! Welcome back!" Then he turns to you. "I'm David," he says.
units.italian: Katya ed Eyes ti guidano al monastero. Mentre vi avvicinate, incontrate un monaco che indossa una lunga veste nera ed è inginocchiato in un piccolo orto, a strappare erbacce.
