Quando alza lo sguardo e vi vede, salta in piedi e corre verso di voi. "Katya! E Ijs! Bentornati!" Poi si volta verso di te. "Io sono David," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"I'm <first>. Pleased to meet you."|1915|0
units.english: "I'm <first>. Pleased to meet you."
units.italian: "Io sono <first>. Piacere di conoscerti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	Katya asks, "Is Brother Greg here?"|1917|0
units.english: Katya asks, "Is Brother Greg here?"
units.italian: Katya chiede: "C'è fratello Greg?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"He is," says David. "Come inside." The monastery building is a stone and brick structure that looks like pictures you have seen of ancient Earth. He leads you down a long hallway and into a sitting room with furniture that looks equally antique, then leaves.|1918|0
units.english: "He is," says David. "Come inside." The monastery building is a stone and brick structure that looks like pictures you have seen of ancient Earth. He leads you down a long hallway and into a sitting room with furniture that looks equally antique, then leaves.
units.italian: "Sì, c'è," dice David. "Entrate." L'edificio del monastero è una struttura in pietra e mattoni che somiglia alle immagini che hai visto dell'antica Terra. Vi guida lungo un lungo corridoio fino a un salotto con mobili altrettanto antichi, poi se ne va.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	As you are waiting, Eyes explains, "Brother Greg is in charge of the monastery's outreach and ministry to pirate crew members."|1919|0
units.english: As you are waiting, Eyes explains, "Brother Greg is in charge of the monastery's outreach and ministry to pirate crew members."
units.italian: Mentre aspettate, Eyes spiega: "Fratello Greg è responsabile dell'assistenza e del ministero del monastero verso i membri degli equipaggi pirata."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"That sounds even odder than being a vigilante nuclear inspector."|1921|0
units.english: "That sounds even odder than being a vigilante nuclear inspector."
units.italian: "Sembra ancora più strano che fare l'ispettore nucleare autonomo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"Why would anyone want to reach out to pirates?"|1922|0
units.english: "Why would anyone want to reach out to pirates?"
units.italian: "Perché mai qualcuno dovrebbe voler tendere la mano ai pirati?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	Eyes laughs. "Yes, the monks were a big influence in helping me to think creatively about my own vocation."|1925|0
units.english: Eyes laughs. "Yes, the monks were a big influence in helping me to think creatively about my own vocation."
units.italian: Eyes ride. "Sì, i monaci hanno avuto una grande influenza nell'aiutarmi a pensare in modo creativo alla mia vocazione."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"Consider this," says Katya. "In the galactic south, the average age of a pirate crew member is seventeen years old. And many are much younger than that. They're more like street kids than like hardened criminals."|1928|0
units.english: "Consider this," says Katya. "In the galactic south, the average age of a pirate crew member is seventeen years old. And many are much younger than that. They're more like street kids than like hardened criminals."
units.italian: "Considera questo," dice Katya. "Nel sud della galassia, l'età media di un membro di un equipaggio pirata è di diciassette anni. E molti sono molto più giovani. Sono più simili a ragazzini di strada che a criminali incalliti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	Just then, Brother Greg walks in. Mr. Eyes introduces you to him and explains your situation. Greg frowns, thoughtfully. "What do we have to offer in exchange for that information?" he asks.|1929|0
units.english: Just then, Brother Greg walks in. Mr. Eyes introduces you to him and explains your situation. Greg frowns, thoughtfully. "What do we have to offer in exchange for that information?" he asks.
units.italian: Proprio in quel momento entra fratello Greg. Mr. Eyes ti presenta a lui e gli spiega la vostra situazione. Greg si acciglia, pensieroso. "Che cosa abbiamo da offrire in cambio di quelle informazioni?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	Katya says, "Ever since the bombings, Southern space has been swarming not only with an increased militia presence, but with the whole Republic Navy. That must make it awfully hard to be a pirate. Seems like the pirates would be glad if the Navy got what they were looking for and went back up north."|1930|0
units.english: Katya says, "Ever since the bombings, Southern space has been swarming not only with an increased militia presence, but with the whole Republic Navy. That must make it awfully hard to be a pirate. Seems like the pirates would be glad if the Navy got what they were looking for and went back up north."
units.italian: Katya dice: "Da quando ci sono stati gli attentati, lo spazio del Sud è pieno non solo di una presenza maggiore della milizia, ma di tutta la Marina della Repubblica. Dev'essere terribilmente difficile fare il pirata. Sembra che i pirati sarebbero contenti se la Marina ottenesse quello che cerca e tornasse a nord."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	Brother Greg nods. "It's worth a try. Why don't you join us for dinner, and we'll depart for Greenrock in the morning. When we get there, just hail the planet and let me do the talking, and I can probably get permission to land for free."|1931|0
units.english: Brother Greg nods. "It's worth a try. Why don't you join us for dinner, and we'll depart for Greenrock in the morning. When we get there, just hail the planet and let me do the talking, and I can probably get permission to land for free."
units.italian: Fratello Greg annuisce. "Vale la pena provare. Perché non vi unite a noi per cena, e domani mattina partiamo per Greenrock. Quando arriviamo, chiamate il pianeta e lasciate parlare me, e probabilmente riuscirò a ottenere il permesso di atterrare gratis."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	You join the brothers for a simple but delicious dinner, soup and salad made entirely from their own gardens. After dinner, Greg asks you, "Do you want to join us for evening prayer?"|1932|0
units.english: You join the brothers for a simple but delicious dinner, soup and salad made entirely from their own gardens. After dinner, Greg asks you, "Do you want to join us for evening prayer?"
units.italian: Ti unisci ai fratelli per una cena semplice ma deliziosa, zuppa e insalata fatti interamente con i loro orti. Dopo cena, Greg ti chiede: "Vuoi unirti a noi per la preghiera serale?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"Sure, I'd be glad to."|1934|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Certo, ne sarò lieto."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"Sorry, I've got some other stuff to get done tonight."|1936|0
units.english: "Sorry, I've got some other stuff to get done tonight."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ho altre cose da sbrigare stasera."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"No problem," he says. "See you in the morning."|1938|0
units.english: "No problem," he says. "See you in the morning."
units.italian: "Nessun problema," dice. "Ci vediamo domattina."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	"Evening prayer" turns out to be a lengthy church service that apparently begins with the monks listing every bad thing they can possibly imagine and praying that it would not happen: "From lightning and tempest; from earthquake, fire, and flood; from plague, pestilence, and famine, good Lord, deliver us. From all oppression, conspiracy, and rebellion; from violence, battle, murder, and war; and from dying suddenly and unprepared, good Lord, deliver us..." It's very monotonous.|1942|0
units.english: "Evening prayer" turns out to be a lengthy church service that apparently begins with the monks listing every bad thing they can possibly imagine and praying that it would not happen: "From lightning and tempest; from earthquake, fire, and flood; from plague, pestilence, and famine, good Lord, deliver us. From all oppression, conspiracy, and rebellion; from violence, battle, murder, and war; and from dying suddenly and unprepared, good Lord, deliver us..." It's very monotonous.
units.italian: La "preghiera serale" si rivela una lunga funzione religiosa che a quanto pare comincia con i monaci che elencano ogni cosa brutta che riescono a immaginare e pregano perché non accada: "Dal fulmine e dalla tempesta; dal terremoto, dal fuoco e dall'inondazione; dalla peste, dal morbo e dalla carestia, buon Signore, liberaci. Da ogni oppressione, cospirazione e ribellione; dalla violenza, dalla battaglia, dall'omicidio e dalla guerra; e dal morire all'improvviso e senza preparazione, buon Signore, liberaci..." È molto monotono.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	At some point, they switch to praying for different people: for the Parliament of the Republic, and everyone in authority; for the governor of <origin>, their world; for the Quarg and all sentient species; for prisoners, for the homeless and poor, for orphans, for pregnant women and young children, for travelers, for starship crews and captains, for miners and oil crews, for mill and factory workers; for the abused; for the mentally ill; for pirates and street gangs; for all creatures and planets vulnerable to exploitation or ecological destruction. (Eyes, who is sitting next to you, responds to that last petition with a fervent "Amen!") The litany is so detailed and specific that you find it both exhausting and fascinating.|1943|0
units.english: At some point, they switch to praying for different people: for the Parliament of the Republic, and everyone in authority; for the governor of <origin>, their world; for the Quarg and all sentient species; for prisoners, for the homeless and poor, for orphans, for pregnant women and young children, for travelers, for starship crews and captains, for miners and oil crews, for mill and factory workers; for the abused; for the mentally ill; for pirates and street gangs; for all creatures and planets vulnerable to exploitation or ecological destruction. (Eyes, who is sitting next to you, responds to that last petition with a fervent "Amen!") The litany is so detailed and specific that you find it both exhausting and fascinating.
units.italian: A un certo punto passano a pregare per persone diverse: per il Parlamento della Repubblica e per tutti quelli che hanno autorità; per il governatore di <origin>, il loro mondo; per i Quarg e per tutte le specie senzienti; per i prigionieri, per i senzatetto e i poveri, per gli orfani, per le donne incinte e i bambini piccoli, per i viaggiatori, per gli equipaggi e i capitani delle astronavi, per i minatori e le squadre petrolifere, per gli operai delle fabbriche e dei mulini; per gli abusati; per i malati di mente; per i pirati e le bande di strada; per tutte le creature e i pianeti vulnerabili allo sfruttamento o alla distruzione ecologica. (Eyes, che è seduto accanto a te, risponde a quest'ultima petizione con un fervente "Amen!") La litania è così dettagliata e specifica che la trovi insieme estenuante e affascinante.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	When the service ends, the monks depart for their rooms in silence, and Eyes, with a brief nod to you, does the same.|1944|0
units.english: When the service ends, the monks depart for their rooms in silence, and Eyes, with a brief nod to you, does the same.
units.italian: Quando la funzione finisce, i monaci si ritirano nelle loro stanze in silenzio, e Eyes, con un breve cenno verso di te, fa lo stesso.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|	At breakfast in the monastery, Mr. Eyes tells you, "I'm going to be staying here until you get back. Greenrock is no place for a man with a price on his head. But Katya will be going with you." You bring Katya and Greg back to your ship and get ready to take off.|1947|0
units.english: At breakfast in the monastery, Mr. Eyes tells you, "I'm going to be staying here until you get back. Greenrock is no place for a man with a price on his head. But Katya will be going with you." You bring Katya and Greg back to your ship and get ready to take off.
units.italian: A colazione nel monastero, Mr. Eyes ti dice: "Io resto qui finché non tornate. Greenrock non è un posto per un uomo con una taglia sulla testa. Ma Katya verrà con te." Riporti Katya e Greg alla tua nave e ti prepari a decollare.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5B|dialog|1951|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Katya and Brother Greg are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya e fratello Greg sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|name|1957|0
units.english: Information Gathering
units.italian: Raccolta di informazioni

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|description|1958|0
units.english: Return to <planet> with Katya and Brother Greg.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> con Katya e fratello Greg.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|Brother Greg disappears for several hours to talk with his various contacts, then returns and reports to you and Katya. "No one has heard anything specific," he says, "and they say keeping a nuclear program secret would take an incredible amount of resources, or a very remote location with very good security."|1969|0
units.english: Brother Greg disappears for several hours to talk with his various contacts, then returns and reports to you and Katya. "No one has heard anything specific," he says, "and they say keeping a nuclear program secret would take an incredible amount of resources, or a very remote location with very good security."
units.italian: Fratello Greg sparisce per diverse ore a parlare con i suoi vari contatti, poi torna e riferisce a te e a Katya. "Nessuno ha sentito niente di specifico," dice, "e dicono che tenere segreto un programma nucleare richiederebbe una quantità incredibile di risorse, o un luogo molto remoto con una sicurezza molto buona."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	"Any hints on where we should look?" asks Katya.|1970|0
units.english: "Any hints on where we should look?" asks Katya.
units.italian: "Qualche indizio su dove dovremmo guardare?" chiede Katya.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	"A few. I talked to one friend who had done research into nuclear development 'for purely academic reasons,' and he said that only a fool would perform atmospheric tests; Intelligence would notice that immediately, no matter what world you were on. He said the ideal development location would be a sparsely populated planet with some abandoned deep underground mines."|1971|0
units.english: "A few. I talked to one friend who had done research into nuclear development 'for purely academic reasons,' and he said that only a fool would perform atmospheric tests; Intelligence would notice that immediately, no matter what world you were on. He said the ideal development location would be a sparsely populated planet with some abandoned deep underground mines."
units.italian: "Qualcuno. Ho parlato con un amico che aveva fatto ricerche sullo sviluppo nucleare 'per ragioni puramente accademiche', e ha detto che solo un folle farebbe test atmosferici: l'Intelligence se ne accorgerebbe subito, su qualunque mondo tu sia. Dice che il luogo ideale per lo sviluppo sarebbe un pianeta scarsamente popolato con qualche miniera abbandonata in profondità."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	"Anything else?" you ask.|1972|0
units.english: "Anything else?" you ask.
units.italian: "Qualcos'altro?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	"Just one more thing," says Greg. "Several people mentioned that they think the Navy itself may have a nuclear arsenal, and that a renegade may have stolen the weapons from them. Much easier than developing them yourself."|1973|0
units.english: "Just one more thing," says Greg. "Several people mentioned that they think the Navy itself may have a nuclear arsenal, and that a renegade may have stolen the weapons from them. Much easier than developing them yourself."
units.italian: "Solo un'altra cosa," dice Greg. "Diverse persone hanno detto che pensano che la Marina stessa possa avere un arsenale nucleare, e che un rinnegato possa aver rubato loro le armi. Molto più facile che svilupparle da soli."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	"Well, let's head back to <planet> and see what Eyes thinks," says Katya, "but I can't imagine the Navy would have such an arsenal. Searching on mining planets sounds like our best bet for now."|1974|0
units.english: "Well, let's head back to <planet> and see what Eyes thinks," says Katya, "but I can't imagine the Navy would have such an arsenal. Searching on mining planets sounds like our best bet for now."
units.italian: "Beh, torniamo su <planet> e vediamo che cosa pensa Eyes," dice Katya, "ma non riesco a immaginare che la Marina abbia un arsenale del genere. Cercare sui pianeti minerari mi sembra la nostra migliore possibilità per ora."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|dialog|1978|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Katya and Brother Greg are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya e fratello Greg sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|When you land on <planet>, as Brother Greg is gathering his luggage, Katya hands you another credit chip for <payment>. "Thanks for risking your life with the pirates," she says. "You've got real guts."|1982|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, as Brother Greg is gathering his luggage, Katya hands you another credit chip for <payment>. "Thanks for risking your life with the pirates," she says. "You've got real guts."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, mentre fratello Greg raccoglie i suoi bagagli, Katya ti porge un altro chip di credito per <payment>. "Grazie per aver rischiato la vita con i pirati," dice. "Hai davvero fegato."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	You return to the monastery and share your new information with Mr. Eyes. His reaction is the same as Katya's. "No way the Navy has nukes," he says. "Some other secret branch of the government, maybe, but not the Navy. That would offend their sense of honor."|1983|0
units.english: You return to the monastery and share your new information with Mr. Eyes. His reaction is the same as Katya's. "No way the Navy has nukes," he says. "Some other secret branch of the government, maybe, but not the Navy. That would offend their sense of honor."
units.italian: Torni al monastero e condividi le nuove informazioni con Mr. Eyes. La sua reazione è la stessa di Katya. "Impossibile che la Marina abbia ordigni nucleari," dice. "Magari qualche altro ramo segreto del governo, ma non la Marina. Offenderebbe il loro senso dell'onore."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	"Still," says Katya, "if there was such a program and the weapons were stolen from it, that would explain why Intelligence has not named a suspect yet. They would have to reveal the program's existence."|1984|0
units.english: "Still," says Katya, "if there was such a program and the weapons were stolen from it, that would explain why Intelligence has not named a suspect yet. They would have to reveal the program's existence."
units.italian: "Comunque," dice Katya, "se esistesse un programma del genere e le armi fossero state rubate, questo spiegherebbe perché l'Intelligence non ha ancora fatto il nome di un sospetto. Dovrebbero rivelare l'esistenza del programma."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	Eyes shakes his head. "This isn't a productive line of investigation," he says. "If it was some local terrorists, we've got some hope of tracking them down. If it's some shadowy government organization, there's no way we can find them. So, the local terrorist angle is the only one worth pursuing."|1985|0
units.english: Eyes shakes his head. "This isn't a productive line of investigation," he says. "If it was some local terrorists, we've got some hope of tracking them down. If it's some shadowy government organization, there's no way we can find them. So, the local terrorist angle is the only one worth pursuing."
units.italian: Eyes scuote la testa. "Questa non è una pista produttiva," dice. "Se fossero terroristi locali, avremmo qualche speranza di rintracciarli. Se è qualche organizzazione governativa nell'ombra, non c'è modo di trovarli. Quindi la pista dei terroristi locali è l'unica che vale la pena seguire."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 5C|	"Very well," says Katya. "Captain <last>, meet us in the spaceport if you're willing to continue working with us."|1986|0
units.english: "Very well," says Katya. "Captain <last>, meet us in the spaceport if you're willing to continue working with us."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice Katya. "Capitano <last>, incontraci allo spazioporto se sei disposto a continuare a lavorare con noi."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|name|1991|0
units.english: The Hunt Continues
units.italian: La caccia continua

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|description|1992|0
units.english: Take Katya and Eyes to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta Katya ed Eyes fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|log|2001|0
units.english: Gave up on searching for evidence of nuclear testing to clear the Free Worlds' name.
units.italian: Hai rinunciato a cercare prove di test nucleari per scagionare le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|You find Katya and Mr. Eyes sitting at a table in the corner of a small cafe, talking in hushed voices and examining a galactic map that is spread out in front of them. Several of the nearby systems are circled. Katya says, "Hello again, Captain. We've picked three planets that we think are our best options: <planet>, Hopper, and New Iceland. It should only take a few weeks to visit all of them. What do you say?"|2006|0
units.english: You find Katya and Mr. Eyes sitting at a table in the corner of a small cafe, talking in hushed voices and examining a galactic map that is spread out in front of them. Several of the nearby systems are circled. Katya says, "Hello again, Captain. We've picked three planets that we think are our best options: <planet>, Hopper, and New Iceland. It should only take a few weeks to visit all of them. What do you say?"
units.italian: Trovi Katya e Mr. Eyes seduti a un tavolo nell'angolo di un piccolo caffè, che parlano a voce bassa ed esaminano una mappa galattica aperta davanti a loro. Diversi sistemi vicini sono cerchiati. Katya dice: "Di nuovo salve, Capitano. Abbiamo scelto tre pianeti che pensiamo siano le nostre opzioni migliori: <planet>, Hopper e New Iceland. Dovrebbero bastare solo un paio di settimane per visitarli tutti. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|	"Sure, I definitely want to help solve this case!"|2008|0
units.english: "Sure, I definitely want to help solve this case!"
units.italian: "Certo, ci tengo davvero a risolvere questo caso!"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|	"Why these worlds specifically? Why not check worlds in Free space if the Republic thinks you did it?"|2010|0
units.english: "Why these worlds specifically? Why not check worlds in Free space if the Republic thinks you did it?"
units.italian: "Perché proprio questi mondi? Perché non controllare i mondi nello spazio delle Free Worlds, se la Repubblica pensa che siate stati voi?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|	"I'm through with helping the Free Worlds. I don't think we have a chance of beating the Navy to the punch."|2011|0
units.english: "I'm through with helping the Free Worlds. I don't think we have a chance of beating the Navy to the punch."
units.italian: "Ho chiuso con l'aiutare le Free Worlds. Non credo che abbiamo qualche possibilità di battere la Marina sul tempo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|	"I suppose that showing a lack of evidence for nuclear testing done on Free planets would be circumstantial evidence for us," Eyes says, "but we're specifically hunting for the culprit, so these are our best bets as far as nearby mining worlds go. And searching these three worlds would be quicker than searching all of Free space."|2014|0
units.english: "I suppose that showing a lack of evidence for nuclear testing done on Free planets would be circumstantial evidence for us," Eyes says, "but we're specifically hunting for the culprit, so these are our best bets as far as nearby mining worlds go. And searching these three worlds would be quicker than searching all of Free space."
units.italian: "Suppongo che dimostrare l'assenza di test nucleari sui pianeti delle Free Worlds sarebbe per noi una prova indiziaria," dice Eyes, "ma stiamo cercando specificamente il colpevole, quindi questi sono i nostri candidati migliori fra i mondi minerari qui vicino. E cercare su questi tre mondi sarebbe più rapido che cercare in tutto lo spazio delle Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|	"Another thing we have to keep in mind is that we may not be able to operate outside of Free space forever," Katya responds. "I pray that we find answers before it comes to it, but war between the Free Worlds and Republic would cut us off from freely searching most of the galaxy."|2015|0
units.english: "Another thing we have to keep in mind is that we may not be able to operate outside of Free space forever," Katya responds. "I pray that we find answers before it comes to it, but war between the Free Worlds and Republic would cut us off from freely searching most of the galaxy."
units.italian: "Un'altra cosa da tenere presente è che potremmo non essere in grado di operare fuori dallo spazio delle Free Worlds per sempre," risponde Katya. "Prego che troviamo delle risposte prima che si arrivi a quel punto, ma una guerra fra le Free Worlds e la Repubblica ci taglierebbe fuori dalla possibilità di cercare liberamente in gran parte della galassia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|	"Okay, I'll help you search these worlds."|2017|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll help you search these worlds."
units.italian: "Va bene, vi aiuterò a cercare su questi mondi."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|	"I don't think this is the best course of action. You'll have to find someone else to help you with this."|2018|0
units.english: "I don't think this is the best course of action. You'll have to find someone else to help you with this."
units.italian: "Non credo che sia la strada migliore. Dovrete trovare qualcun altro che vi aiuti."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|	"Great!" says Katya. "We'll stop on <destination> first, then swing by Hopper and on to New Iceland. If we still haven't found anything by that point, we'll start working our way up the Rim."|2022|0
units.english: "Great!" says Katya. "We'll stop on <destination> first, then swing by Hopper and on to New Iceland. If we still haven't found anything by that point, we'll start working our way up the Rim."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice Katya. "Ci fermiamo prima su <destination>, poi passiamo da Hopper e proseguiamo per New Iceland. Se a quel punto non avremo ancora trovato niente, cominceremo a risalire lungo il Bordo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6|dialog|2026|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Katya and Mr. Eyes are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya e Mr. Eyes sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6B|name|2032|0
units.english: The Hunt Continues
units.italian: La caccia continua

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6B|description|2033|0
units.english: Take Katya and Eyes to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta Katya ed Eyes fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6B|Mr. Eyes fires up his instruments and looks at the results for a few minutes. "Nothing," he says. "Even underground testing would've thrown up a debris plume large enough to measure traces of it. But I'm picking up nothing."|2044|0
units.english: Mr. Eyes fires up his instruments and looks at the results for a few minutes. "Nothing," he says. "Even underground testing would've thrown up a debris plume large enough to measure traces of it. But I'm picking up nothing."
units.italian: Mr. Eyes accende i suoi strumenti e guarda i risultati per qualche minuto. "Niente," dice. "Anche un test sotterraneo avrebbe sollevato una colonna di detriti abbastanza grande da misurarne le tracce. Ma non rilevo nulla."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6B|	"No problem," says Katya. "Let's continue to <planet>."|2045|0
units.english: "No problem," says Katya. "Let's continue to <planet>."
units.italian: "Nessun problema," dice Katya. "Proseguiamo per <planet>."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6B|dialog|2049|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Katya and Mr. Eyes are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya e Mr. Eyes sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6C|Again, Eyes runs his tests, and again, nothing shows up. "One more planet to go," he says. "Time to try <planet>." You can tell that they are both starting to feel a bit discouraged, and you are overwhelmed by the thought of how many planets in this sector you may need to search unless you get a lucky break soon.|2067|0
units.english: Again, Eyes runs his tests, and again, nothing shows up. "One more planet to go," he says. "Time to try <planet>." You can tell that they are both starting to feel a bit discouraged, and you are overwhelmed by the thought of how many planets in this sector you may need to search unless you get a lucky break soon.
units.italian: Ancora una volta Eyes fa i suoi test, e ancora una volta non salta fuori niente. "Manca un pianeta," dice. "È ora di provare <planet>." Ti accorgi che stanno cominciando entrambi a scoraggiarsi, e ti senti sopraffatto al pensiero di quanti pianeti in questo settore potresti dover cercare se non arriva presto un colpo di fortuna.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 6C|dialog|2071|0

units.english: The Hunt Continues
units.italian: La caccia continua

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|description|2078|0
units.english: Take Katya and Eyes to <destination> to check for signs of underwater testing.
units.italian: Porta Katya ed Eyes fino a <destination> per controllare se ci sono segni di test subacquei.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|log|2087|0
units.english: Gave up on searching for evidence of nuclear testing to clear the Free Worlds' name.
units.italian: Hai rinunciato a cercare prove di test nucleari per scagionare le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|<origin> turns out no differently than the previous two. "We need a change in strategy," says Katya. "We've been talking about something while we were in transit."|2092|0
units.english: <origin> turns out no differently than the previous two. "We need a change in strategy," says Katya. "We've been talking about something while we were in transit."
units.italian: <origin> non si rivela diverso dai due precedenti. "Dobbiamo cambiare strategia," dice Katya. "Abbiamo parlato di una cosa mentre eravamo in viaggio."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	Eyes says, "It occurred to me that underwater testing might be even easier than underground: no need to dig or find a mine shaft. And, the Navy's sensors are for atmosphere, not oceans. But I've still got my old test kits with me for seawater."|2093|0
units.english: Eyes says, "It occurred to me that underwater testing might be even easier than underground: no need to dig or find a mine shaft. And, the Navy's sensors are for atmosphere, not oceans. But I've still got my old test kits with me for seawater."
units.italian: Eyes dice: "Mi è venuto in mente che un test subacqueo potrebbe essere ancora più facile di uno sotterraneo: non serve scavare né trovare un pozzo di miniera. E i sensori della Marina sono per l'atmosfera, non per gli oceani. Ma ho ancora con me i miei vecchi kit per analizzare l'acqua di mare."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	Katya says, "So then we wondered, what sort of world would you go to if you wanted rumblings in the ocean to go unnoticed? Either an unpopulated one, or one with lots of meteorite activity. And that leads us to... <planet>." She points out the system on your map. "Mild tidal surges on almost a weekly basis, due to impacts from all the asteroids in system. Perfect place to hide an undersea explosion."|2094|0
units.english: Katya says, "So then we wondered, what sort of world would you go to if you wanted rumblings in the ocean to go unnoticed? Either an unpopulated one, or one with lots of meteorite activity. And that leads us to... <planet>." She points out the system on your map. "Mild tidal surges on almost a weekly basis, due to impacts from all the asteroids in system. Perfect place to hide an undersea explosion."
units.italian: Katya dice: "Allora ci siamo chiesti: su che tipo di mondo andresti se volessi che i boati nell'oceano passassero inosservati? O su uno disabitato, o su uno con molta attività di meteoriti. E questo ci porta a... <planet>." Indica il sistema sulla tua mappa. "Ondate di marea moderate quasi ogni settimana, per via degli impatti di tutti gli asteroidi del sistema. Il posto perfetto per nascondere un'esplosione sottomarina."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	"Sounds like a good possibility. Let's give it a try!"|2096|0
units.english: "Sounds like a good possibility. Let's give it a try!"
units.italian: "Sembra una buona possibilità. Proviamo!"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	"But <planet> is part of the Free Worlds. What happens if we do find evidence there?"|2098|0
units.english: "But <planet> is part of the Free Worlds. What happens if we do find evidence there?"
units.italian: "Ma <planet> fa parte delle Free Worlds. Che succede se ci troviamo delle prove?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	"I've got other missions I need to run instead of continuing this wild goose chase."|2099|0
units.english: "I've got other missions I need to run instead of continuing this wild goose chase."
units.italian: "Ho altre missioni da sbrigare invece di continuare questa caccia al tesoro."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	"The plan hasn't changed," Eyes responds. "We find where the testing occurred, and that will lead us to the culprits. Even if it turns out that someone connected to the Free Worlds are responsible, they'll be turned over to the Republic."|2102|0
units.english: "The plan hasn't changed," Eyes responds. "We find where the testing occurred, and that will lead us to the culprits. Even if it turns out that someone connected to the Free Worlds are responsible, they'll be turned over to the Republic."
units.italian: "Il piano non è cambiato," risponde Eyes. "Troviamo dove sono avvenuti i test, e questo ci porterà ai colpevoli. Anche se saltasse fuori che è responsabile qualcuno legato alle Free Worlds, sarà consegnato alla Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	"I pray that no one within the Free Worlds are a part of this, though," Katya says quietly. "I'm almost hoping we find nothing."|2103|0
units.english: "I pray that no one within the Free Worlds are a part of this, though," Katya says quietly. "I'm almost hoping we find nothing."
units.italian: "Prego però che nessuno dentro le Free Worlds c'entri qualcosa," dice Katya a voce bassa. "Quasi spero che non troviamo niente."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	"Fair enough. Let's give it a try."|2105|0
units.english: "Fair enough. Let's give it a try."
units.italian: "Giusto, mi sembra ragionevole. Proviamo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	"The Free Worlds are looking guiltier the more we look. I'm out of here."|2106|0
units.english: "The Free Worlds are looking guiltier the more we look. I'm out of here."
units.italian: "Le Free Worlds sembrano sempre più colpevoli man mano che cerchiamo. Me ne vado."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7|	"I appreciate your help, Captain <last>," says Katya. "Let's get going."|2110|0
units.english: "I appreciate your help, Captain <last>," says Katya. "Let's get going."
units.italian: "Apprezzo il tuo aiuto, Capitano <last>," dice Katya. "Andiamo."

units.english: Take Katya and Eyes to the mining moon <planet>.
units.italian: Porta Katya ed Eyes sulla luna mineraria <planet>.
