units.english: Gave up on searching for evidence of nuclear testing to clear the Free Worlds' name.
units.italian: Hai rinunciato a cercare prove di test nucleari per scagionare le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|After landing, you go for a walk along the beach with Katya and Eyes. They both go barefoot, walking in the surf. Eyes is collecting pebbles and shells from under the water, and at one point instead of grabbing a pebble he surreptitiously reaches down and fills a small vial with seawater.|2135|0
units.english: After landing, you go for a walk along the beach with Katya and Eyes. They both go barefoot, walking in the surf. Eyes is collecting pebbles and shells from under the water, and at one point instead of grabbing a pebble he surreptitiously reaches down and fills a small vial with seawater.
units.italian: Dopo l'atterraggio vai a fare una passeggiata sulla spiaggia con Katya ed Eyes. Camminano entrambi a piedi nudi, nell'acqua bassa. Eyes raccoglie sassolini e conchiglie da sotto l'acqua, e a un certo punto, invece di prendere un sassolino, si abbassa di nascosto e riempie una fiala con l'acqua di mare.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	Back at your ship he runs his tests, with you and Katya watching eagerly. He looks at the results, frowns, and then repeats the whole procedure with a second test kit. Finally he sighs. "Nothing," he says.|2136|0
units.english: Back at your ship he runs his tests, with you and Katya watching eagerly. He looks at the results, frowns, and then repeats the whole procedure with a second test kit. Finally he sighs. "Nothing," he says.
units.italian: Tornati alla nave, fa i suoi test, con te e Katya che guardate impazienti. Guarda i risultati, si acciglia, poi ripete tutta la procedura con un secondo kit. Alla fine sospira. "Niente," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	Katya shouts in frustration and bangs her fists against the bulkheads. "We're never going to find anything," she says. "Forget it, I'm going for a walk." She leaves your ship.|2137|0
units.english: Katya shouts in frustration and bangs her fists against the bulkheads. "We're never going to find anything," she says. "Forget it, I'm going for a walk." She leaves your ship.
units.italian: Katya urla di frustrazione e batte i pugni sulle paratie. "Non troveremo mai niente," dice. "Lascia perdere, vado a farmi una passeggiata." Esce dalla nave.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	Mr. Eyes packs up his instruments, and then you walk outside and find her sitting on the landing pad near your ship, watching the moon rise over the ocean. She seems much calmer.|2138|0
units.english: Mr. Eyes packs up his instruments, and then you walk outside and find her sitting on the landing pad near your ship, watching the moon rise over the ocean. She seems much calmer.
units.italian: Mr. Eyes mette via i suoi strumenti, poi uscite e la trovate seduta sulla piazzola di atterraggio vicino alla nave, a guardare la luna che sorge sul mare. Sembra molto più calma.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	(Sit down next to her and try to comfort her.)|2140|0
units.english: (Sit down next to her and try to comfort her.)
units.italian: (Siediti accanto a lei e cerca di consolarla.)

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	"What should we do now?"|2141|0
units.english: "What should we do now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	You sit on one side of her, and Eyes sits on the other. "It's really admirable, what you're doing," you say. "You're trying to work for peace, and for justice. It's valuable work. Don't lose heart."|2144|0
units.english: You sit on one side of her, and Eyes sits on the other. "It's really admirable, what you're doing," you say. "You're trying to work for peace, and for justice. It's valuable work. Don't lose heart."
units.italian: Ti siedi da un lato, ed Eyes si siede dall'altro. "È davvero ammirevole, quello che stai facendo," dici. "Stai cercando di lavorare per la pace e per la giustizia. È un lavoro prezioso. Non perderti d'animo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	"One more try," she says. "One last world, and then we give up. I want you to take me... there." She points at the moon, hanging just above the horizon.|2148|0
units.english: "One more try," she says. "One last world, and then we give up. I want you to take me... there." She points at the moon, hanging just above the horizon.
units.italian: "Un ultimo tentativo," dice. "Un ultimo mondo, e poi rinunciamo. Voglio che mi porti... là." Indica la luna, sospesa appena sopra l'orizzonte.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	Eyes says, "Mining world. Dusty atmosphere. Frequent meteorite impacts. You could set off a nuke on the far side of that world and the miners would probably sleep right through it."|2149|0
units.english: Eyes says, "Mining world. Dusty atmosphere. Frequent meteorite impacts. You could set off a nuke on the far side of that world and the miners would probably sleep right through it."
units.italian: Eyes dice: "Mondo minerario. Atmosfera polverosa. Impatti frequenti di meteoriti. Potresti far esplodere un ordigno sul lato opposto di quel mondo e i minatori probabilmente dormirebbero lo stesso."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	"Okay, I'll take you to this one last world, and then we're done."|2151|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll take you to this one last world, and then we're done."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti porto su quest'ultimo mondo, e poi abbiamo finito."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	"Sorry, 'one more world' is what you said two planets ago. I'm done with this."|2152|0
units.english: "Sorry, 'one more world' is what you said two planets ago. I'm done with this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, 'un altro mondo' è quello che hai detto due pianeti fa. Ho chiuso con questa storia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|	"I promise it will be the last one," says Katya.|2154|0
units.english: "I promise it will be the last one," says Katya.
units.italian: "Prometto che sarà l'ultimo," dice Katya.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7B|dialog|2158|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Katya and Mr. Eyes are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Katya e Mr. Eyes sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|name|2164|0
units.english: Bring Eyes to <planet>
units.italian: Porta Eyes su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|description|2165|0
units.english: While Katya is undercover on <origin>, bring Mr. Eyes to <destination> to report to the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Mentre Katya è sotto copertura su <origin>, porta Mr. Eyes a <destination> per riferire alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|log|2175|0
units.english: Found evidence of nuclear testing on Clink, a mining moon on the edge of Free Worlds territory. It's strange that the perpetrators left such clear evidence behind; the Navy's drones will certainly have discovered it before we did. Katya stayed behind to try to infiltrate the mining compound and collect more information.
units.italian: Hai trovato prove di test nucleari su Clink, una luna mineraria ai margini del territorio delle Free Worlds. È strano che i responsabili abbiano lasciato dietro prove così evidenti: i droni della Marina le avranno di sicuro scoperte prima di noi. Katya è rimasta indietro per cercare di infiltrarsi nel complesso minerario e raccogliere altre informazioni.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|You land some distance from the mining settlement, and Mr. Eyes goes into the airlock in a pressure suit, cycling it to bring in some of the moon's thin atmosphere for him to test. "Firing up my instruments now," he says through the commlink. There is a long pause, and then he starts spouting a long string of creative profanity. Katya runs over to the airlock window to see what is happening.|2177|0
units.english: You land some distance from the mining settlement, and Mr. Eyes goes into the airlock in a pressure suit, cycling it to bring in some of the moon's thin atmosphere for him to test. "Firing up my instruments now," he says through the commlink. There is a long pause, and then he starts spouting a long string of creative profanity. Katya runs over to the airlock window to see what is happening.
units.italian: Atterri a una certa distanza dall'insediamento minerario, e Mr. Eyes entra nella camera di equilibrio con una tuta pressurizzata, facendola ciclare per raccogliere un po' dell'atmosfera sottile della luna e poterla analizzare. "Accendo gli strumenti adesso," dice attraverso il collegamento. Segue una lunga pausa, e poi comincia a vomitare una lunga serie di imprecazioni creative. Katya corre alla finestra della camera di equilibrio per vedere che succede.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	Finally, Eyes calms down enough to say, "It's a match! Not only has there been a recent test here, but the signature matches the one we took on Geminus. This is it."|2178|0
units.english: Finally, Eyes calms down enough to say, "It's a match! Not only has there been a recent test here, but the signature matches the one we took on Geminus. This is it."
units.italian: Alla fine Eyes si calma abbastanza da dire: "Corrisponde! Non solo qui c'è stato un test recente, ma la firma corrisponde a quella che abbiamo rilevato su Geminus. È questo il posto."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	He cycles the airlock and comes back inside. "Let's fly around and see if we can find the site," he says. After a few hours of flying low over the surface and scanning for radiation signatures, you find a spot that looks like all the other meteorite craters but is full of radiation. Katya and Eyes look at the images of the surface almost in disbelief.|2179|0
units.english: He cycles the airlock and comes back inside. "Let's fly around and see if we can find the site," he says. After a few hours of flying low over the surface and scanning for radiation signatures, you find a spot that looks like all the other meteorite craters but is full of radiation. Katya and Eyes look at the images of the surface almost in disbelief.
units.italian: Fa ciclare la camera di equilibrio e rientra. "Voliamo in cerchio e vediamo se riusciamo a trovare il sito," dice. Dopo qualche ora di volo radente sulla superficie e di scansione delle firme di radiazione, trovate un punto che sembra come tutti gli altri crateri meteoritici ma è pieno di radiazioni. Katya ed Eyes guardano le immagini della superficie quasi increduli.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"Based on the isotopic decay rates, this explosion happened in mid-June," says Eyes. "Just before the attacks happened."|2180|0
units.english: "Based on the isotopic decay rates, this explosion happened in mid-June," says Eyes. "Just before the attacks happened."
units.italian: "In base ai tassi di decadimento isotopico, questa esplosione è avvenuta a metà giugno," dice Eyes. "Poco prima che avvenissero gli attentati."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"It makes no sense," says Katya. "It's a blatant atmospheric test. No way the Navy hasn't found this. The Navy could act on this at any moment."|2181|0
units.english: "It makes no sense," says Katya. "It's a blatant atmospheric test. No way the Navy hasn't found this. The Navy could act on this at any moment."
units.italian: "Non ha alcun senso," dice Katya. "È un test atmosferico sfacciato. Impossibile che la Marina non l'abbia trovato. La Marina potrebbe agire su questa cosa da un momento all'altro."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"What do we do now that we've found the test site?"|2183|0
units.english: "What do we do now that we've found the test site?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo adesso che abbiamo trovato il sito dei test?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"So the Free Worlds are behind this! This is one of your planets!"|2185|0
units.english: "So the Free Worlds are behind this! This is one of your planets!"
units.italian: "Quindi sono le Free Worlds dietro a tutto questo! Questo è uno dei vostri pianeti!"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"Yes, this a Free planet, but this evidence is far too blatant," Eyes responds. "Just because we found a match here doesn't mean this is where all the testing happened. I'm only detecting enough isotopes to account for one explosion, and you wouldn't just test once. If anything, this shows that the Free Worlds are being framed by someone, and they used one nuke here before bombing Geminus and Martini to make it look like it was the Free Worlds who did it."|2187|0
units.english: "Yes, this a Free planet, but this evidence is far too blatant," Eyes responds. "Just because we found a match here doesn't mean this is where all the testing happened. I'm only detecting enough isotopes to account for one explosion, and you wouldn't just test once. If anything, this shows that the Free Worlds are being framed by someone, and they used one nuke here before bombing Geminus and Martini to make it look like it was the Free Worlds who did it."
units.italian: "Sì, questo è un pianeta delle Free Worlds, ma questa prova è fin troppo sfacciata," risponde Eyes. "Il fatto che qui abbiamo trovato una corrispondenza non significa che sia qui che sono avvenuti tutti i test. Sto rilevando isotopi sufficienti solo per una esplosione, e non faresti un test una volta sola. Semmai, questo dimostra che qualcuno sta incastrando le Free Worlds, e ha usato un ordigno qui prima di bombardare Geminus e Martini per far sembrare che siano state le Free Worlds a farlo."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"I swear before God when I say that the Free Worlds have nothing to do with this, Captain," Katya says. "But we'll find whoever is responsible and bring them to justice."|2188|0
units.english: "I swear before God when I say that the Free Worlds have nothing to do with this, Captain," Katya says. "But we'll find whoever is responsible and bring them to justice."
units.italian: "Giuro davanti a Dio che le Free Worlds non c'entrano niente con questo, Capitano," dice Katya. "Ma troveremo chi è responsabile e lo porteremo davanti alla giustizia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	Katya thinks for a moment. "Captain, is the outpost reporting any job openings?"|2191|0
units.english: Katya thinks for a moment. "Captain, is the outpost reporting any job openings?"
units.italian: Katya riflette un momento. "Capitano, l'avamposto segnala qualche posto di lavoro aperto?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	You check your computer. "One job opening, for a janitor in the mess hall."|2192|0
units.english: You check your computer. "One job opening, for a janitor in the mess hall."
units.italian: Controlli il computer. "Un posto, come inserviente nella mensa."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	She grimaces. "Okay, it's better than nothing. I'll take the job to go undercover and see what I can find out. You take Eyes to <planet>, where he can get in touch with the Free Worlds Council. I'll find a way to send you a message once I've found the perpetrators."|2193|0
units.english: She grimaces. "Okay, it's better than nothing. I'll take the job to go undercover and see what I can find out. You take Eyes to <planet>, where he can get in touch with the Free Worlds Council. I'll find a way to send you a message once I've found the perpetrators."
units.italian: Fa una smorfia. "Va bene, è meglio di niente. Prenderò il lavoro per andare sotto copertura e vedere che cosa riesco a scoprire. Tu porta Eyes su <planet>, dove potrà mettersi in contatto con il Consiglio delle Free Worlds. Troverò il modo di mandarti un messaggio quando avrò trovato i responsabili."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"Katerina," says Eyes, "this is way too dangerous. As I said, if we were able to detect this then so can the Navy, and they probably already have. They could decide to occupy Clink at any moment, and you'd be trapped here with no way out."|2194|0
units.english: "Katerina," says Eyes, "this is way too dangerous. As I said, if we were able to detect this then so can the Navy, and they probably already have. They could decide to occupy Clink at any moment, and you'd be trapped here with no way out."
units.italian: "Katerina," dice Eyes, "è troppo pericoloso. Come ho detto, se siamo riusciti a rilevarlo noi, allora può farlo anche la Marina, e probabilmente l'ha già fatto. Potrebbero decidere di occupare Clink da un momento all'altro, e tu rimarresti intrappolata qui senza via d'uscita."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"There's no other way," she says. "We have no time to lose. I'm willing to risk it."|2195|0
units.english: "There's no other way," she says. "We have no time to lose. I'm willing to risk it."
units.italian: "Non c'è altro modo," dice lei. "Non abbiamo tempo da perdere. Sono disposta a rischiare."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	With deep reservations, you drop her off at the outpost. Katya ruffles her hair and rubs some moon dust onto her face to blend in while asking about the job, which she is quickly offered. "Not many folks care to work up here," says the foreman, "so your help would be much appreciated." You and Eyes return to your ship and get ready to travel to <planet> with the evidence.|2196|0
units.english: With deep reservations, you drop her off at the outpost. Katya ruffles her hair and rubs some moon dust onto her face to blend in while asking about the job, which she is quickly offered. "Not many folks care to work up here," says the foreman, "so your help would be much appreciated." You and Eyes return to your ship and get ready to travel to <planet> with the evidence.
units.italian: Con molte riserve, la lasci all'avamposto. Katya si scompiglia i capelli e si strofina un po' di polvere lunare sul viso per confondersi mentre chiede del lavoro, che le viene offerto subito. "Non sono molti quelli che hanno voglia di lavorare quassù," dice il caposquadra, "quindi il tuo aiuto sarà molto apprezzato." Tu ed Eyes tornate alla nave e vi preparate a viaggiare verso <planet> con le prove.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|dialog|2200|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Mr. Eyes is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Mr. Eyes è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|Eyes has been really quiet for the whole journey; you're sure that he's worried about Katya. When you land, he hands you <payment> and says, "Thank you for all your help, Captain. I pray that this leads to justice being done."|2205|0
units.english: Eyes has been really quiet for the whole journey; you're sure that he's worried about Katya. When you land, he hands you <payment> and says, "Thank you for all your help, Captain. I pray that this leads to justice being done."
units.italian: Eyes è stato davvero zitto per tutto il viaggio; sei sicuro che sia preoccupato per Katya. Quando atterri, ti porge <payment> e dice: "Grazie per tutto il tuo aiuto, Capitano. Prego che questo porti alla giustizia."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	He starts to walk off, then comes back. "By the way, Katya wanted to keep this a secret, but I think you should know." He points to the credit chips he just handed you. "Katya's been funding this out of her own pocket. That's the last of her savings that she just paid you."|2206|0
units.english: He starts to walk off, then comes back. "By the way, Katya wanted to keep this a secret, but I think you should know." He points to the credit chips he just handed you. "Katya's been funding this out of her own pocket. That's the last of her savings that she just paid you."
units.italian: Comincia ad allontanarsi, poi torna indietro. "A proposito, Katya voleva tenere la cosa segreta, ma penso che dovresti saperlo." Indica i chip di credito che ti ha appena dato. "Katya ha finanziato tutto questo di tasca propria. Quelli erano gli ultimi suoi risparmi, quelli che ti ha appena pagato."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"I had no idea."|2208|0
units.english: "I had no idea."
units.italian: "Non ne avevo idea."

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"Wow, she really is dedicated to this work, isn't she?"|2209|0
units.english: "Wow, she really is dedicated to this work, isn't she?"
units.italian: "Caspita, è davvero dedita a questo lavoro, vero?"

units.id: mission:FW Katya 7C|	"She's a unique woman," says Eyes. "I hope we see her again soon. Goodbye for now, <first>."|2210|0
units.english: "She's a unique woman," says Eyes. "I hope we see her again soon. Goodbye for now, <first>."
units.italian: "È una donna fuori dal comune," dice Eyes. "Spero di rivederla presto. Per ora addio, <first>."

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|name|2217|0
units.english: Join the Free Worlds
units.italian: Unisciti alle Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|description|2218|0
units.english: If you want to join the Free Worlds, report to their headquarters on <destination>.
units.italian: Se vuoi unirti alle Free Worlds, presentati al loro quartier generale su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|log|2232|0
units.english: Declined an offer to join the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai rifiutato un'offerta di unirti alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|log|2236|0
units.english: Got invited to join the Free Worlds. It's a valuable opportunity, but it would also be a fast way to become an enemy of the Republic.
units.italian: Sei stato invitato a unirti alle Free Worlds. È un'occasione preziosa, ma sarebbe anche un modo rapido per diventare nemico della Repubblica.

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|Soon after you land, a courier arrives at your ship and hands you a formal looking letter. It reads:|2238|0
units.english: Soon after you land, a courier arrives at your ship and hands you a formal looking letter. It reads:
units.italian: Poco dopo che atterri, un corriere arriva alla tua nave e ti consegna una lettera dall'aspetto formale. Dice:

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|Dear Captain <last>,|2240|0
units.english: Dear Captain <last>,
units.italian: Gentile Capitano <last>,

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|	The Free Worlds Council would like to thank you for the invaluable assistance you have rendered to us recently. We are prepared to offer you a position as an officer in our militia, remaining in command of your own ship. Your starting salary will be 1,100 credits per diem. If you want to join us, please report to our headquarters on Bourne at your earliest convenience.|2241|0
units.english: The Free Worlds Council would like to thank you for the invaluable assistance you have rendered to us recently. We are prepared to offer you a position as an officer in our militia, remaining in command of your own ship. Your starting salary will be 1,100 credits per diem. If you want to join us, please report to our headquarters on Bourne at your earliest convenience.
units.italian: Il Consiglio delle Free Worlds desidera ringraziarla per l'inestimabile aiuto che ci ha recentemente offerto. Siamo pronti a offrirle un posto come ufficiale nella nostra milizia, mantenendo il comando della sua nave. Il suo stipendio iniziale sarà di 1.100 crediti al giorno. Se desidera unirsi a noi, voglia presentarsi al nostro quartier generale su Bourne appena le sarà possibile.

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|	Sincerely,|2242|0
units.english: Sincerely,
units.italian: Distinti saluti,

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|				Tomek Voigt|2243|0
units.english: Tomek Voigt
units.italian: Tomek Voigt

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|				Jean-Jacques Soleau|2244|0
units.english: Jean-Jacques Soleau
units.italian: Jean-Jacques Soleau

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|				Freya Winters|2245|0
units.english: Freya Winters
units.italian: Freya Winters

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|				Alondo Gruyere|2246|0
units.english: Alondo Gruyere
units.italian: Alondo Gruyere

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|				Katerina Reynolds|2247|0
units.english: Katerina Reynolds
units.italian: Katerina Reynolds

units.id: mission:FW Commitment|	You notice that Katya's name is printed, instead of signed like the others; she must still be undercover on Clink.|2249|0
units.english: You notice that Katya's name is printed, instead of signed like the others; she must still be undercover on Clink.
units.italian: Noti che il nome di Katya è stampato, invece che firmato come gli altri; dev'essere ancora sotto copertura su Clink.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|name|2256|0
units.english: Rescue Katya
units.italian: Salva Katya

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|description|2257|0
units.english: Rescue Katya from <planet>, before the Navy discovers her, and bring her safely to Longjump.
units.italian: Salva Katya da <planet>, prima che la Marina la scopra, e portala sana e salva a Longjump.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|You are on Bourne, the capital of the Free Worlds. Do you take them up on their job offer and volunteer to officially join them? With tensions between the Free Worlds and Republic so high, it's not unthinkable that they could go to war with one another, so it would be a good idea to have a warship and some spare funds before siding with the Free Worlds.|2268|0
units.english: You are on Bourne, the capital of the Free Worlds. Do you take them up on their job offer and volunteer to officially join them? With tensions between the Free Worlds and Republic so high, it's not unthinkable that they could go to war with one another, so it would be a good idea to have a warship and some spare funds before siding with the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Sei su Bourne, la capitale delle Free Worlds. Accetti la loro offerta di lavoro e ti offri volontario per unirti ufficialmente a loro? Con le tensioni fra le Free Worlds e la Repubblica così alte, non è impensabile che possano entrare in guerra fra loro, quindi sarebbe una buona idea avere una nave da guerra e un po' di fondi di riserva prima di schierarti con le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	(Yes.)|2270|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	(Not yet.)|2271|0
units.english: (Not yet.)
units.italian: (Non ancora.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	You find the Free Worlds offices and give your name to the person at the front desk. A few minutes later Tomek Voigt, who manages supplies and fleet movements for the Council, comes down the stairs to greet you. "I'm so glad you've agreed to join us, Captain <last>," he says.|2277|0
units.english: You find the Free Worlds offices and give your name to the person at the front desk. A few minutes later Tomek Voigt, who manages supplies and fleet movements for the Council, comes down the stairs to greet you. "I'm so glad you've agreed to join us, Captain <last>," he says.
units.italian: Trovi gli uffici delle Free Worlds e dai il tuo nome alla persona alla reception. Pochi minuti dopo Tomek Voigt, che gestisce i rifornimenti e i movimenti della flotta per il Consiglio, scende le scale per salutarti. "Sono così contento che tu abbia accettato di unirti a noi, Capitano <last>," dice.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	You find the Free Worlds offices and give your name to the person at the front desk. A few minutes later Tomek Voigt, who manages supplies and fleet movements for the Council, comes down the stairs to greet you. "Captain <last>," he says with a stern glare. "If it were up to me alone you would not be standing in front of me today, but it would appear that your continued help has earned you enough good will to surpass my mistrust of you.|2281|0
units.english: You find the Free Worlds offices and give your name to the person at the front desk. A few minutes later Tomek Voigt, who manages supplies and fleet movements for the Council, comes down the stairs to greet you. "Captain <last>," he says with a stern glare. "If it were up to me alone you would not be standing in front of me today, but it would appear that your continued help has earned you enough good will to surpass my mistrust of you.
units.italian: Trovi gli uffici delle Free Worlds e dai il tuo nome alla persona alla reception. Pochi minuti dopo Tomek Voigt, che gestisce i rifornimenti e i movimenti della flotta per il Consiglio, scende le scale per salutarti. "Capitano <last>," dice con uno sguardo severo. "Se dipendesse solo da me, oggi non sarebbe qui davanti a me, ma pare che il suo continuo aiuto le abbia guadagnato abbastanza benevolenza da superare la mia diffidenza verso di lei.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	"But I'm a reasonable man," he continues, his expression changing to a smile. "If my friends trust you, then I will give you a second chance, even if it is against my better judgment. Now please, join us."|2282|0
units.english: "But I'm a reasonable man," he continues, his expression changing to a smile. "If my friends trust you, then I will give you a second chance, even if it is against my better judgment. Now please, join us."
units.italian: "Ma sono un uomo ragionevole," continua, con l'espressione che si scioglie in un sorriso. "Se i miei amici si fidano di te, allora ti darò una seconda possibilità, anche se va contro il mio miglior giudizio. Ora, per favore, unisciti a noi."

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	That night you are introduced to the rest of the Council: Alondo Gruyere, the Council's chief diplomat, Freya Winters, an adept engineer and the Council's head of logistics, and Jean-Jacques "JJ" Soleau, an ex-Navy officer who now leads the training of the Free Worlds militias. Katya Reynolds, the final member of the Council, is not present.|2285|0
units.english: That night you are introduced to the rest of the Council: Alondo Gruyere, the Council's chief diplomat, Freya Winters, an adept engineer and the Council's head of logistics, and Jean-Jacques "JJ" Soleau, an ex-Navy officer who now leads the training of the Free Worlds militias. Katya Reynolds, the final member of the Council, is not present.
units.italian: Quella sera ti vengono presentati gli altri membri del Consiglio: Alondo Gruyere, capo diplomatico del Consiglio; Freya Winters, ingegnere esperta e responsabile della logistica del Consiglio; e Jean-Jacques "JJ" Soleau, ex ufficiale della Marina che ora guida l'addestramento delle milizie delle Free Worlds. Katya Reynolds, l'ultimo membro del Consiglio, non è presente.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	They take you out to dinner at a very fancy restaurant. Halfway through the third course of the meal, Tomek's communicator beeps. He reaches over to turn it off, then sees the message and turns pale. A hush falls over the table. "<system> has been captured by the Navy," he announces.|2286|0
units.english: They take you out to dinner at a very fancy restaurant. Halfway through the third course of the meal, Tomek's communicator beeps. He reaches over to turn it off, then sees the message and turns pale. A hush falls over the table. "<system> has been captured by the Navy," he announces.
units.italian: Ti portano a cena in un ristorante molto raffinato. A metà della terza portata, il comunicatore di Tomek emette un bip. Allunga la mano per spegnerlo, poi vede il messaggio e impallidisce. Cala il silenzio sul tavolo. "La Marina ha conquistato <system>," annuncia.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	After a long silence, JJ asks, "How many casualties?"|2287|0
units.english: After a long silence, JJ asks, "How many casualties?"
units.italian: Dopo un lungo silenzio, JJ chiede: "Quante vittime?"

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	"None," says Tomek. "The Navy claimed that <system> was the source of the terrorist attack, and after they showed the evidence to the militia commander on Deep he surrendered and yielded control of the system to them without a fight."|2288|0
units.english: "None," says Tomek. "The Navy claimed that <system> was the source of the terrorist attack, and after they showed the evidence to the militia commander on Deep he surrendered and yielded control of the system to them without a fight."
units.italian: "Nessuna," dice Tomek. "La Marina ha sostenuto che <system> era la fonte dell'attentato terroristico, e dopo che hanno mostrato le prove al comandante della milizia su Deep, si è arreso e ha ceduto loro il controllo del sistema senza combattere."

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	"Was Katya still there? We need to rescue her!"|2290|0
units.english: "Was Katya still there? We need to rescue her!"
units.italian: "Katya era ancora là? Dobbiamo salvarla!"

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	"We can't allow them to do that. We should gather our fleets and attack."|2291|0
units.english: "We can't allow them to do that. We should gather our fleets and attack."
units.italian: "Non possiamo permettere che facciano questo. Dovremmo radunare le nostre flotte e attaccare."

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	"Indeed," says Freya. "That should be our first priority."|2294|0
units.english: "Indeed," says Freya. "That should be our first priority."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice Freya. "Questa dovrebbe essere la nostra prima priorità."

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	JJ says, "Calm down, Captain. Combat is our last option, not our first. And if their claim is correct, they were justified in taking the system."|2298|0
units.english: JJ says, "Calm down, Captain. Combat is our last option, not our first. And if their claim is correct, they were justified in taking the system."
units.italian: JJ dice: "Calmati, Capitano. Il combattimento è la nostra ultima opzione, non la prima. E se la loro affermazione è corretta, avevano il diritto di prendere il sistema."

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	Freya says, "Uniting the militias could take weeks. A much more pressing issue is that Katya is still on Clink, unless anyone has heard otherwise from her."|2299|0
units.english: Freya says, "Uniting the militias could take weeks. A much more pressing issue is that Katya is still on Clink, unless anyone has heard otherwise from her."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Unire le milizie potrebbe richiedere settimane. Una questione molto più urgente è che Katya è ancora su Clink, a meno che qualcuno non abbia avuto sue notizie."

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|	"Well," says Alondo, "it's a good thing we haven't yet publicly announced that Captain <last> is working for us. Captain, we have one final mission for you as an independent merchant captain. We need you to stop on Clink, locate Katya, and bring her safely to Longjump without being stopped by the Navy."|2302|0
units.english: "Well," says Alondo, "it's a good thing we haven't yet publicly announced that Captain <last> is working for us. Captain, we have one final mission for you as an independent merchant captain. We need you to stop on Clink, locate Katya, and bring her safely to Longjump without being stopped by the Navy."
units.italian: "Beh," dice Alondo, "è un bene che non abbiamo ancora annunciato pubblicamente che il Capitano <last> lavora per noi. Capitano, abbiamo una missione finale per lei come capitano mercantile indipendente. Deve fare tappa su Clink, trovare Katya e portarla sana e salva a Longjump senza essere fermato dalla Marina."

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|log|2308|0
units.english: Alondo grew up on Bourne, the relatively prosperous planet on the edge of the Rim that is now the capital of the Free Worlds. He served as a Republic diplomat for years before becoming convinced that Parliament was just using him to "pacify" the less developed worlds in the South with empty promises. He joined the Southern Mutual Defense Pact in the early days, before it became the Free Worlds, and is now a member of the Council.
units.italian: Alondo è cresciuto su Bourne, il pianeta relativamente prospero ai margini del Bordo che ora è la capitale delle Free Worlds. Ha servito per anni come diplomatico della Repubblica prima di convincersi che il Parlamento lo stesse solo usando per "pacificare" i mondi meno sviluppati del Sud con promesse vuote. Si è unito al Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud nei primi tempi, prima che diventasse le Free Worlds, e ora è membro del Consiglio.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|log|2309|0
units.english: Tomek is a young and ambitious militia commander. His brilliant tactical leadership and charismatic personality gained him quite a following in the Dirt Belt region even before the Free Worlds came into existence. He was asked to join the Council in part because of his popularity with the local militias throughout the region.
units.italian: Tomek è un comandante della milizia giovane e ambizioso. La sua brillante guida tattica e la sua personalità carismatica gli hanno guadagnato un notevole seguito nella regione della Fascia di Terra già prima che le Free Worlds esistessero. È stato invitato a far parte del Consiglio anche per la sua popolarità presso le milizie locali di tutta la regione.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|log|2310|0
units.english: Freya is an engineer, specializing in surveillance equipment but with a wide range of talents. She organized the "Thousand Eyes" program run by the Southern Mutual Defense Pact, which was an attempt to reduce the power of the pirate fleets in the region by tracking their fleet movements. Despite her relative lack of interest in politics, she was asked to join the Free Worlds Council because of her expertise in optimizing the distribution and management of resources.
units.italian: Freya è un'ingegnere specializzata in apparecchiature di sorveglianza, ma con un ventaglio di talenti molto ampio. Ha organizzato il programma "Mille Occhi" gestito dal Patto di Difesa Reciproca del Sud, un tentativo di ridurre la potenza delle flotte pirata della regione seguendone i movimenti. Nonostante il suo scarso interesse per la politica, è stata invitata a far parte del Consiglio delle Free Worlds per la sua competenza nell'ottimizzare la distribuzione e la gestione delle risorse.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 1|log|2311|0
units.english: Known to most people simply as "JJ," Jean-Jacques grew up in the Dirt Belt and served in the Navy for years before quitting in frustration over the fact that the Navy was no longer defending his home region of space. He now serves on the Free Worlds Council, where he is tasked with coordinating actions between the local militias and shaping them into a single fighting force that can act in concert with each other.
units.italian: Noto ai più semplicemente come "JJ", Jean-Jacques è cresciuto nella Fascia di Terra e ha servito per anni nella Marina prima di dimettersi, frustrato dal fatto che la Marina non difendesse più la sua regione di spazio d'origine. Ora fa parte del Consiglio delle Free Worlds, dove ha il compito di coordinare le azioni fra le milizie locali e di trasformarle in un'unica forza combattente capace di agire in modo concertato.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|name|2318|0
units.english: Rescue Katya
units.italian: Salva Katya

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|description|2319|0
units.english: Return to <planet> and report to the Free Worlds Council that you were unable to locate Katya.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> e riferisci al Consiglio delle Free Worlds che non sei riuscito a trovare Katya.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|The mining outpost on Clink is swarming with Navy officers; you would guess that they in fact outnumber the miners. You are not sure how you are going to get in there and contact Katya without the Navy noticing.|2329|0
units.english: The mining outpost on Clink is swarming with Navy officers; you would guess that they in fact outnumber the miners. You are not sure how you are going to get in there and contact Katya without the Navy noticing.
units.italian: L'avamposto minerario su Clink brulica di ufficiali della Marina; supponi che siano in numero maggiore dei minatori. Non sei sicuro di come entrare e contattare Katya senza che la Marina se ne accorga.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Wait in my ship and see if she approaches.)|2331|0
units.english: (Wait in my ship and see if she approaches.)
units.italian: (Aspetta nella mia nave e vedi se si avvicina.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Check if she is waiting for me out by the test site.)|2332|0
units.english: (Check if she is waiting for me out by the test site.)
units.italian: (Controlla se mi sta aspettando fuori, presso il sito dei test.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Make some excuse to enter the outpost.)|2334|0
units.english: (Make some excuse to enter the outpost.)
units.italian: (Inventa una scusa per entrare nell'avamposto.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	You wait on the landing pad for several hours. Katya does not show up. Navy officers in pressure suits walk by your ship about every fifteen minutes, no doubt wondering what you are doing here.|2338|0
units.english: You wait on the landing pad for several hours. Katya does not show up. Navy officers in pressure suits walk by your ship about every fifteen minutes, no doubt wondering what you are doing here.
units.italian: Aspetti sulla piazzola di atterraggio per diverse ore. Katya non si fa viva. Ogni quarto d'ora circa passano vicino alla tua nave ufficiali della Marina in tuta pressurizzata, senza dubbio chiedendosi che cosa ci fai qui.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Check if she is waiting for me out by the test site.)|2340|0
units.english: (Check if she is waiting for me out by the test site.)
units.italian: (Controlla se mi sta aspettando fuori, presso il sito dei test.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Make some excuse to enter the outpost.)|2341|0
units.english: (Make some excuse to enter the outpost.)
units.italian: (Inventa una scusa per entrare nell'avamposto.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Give up and report my failure to the Council.)|2343|0
units.english: (Give up and report my failure to the Council.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia e riferisci il mio fallimento al Consiglio.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	You fly over the test site scanning for life signs or energy signatures, but there is nothing. And, there is little chance that Katya could be living out here for long, because she would need an oxygen source.|2347|0
units.english: You fly over the test site scanning for life signs or energy signatures, but there is nothing. And, there is little chance that Katya could be living out here for long, because she would need an oxygen source.
units.italian: Sorvoli il sito dei test cercando segni di vita o firme energetiche, ma non c'è nulla. E del resto Katya avrebbe poche possibilità di vivere quassù a lungo, perché avrebbe bisogno di una fonte di ossigeno.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Wait on the landing pad and see if she approaches.)|2349|0
units.english: (Wait on the landing pad and see if she approaches.)
units.italian: (Aspetta sulla piazzola e vedi se si avvicina.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Make some excuse to enter the outpost.)|2351|0
units.english: (Make some excuse to enter the outpost.)
units.italian: (Inventa una scusa per entrare nell'avamposto.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	(Give up and report my failure to the Council.)|2352|0
units.english: (Give up and report my failure to the Council.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia e riferisci il mio fallimento al Consiglio.)

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	You put on a pressure suit, leave your ship, and approach the outpost. As soon as you step through the airlock you are stopped by a Navy officer. "What is your business here?" he asks.|2356|0
units.english: You put on a pressure suit, leave your ship, and approach the outpost. As soon as you step through the airlock you are stopped by a Navy officer. "What is your business here?" he asks.
units.italian: Indossi una tuta pressurizzata, lasci la nave e ti avvicini all'avamposto. Appena varchi la camera di equilibrio vieni fermato da un ufficiale della Marina. "Che cosa fa qui?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	"My brother is a miner here," you say. "Our mother sent me to check on him."|2357|0
units.english: "My brother is a miner here," you say. "Our mother sent me to check on him."
units.italian: "Mio fratello è un minatore qui," dici. "Nostra madre mi ha mandato a vedere come sta."

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	The officer says, "Don't worry, no one here has been hurt, and they will all be free to continue their work shortly. But for now, I'm going to have to ask you to leave this world." He calls over several guards who are wearing pressure suits; they escort you to your ship and command you to take off.|2358|0
units.english: The officer says, "Don't worry, no one here has been hurt, and they will all be free to continue their work shortly. But for now, I'm going to have to ask you to leave this world." He calls over several guards who are wearing pressure suits; they escort you to your ship and command you to take off.
units.italian: L'ufficiale dice: "Non si preoccupi, qui nessuno è stato ferito, e tutti saranno liberi di riprendere il lavoro a breve. Ma per ora devo chiederle di lasciare questo mondo." Chiama diverse guardie in tuta pressurizzata; ti scortano alla tua nave e ti ordinano di decollare.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|	You have no choice but to head back to <planet> without Katya. The Council is going to be very disappointed.|2361|0
units.english: You have no choice but to head back to <planet> without Katya. The Council is going to be very disappointed.
units.italian: Non hai altra scelta che tornare su <planet> senza Katya. Il Consiglio sarà molto deluso.

units.id: mission:Rescue Katya 2|log|2365|0
units.english: The Navy has invaded Kornephoros, while Katya was still undercover on Clink. No sign of where she is. She may have been taken as a prisoner.
units.italian: La Marina ha invaso Kornephoros, mentre Katya era ancora sotto copertura su Clink. Nessuna traccia di dove sia. Potrebbe essere stata presa prigioniera.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|name|2371|0
units.english: Defend Sabik
units.italian: Difendi Sabik

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|description|2372|0
units.english: Help to repulse a Navy attack on Sabik, then land on Longjump to debrief.
units.italian: Aiuta a respingere un attacco della Marina su Sabik, poi atterra su Longjump per il debriefing.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|When you land on <planet>, you discover that Tomek has already found transportation here; he meets you almost as soon as your ship lands. When you step out of the hatch alone, without Katya, he turns away in grief. "I'm sorry," you say, "I couldn't locate her. The whole place is under guard."|2386|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, you discover that Tomek has already found transportation here; he meets you almost as soon as your ship lands. When you step out of the hatch alone, without Katya, he turns away in grief. "I'm sorry," you say, "I couldn't locate her. The whole place is under guard."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, scopri che Tomek ha già trovato un passaggio fin qui; ti viene incontro quasi appena la tua nave tocca terra. Quando esci dal portello da solo, senza Katya, si volta altrove per il dolore. "Mi dispiace," dici, "non sono riuscito a trovarla. Tutto il posto è sotto sorveglianza."

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	"Very well," he says, "we'll have to pray that she's still hidden there somewhere. In the meantime, we need to make your allegiance official so that you can fight alongside us if it comes to that."|2387|0
units.english: "Very well," he says, "we'll have to pray that she's still hidden there somewhere. In the meantime, we need to make your allegiance official so that you can fight alongside us if it comes to that."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice, "dovremo pregare che sia ancora nascosta là da qualche parte. Nel frattempo dobbiamo rendere ufficiale la tua appartenenza, così potrai combattere al nostro fianco se dovesse servire."

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	He is carrying a paintbrush and a very large can of green paint. "Would you like to do the honors?" he asks.|2388|0
units.english: He is carrying a paintbrush and a very large can of green paint. "Would you like to do the honors?" he asks.
units.italian: Porta con sé un pennello e un barattolo molto grande di vernice verde. "Vuoi fare gli onori?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	"Sure."|2390|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	"I can't just keep flying merchant colors?"|2392|0
units.english: "I can't just keep flying merchant colors?"
units.italian: "Non posso continuare a volare con i colori dei mercanti?"

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	"No," he says, "it would be dishonest, and if you were to fight alongside us you would be classified as a partisan, a criminal rather than an enemy combatant. Believe it or not, you're better off as an official prisoner of war than as a partisan, if you ever do get captured. So, time to start painting."|2394|0
units.english: "No," he says, "it would be dishonest, and if you were to fight alongside us you would be classified as a partisan, a criminal rather than an enemy combatant. Believe it or not, you're better off as an official prisoner of war than as a partisan, if you ever do get captured. So, time to start painting."
units.italian: "No," dice, "sarebbe disonesto, e se combattessi al nostro fianco saresti classificato come partigiano, un criminale invece che un combattente nemico. Che tu ci creda o no, se mai dovessi essere catturato staresti meglio come prigioniero di guerra ufficiale che come partigiano. Quindi è ora di cominciare a verniciare."

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	You take the paintbrush, climb on top of your ship, and begin painting it in the green and gold of the Free Worlds. Suddenly you hear a cheer from one of the other ships parked nearby; someone has seen what you are doing and is shouting, "For freedom! Another ship for freedom!" Soon several other people see you, and before long it seems like everyone in the port has picked up the cheer.|2397|0
units.english: You take the paintbrush, climb on top of your ship, and begin painting it in the green and gold of the Free Worlds. Suddenly you hear a cheer from one of the other ships parked nearby; someone has seen what you are doing and is shouting, "For freedom! Another ship for freedom!" Soon several other people see you, and before long it seems like everyone in the port has picked up the cheer.
units.italian: Prendi il pennello, ti arrampichi sopra la nave e cominci a dipingerla con il verde e l'oro delle Free Worlds. All'improvviso senti un grido da una delle altre navi parcheggiate lì vicino; qualcuno ha visto che cosa stai facendo e sta urlando: "Per la libertà! Un'altra nave per la libertà!" Presto ti vedono anche altri, e in poco tempo sembra che tutto il porto abbia raccolto quel grido.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	Tomek stands by, silently, until you finish, and then approaches you with an outstretched arm holding onto a license. "Here. You're going to need this. I'm sure your assistance will be invaluable to our cause," he says as you accept the militia license. "Now if you'll excuse me, I must gather the militia for the coming battle."|2398|0
units.english: Tomek stands by, silently, until you finish, and then approaches you with an outstretched arm holding onto a license. "Here. You're going to need this. I'm sure your assistance will be invaluable to our cause," he says as you accept the militia license. "Now if you'll excuse me, I must gather the militia for the coming battle."
units.italian: Tomek resta lì in silenzio finché non hai finito, poi ti si avvicina con il braccio teso che regge una licenza. "Ecco. Ti servirà. Sono sicuro che il tuo aiuto sarà inestimabile per la nostra causa," dice mentre ritiri la licenza della milizia. "Ora, se vuoi scusarmi, devo radunare la milizia per la battaglia che verrà."

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	(Let him go.)|2400|0
units.english: (Let him go.)
units.italian: (Lascialo andare.)

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	"I've never worked with another fleet in battle, what advice can you offer?"|2402|0
units.english: "I've never worked with another fleet in battle, what advice can you offer?"
units.italian: "Non ho mai combattuto insieme a un'altra flotta. Che consiglio puoi darmi?"

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	He stops his turn to leave. "Of course, you probably haven't spent much time in a militia fleet defending a planet or system." After a few moments of thought, he continues, "When fighting alongside a large fleet, it's usually best to work in groups, fire on the same targets as everyone else. You'll see the ships around you working together to disable a single target at a time, instead of everyone trying to run their own one-on-one fights. We don't expect you to defeat every Navy ship yourself. And, try not to get too close to their ships, either; you probably don't want a group all choosing to target you." He pauses for a moment. "Though, if you're feeling brave, you could try to get a large group of ships to follow you and lead them on a wild goose chase, leaving a smaller force for everyone else to deal with before moving on to your group. It'll be a short chase, however, if you can't stay out of their weapon range and evade their missiles. If it comes to defending this system in particular, the Navy may send additional ships after the initial wave. They will most likely arrive from Kornephoros, so being in their line of fire, on that side of the system, before they arrive is also something to avoid.|2403|0
units.english: He stops his turn to leave. "Of course, you probably haven't spent much time in a militia fleet defending a planet or system." After a few moments of thought, he continues, "When fighting alongside a large fleet, it's usually best to work in groups, fire on the same targets as everyone else. You'll see the ships around you working together to disable a single target at a time, instead of everyone trying to run their own one-on-one fights. We don't expect you to defeat every Navy ship yourself. And, try not to get too close to their ships, either; you probably don't want a group all choosing to target you." He pauses for a moment. "Though, if you're feeling brave, you could try to get a large group of ships to follow you and lead them on a wild goose chase, leaving a smaller force for everyone else to deal with before moving on to your group. It'll be a short chase, however, if you can't stay out of their weapon range and evade their missiles. If it comes to defending this system in particular, the Navy may send additional ships after the initial wave. They will most likely arrive from Kornephoros, so being in their line of fire, on that side of the system, before they arrive is also something to avoid.
units.italian: Si ferma mentre stava per andarsene. "Certo, probabilmente non hai passato molto tempo in una flotta della milizia a difendere un pianeta o un sistema." Dopo qualche momento di riflessione, continua: "Quando si combatte al fianco di una grande flotta, di solito è meglio lavorare in gruppo e sparare sugli stessi bersagli degli altri. Vedrai le navi intorno a te collaborare per mettere fuori uso un bersaglio alla volta, invece che ognuna impegnata nel proprio duello. Non ci aspettiamo che tu sconfigga da solo ogni nave della Marina. E cerca anche di non avvicinarti troppo alle loro navi: probabilmente non vuoi che un gruppo scelga proprio te come bersaglio." Si ferma un momento. "Però, se ti senti coraggioso, potresti provare a farti seguire da un gruppo numeroso di navi e portarle a spasso, lasciando una forza più piccola a tutti gli altri da affrontare prima di passare al tuo gruppo. Sarà un inseguimento breve, però, se non riesci a restare fuori dalla portata delle loro armi e a schivare i loro missili. Se si arriva a difendere proprio questo sistema, la Marina potrebbe mandare altre navi dopo la prima ondata. Molto probabilmente arriveranno da Kornephoros, quindi anche trovarti sulla loro linea di fuoco, da quel lato del sistema, prima che arrivino è una cosa da evitare.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	"Now, I really do need to go get everyone else ready."|2404|0
units.english: "Now, I really do need to go get everyone else ready."
units.italian: "Ora devo davvero andare a preparare tutti gli altri."

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	You find that the militia are collecting at the spaceport bar. Some congratulate you on joining the Free Worlds, but most are standing around quietly, waiting for something to happen. More gather as time goes by, to the point that the bar becomes overcrowded and militia are waiting in the streets outside the building.|2406|0
units.english: You find that the militia are collecting at the spaceport bar. Some congratulate you on joining the Free Worlds, but most are standing around quietly, waiting for something to happen. More gather as time goes by, to the point that the bar becomes overcrowded and militia are waiting in the streets outside the building.
units.italian: Scopri che la milizia si sta radunando al bar dello spazioporto. Alcuni ti fanno i complimenti per esserti unito alle Free Worlds, ma la maggior parte sta lì in silenzio, aspettando che succeda qualcosa. Con il passare del tempo se ne aggiungono altri, al punto che il bar diventa sovraffollato e i miliziani aspettano nelle strade fuori dall'edificio.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	An hour later, while standing outside the bar, you look up and notice the flashing lights of ship weapons fire off in the distance above the planet. Some militia begin running to their ships, but most stand there like a deer in headlights. Just then, Tomek returns with a megaphone and begins shouting orders. "The Navy has entered the system! We can't let them take it, or they'll have us completely bottled up. This is where it begins. We need to fight! Get to your ships, quickly! We have more reinforcements on their way from deeper in the Rim!|2407|0
units.english: An hour later, while standing outside the bar, you look up and notice the flashing lights of ship weapons fire off in the distance above the planet. Some militia begin running to their ships, but most stand there like a deer in headlights. Just then, Tomek returns with a megaphone and begins shouting orders. "The Navy has entered the system! We can't let them take it, or they'll have us completely bottled up. This is where it begins. We need to fight! Get to your ships, quickly! We have more reinforcements on their way from deeper in the Rim!
units.italian: Un'ora dopo, mentre sei fuori dal bar, alzi lo sguardo e noti le luci lampeggianti del fuoco delle armi delle navi in lontananza, sopra il pianeta. Alcuni miliziani cominciano a correre verso le loro navi, ma la maggior parte resta lì impietrita come un cervo nei fari. Proprio allora torna Tomek con un megafono e comincia a gridare ordini. "La Marina è entrata nel sistema! Non possiamo lasciarglielo prendere, o ci avranno completamente imbottigliati. È qui che comincia. Dobbiamo combattere! Correte alle vostre navi, in fretta! Abbiamo altri rinforzi in arrivo dal profondo del Bordo!

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|	"And if you can, disable their ships instead of destroying them. These are Navy ships, after all, and most of them don't want war any more than we do. Now go! Your worlds need you!" You hurry to join all the other ships taking off to defend the system.|2408|0
units.english: "And if you can, disable their ships instead of destroying them. These are Navy ships, after all, and most of them don't want war any more than we do. Now go! Your worlds need you!" You hurry to join all the other ships taking off to defend the system.
units.italian: "E se potete, mettete fuori uso le loro navi invece di distruggerle. Sono navi della Marina, dopotutto, e la maggior parte di loro non vuole la guerra più di noi. Ora andate! I vostri mondi hanno bisogno di voi!" Ti affretti a unirti a tutte le altre navi che decollano per difendere il sistema.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|log|2412|0
units.english: Officially joined the Free Worlds. Helping to defend Sabik, which is now under attack by the Navy. This Free Worlds work may mean getting involved in a lot more battles like this one.
units.italian: Ti sei unito ufficialmente alle Free Worlds. Stai aiutando a difendere Sabik, che ora è sotto attacco della Marina. Questo lavoro per le Free Worlds potrebbe significare finire coinvolto in molte altre battaglie come questa.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|dialog|2500|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still Navy ships circling overhead. You should take off and help finish them off.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora navi della Marina che girano là sopra. Dovresti decollare e aiutare a finirle.

units.id: mission:Defend Sabik|dialog|2502|0
units.english: The Navy has been driven off, but at a great cost. You should probably visit the spaceport and see if Tomek is there, or someone else who can tell you what to do next.
units.italian: La Marina è stata respinta, ma a un costo elevato. Probabilmente dovresti passare dallo spazioporto e vedere se c'è Tomek, o qualcun altro che possa dirti che cosa fare adesso.
